chapters.title: Chapter 51: The Wife They Chose to Take
paragraphs: I feel happy seeing her, because this beautiful woman is my wife.
"Naivara Tidewhisper."
"Luke, what are you doing here?"
Naivara asked with a confused expression, as she didn’t expect me to come here.
With a smile on my face, I told her.
"We got the invitation from the Count; that’s why we are here."
But as I finished speaking, I suddenly felt Aurielle’s hands trembling within mine.

"What happened, honey? Are you ok?" I bring my hands towards her face to check if everything is alright and then ask her. on which she nodded, but when I look into her, I can feel she is hiding something, like she is afraid.
"Seems like you have become familiar with each other." Naivara said with a normal voice as she saw our intimate action.
On this I smiled at her and said. "Yeah, all of you are my wives, and as a husband, I have to take care of all of you."
But after completing those words, Aurielle’s hands trembled more, and Naivara’s face changed little but before she could say something.
"Know your place, talentless hero."
Suddenly from the Naivara side an angry male voice came, and then I noticed that there were some other people as well.

Behind Naivara stood two beautiful women clad in full body armour coloured like the ocean, with intricate golden linings running across its surface. Though their helmets concealed most of their features, their faces could still be partially seen through the narrow visor slits.
Then, on her other side, stood a young man with dark blue hair and black eyes. He was dressed in luxurious clothes, resembling a finely tailored tuxedo.
Behind him also stood two women. Though they wore the same ocean coloured full body armour, theirs was adorned with silver linings instead of gold.
However, I could clearly see the disgust on his face as he looked towards me.
He stepped forward and looked down at both of us, his eyes filled with contempt.
"I don’t know how you managed to win the heart of this exiled princess."
He paused for a moment as he looked towards Aurielle with disgust as well.
"Well, I can’t expect more from someone who is really discarded, that she has to cling to a talentless person."
I clenched my fist as he said bad words about my wife, but then he added another line.
"But don’t expect Naivara to fall for you, because she has many better men for her in line."
"Enough, Oryn Seavale", Naivara, from the side, told him to shut up, and then she looked towards me with a sorry face.
Then she took a deep breath before saying it.
"Luke, we can’t be together, so forget about me."
"Huh?" I was stunned when she said that, and a moment later I asked, "What do you mean?"
Naivara sighed and told me. "Luke, you know, we were forced to marry you, and none of us are happy with this."
I felt pained in my heart as she said those words. But she continued.
"So my father has already decided to announce the ritual after some time."
Naivara said this to me while looking at my eyes.
"And what is this ritual?" I asked her back, holding onto a sliver of hope that perhaps we could stop it.
In response, she spoke in a resigned voice, as though her fate had already been decided.
"Ahh, this is the ritual that every Sea King holds. In it, one of his daughters is offered as a trophy to the strongest man who comes from every land and nation."

"They will fight among themselves, and the winner will marry the princess, as she will become his. And my father has chosen me." Naivara finished her last words in a sad voice, as though she didn’t want to be treated like a trophy to be won.
I got stunned by this; she is my wife. How dare they try to do something like that?
"But you are my wife!" I said in a slightly loud voice, on which I felt Aurielle hold tremble even more.
Naivara shook her head. "Does anyone even accept this marriage?"
I paused. As I turned around, I saw that some people had started gathering around us, and everyone wore the same expression, as if I were some kind of zoo monkey on display.
Then I turned to her and said with a loud voice.
"I don’t care about anyone, Naivara; I know only one thing: that you are my wife and these golden chains and those vows are proof."

As I finished my sentence, the golden chains connected to our hearts appeared. Everyone could see that two chains were connected to the girls present, while three others extended in different directions.
A small smile appeared on Naivara’s face.
"Sadly, Luke, those things do not matter; only strength matters. And the things about chains - my father has found the way, so he will also break the chain when I am married."
"What?" As I heard those words, my mind went blank for a moment.
"They will break the chains that are binding my wife to me? and then they will take her from me?"
Those words echoed in my mind as I unconsciously released Aurielle’s hand. on this her eyes had become so wet that tears seemed ready to spill out at any moment.
"Don’t go, Luke, please don’t go."
Aurielle muttered something in a very low voice, but I didn’t hear it, as all of my focus was now on Naivara and the words that kept repeating in my mind.
Slowly I start moving towards her and raised my hand to touch her while saying with a slightly trembled voice.
"But Naivara, I have taken a vow to protect all of you, a vow to protect all my wives. So how can they take you away from me?"
Then-
"Insolent! How dare you try to touch the Sea Princess?" one of the women besides her, whose armour was adorned with golden linings, suddenly shouted. Then she threw a punch at me.
"Too fast." I felt that her attack was moving faster than anything I had ever faced in my life; even sound speed seemed slow compared to her punch.
Suddenly Nyx and Myrkhal, who were sleeping inside me, came out and shouted in my mind.
"Look carefully, or you will get injured badly."
BANG!
But it was too late -
"Aghh!"
The punch connected with my gut at such terrifying speed that I couldn’t react at all.
BOOM!
A deafening shockwave erupted from the impact point as the air around us exploded outward.
For a brief moment, I felt as if all the air had been driven from my lungs.
My feet left the ground instantly, and the world became a blur.
But I vaguely saw Aurielle’s face twist into horror as my body was launched backwards through the air like a cannonball.
WHOOOOOSH!
Wind roared past my ears.
Then—
CRAAASHHHH!!
My body slammed into the side of a nearby building.
Stone shattered upon impact, and cracks spread across the wall like a spiderweb as chunks of brick and debris exploded into the street.
RUMBLE...
Dust clouds billowed outward, covering the surrounding area.
I smashed through part of the wall before finally stopping amid broken stone and splintered wood.
For a moment, my vision turned completely white.
A high-pitched ringing filled my ears.
Eeeeeeeeee...
Then, slowly, the world came back into focus.
A cry of pain escaped my mouth as I tasted something metallic.
Warm blood trickled from the corner of my lips.
My chest felt as though it had been crushed by a giant hammer.
Looking down, I immediately realised the severity of the damage.
Several ribs had broken from the impact, and the shattered bone fragments were now digging into my internal organs.
Every breath felt like a knife twisting inside my body.
"Luke!!!"
Then I heard Aurielle’s panicked voice as she shouted my name at the top of her lungs.
Weakly, I turned my head towards her.
Through the dust and debris, I saw her running towards me, tears already streaming from her eyes.
Her usual composure was completely gone, replaced by fear and desperation.
"Luke!"
Her voice trembled this time more as she pushed through the crowd, not caring about anything else.
Seeing her like that, a faint pain stirred in my heart, far worse than the injuries covering my body.
The surrounding people were laughing at my foolish attempt, treating the whole scene as entertainment.
In the distance, I also noticed several knights bearing the symbol of Stormveil County standing nearby, yet none of them made a move to intervene.
Then my gaze fell upon Oryn. A broad smile was plastered across his face, as if he were the one who had landed the punch himself.
Finally, I looked towards the woman who had struck me. Now that I could properly sense it, I finally felt her aura.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Do You Love Her More Than Me?
paragraphs: Finally, I looked towards the woman who had struck me. Now that I could properly sense it, I finally felt her aura.
"Definitely way stronger than Silver Knight, Golden Knight?" I thought weakly.
It seems she holds back her strength, or her princess would also die if I died.
But when our eyes met, I could clearly see the contempt on her face. Her expression seemed to say only one thing:
Just wait until those chains break.
Then I will erase this bug from the world.
"Back away!" Suddenly Naivara shouted at the golden knight, who just got back normally, as if she didn’t feel sorry about her actions.
Then Aurielle finally reached me and immediately dropped to her knees besides me, pulling my battered body into her embrace.
Tears streamed down her face as she frantically asked one question after another, her voice trembling with panic and fear.
Her hands shook as they gently caressed my face and ran through my hair, as if she was afraid I would disappear the moment she let go.
"Luke... Luke..."
She kept calling my name, her tear-filled eyes desperately calling me back as she tried to make sure I was still conscious.
I didn’t reply to her as my bloodshot eyes remained fixed on the golden-armoured woman.
Then, for the briefest moment, my face glitched.
First into Myrkhal’s Titan form.
Then into Nyx’s.
The change lasted only a fraction of a fraction of a second, so fast that nobody noticed it.
Nobody except three beings.
Nyx looks toward Luke worriedly, and Myrkhal just looked at curisoty.
[Luke, control your emotions; if you got out of control, then Aurielle Life could also be in danger.]
Finally, the system’s voice brought me out of my thoughts, as it calmed my mind somewhat. But even then, my gaze remained fixed on the golden knight and Oryn.
But I didn’t notice that Naivara was moving towards me and now has come close.
When I finally noticed her, I could see her face also become a little worried then as she was about to get down and check on my condition.
"DON’T TOUCH HIM!"
Aurielle suddenly freaked out and shouted at Naivara at the top of her lungs.
On this Naivara flinched and backed away a little, as Aurielle’s eyes are now deep purple, but there is a shade of violet sun in them.
Both Golden Knights suddenly appeared besides the Naivara, but she raised her hand instantly to stop them from attacking Aurielle.
I could feel Aurielle’s anger as she held me tightly, worried if something would happen to me again.
But then I heard Naivara’s voice and looked towards her.
"Luke, you said you had taken a vow to protect us, but right now you can’t even defeat my bodyguard. Then how are you going to protect all of us?"
When those words left her mouth, they stung my heart deeply.
Because I knew it was the truth, as I couldn’t even face those Golden Knights.
Suddenly a wave of sadness washed over me as I realised how powerless I truly was.
I couldn’t even protect my own wife, who was now going to be placed on display like a trophy for all men from every land to claim.
"I hate this weakness." I clenched my fist hard, but Aurielle held my fist and looked at my eye.
"Luke, I am here," she said while bringing my hand to her cheek.
I calmed down a little after looking at her purple eyes, which were filled with only love and worry for me.
Naivara watched all of this and sighed; then she left them and headed towards the Count’s mansion.
Oryn paused slightly and said a word before also following them.
"Talentless."
Soon surrounding people also start returning back to their work as territory guards as well.
As the crowd finally reduced, I said to Aurielle,
"I am sorry, Aurielle, that your husband disappointed you so much and turned himself into a laughingstock in front of everyone."
Nyx also heard everything, but he didn’t say anything, and Myrkhal returned back to sleep.
Aurielle who upon hearing this give me a angry glare.
"My husband is the best, and I don’t care what others think about him."
She held my cheeks with her both hands forcefully and said those words to me.
"Master" Then I heard my knights voices as they have returned.
After a moment, I sighed and felt the weakness spreading throughout my entire body. Then I looked at everyone and said.
"Let’s return to the inn." On this everyone nodded.
Though I can see anger in their eyes. "Seems like they also heard something."
I shake my head, and with the help of Aurielle, I stand up, and then all of us return back to the inn.
"Welcome back." The cat girl smiled warmly at us, but then she frowned when she noticed that I was wounded.
"Sir, are you okay? Should I order some health potion for you?"
She asked worriedly, to which I shook my head and left for our room before thanking her.
CRRREK.
As Aurielle closed the door, I looked around and found that the interior was quite tall, like 15 feet.
Then Nyx came close and told me. "Luke, you can use your titan form to heal those wounds fast."
I nodded, as that was my plan.
Then I look towards Aurielle, who is preparing water for me. and I told her.
"Honey, I am going to summon my giant form, so don’t panic." On this she nodded.
"Nyx Ascension!"
The moment those words left my mouth, my whole body suddenly began to expand.
In an instant, I grew into a twelve foot tall giant with dark blue hair and azure blue eyes.
"Even though I am only getting a one time strength bonus, the titan regeneration ability is still effective."
CRACK CREEK.
As those words left my mouth, I felt my those broken ribs being forcefully coming out and new bones growing.
Tak...tak.
The moment those bones dropped to the ground, my muscles also started healing back, and in just a few minutes I was now fully healthy.
"Hufff..." I took a long breath and removed my titan form, and then my body slowly returned to human form.
"This always feels amazing seeing how even the serious injury healed in a moment."
After being surprised by instant healing, I smiled, but when I noticed the stamina consumption, I felt this titan form could be held for only five more minutes.
"Is there some kind of stamina increasing potion or fruit?" This thought came into my mind after noticing that healing my wounds also consumed stamina.
"Luke!" Then I heard Aurielle call and turned towards her.
There she is, crying and while making a sad expression.
I got confused on this and asked back. "What’s happened?"
On which she paused slightly and then asked. "Luke, am I not enough for you?"
"What?" I got baffled when she asked me this, because I don’t know. What is she trying to say??.
"Am I not enough to make you happy?" She asked again but added more words this time.
I saw her crying stop somewhat, as I know she is expecting my answer with a serious face.
On this, I walked towards her and held her shoulder while looking straight at her purple eyes.
"Of course you are enough. When did I ever say that I am not happy with you?"
With a smile I said to her, but her face didn’t change and she didn’t become happy; instead, it became more sad, like I had wronged her.
"Then, why did you go towards Naivara?" She holds my collar tightly, which I have just changed.
"Tell me... do you love her more than me?"
She finally spoke the words that had been stabbing her heart the entire time.
The moment he released her hand and walked towards Naivara, a fear she had never experienced before gripped her heart.
It felt as though someone was slowly tearing him away from her.
"Tell me!!!"
She suddenly yelled at me, her voice breaking with panic and desperation.
Tears streamed down her face as her trembling hands clutched my clothes tightly, as if she were afraid I would disappear the moment she let go.
[Chapter End]

The moment he released her hand and walked towards Naivara, a fear she had never experienced before gripped her heart.
It felt as though someone was slowly tearing him away from her.
"Tell me!!!"
She suddenly yelled at me, her voice breaking with panic and desperation.
Tears streamed down her face as her trembling hands clutched my clothes tightly, as if she were afraid I would disappear the moment she let go.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Please Don’t Leave Me
paragraphs: "Tell me!!!" She yelled at Luke, who now stood frozen like a statue, because he had a clear answer, but he knew that saying it would be the wrong choice.
Because both of them were his wives, and asking him to choose between them was nothing less than pure torture.
After a long silence, Luke finally forced those words out of his mouth.
"Both of you are my wives. Of course, I love both of you."
But those words only made Aurielle’s face turn pale. Her eyes trembled, and then she shouted, unable to hold back the emotions bottled up inside her any longer.
"How can you love her? Or your other wives?"
Aurielle suddenly pulled his collar until their faces were only inches apart.
Tears streamed down her cheeks as she shouted, but her voice filled with pain and frustration.
"I am your only wife, not them!"
"They were the ones who left you, and it was me who took care of you!"
"Do you understand? It was me, not those bitches who left you and didn’t care about you at all!"
Luke could see Aurielle crying so hard as she shouted at him, her voice breaking more and more with every word.

Because he also knew the truth, if Aurielle had not taken care of him and had left him as well, he would have struggled to find even a safe shelter to call home, wandering aimlessly until one day he would have died.
Yeah, because he later found out that even if he died, all of them would still have one year before they died because of the golden chain.
So they could find the cure while he was long dead.
"I am sorry, Aurielle," Luke said to her in a low voice.
Aurielle’s pupils dilated after hearing his words, and she felt that her body was losing all strength.
"Aurielle!" Luke hurriedly held her when he noticed she suddenly collapsed to the ground.
"Are you okay?!" Luke held her tightly and asked worriedly while looking at her eyes, which now have lost their color.
"So you don’t love me." But then Luke heard Aurielle’s somewhat low but lost voice, like she doesn’t want to live anymore.
"What are you talking about?"
Luke held her face close to his, their foreheads almost touching as they both sat on the floor of the room.
Luke kissed her forehead and said it. "I love you and I will always love you."
He finally finished saying this, but Aurielle didn’t respond; her eyes just looked blank, but then she muttered something in a weak voice.
"Do you know? When you released my hand after seeing Naivara, I got so afraid that I thought you would leave me."
I didn’t say anything; I just quietly listened to her talk while holding her.
"I know; you are special, Luke." She finally looked at his eyes with love and raised her hand slowly to caress his cheek gently.
"I know, I can’t take you all for myself." Then she also brings Luke’s hand to her cheek.
"But remember, I am your only wife; if not, at least I am your first wife and always will be."
With that, she stood up weakly and swayed Luke’s hand away that was holding her, before walking towards the bed.
"Aurielle!" Luke called to her, but she didn’t stop and just slumped into bed.
He knows he is the worst, but he has taken a vow to protect his wife and his loved one.
So he just can’t abandon the other. "I need to be careful and have to think more about how to handle them."
Luke sighed, but then Nyx’s voice came.
"It seems like she thought you have only her in your heart."
Luke paused and turned to look at Nyx, who was floating beside him but then Nyx moved and sat on his shoulder.
"Your problem was not only that you ignored her, but you also left her behind for another woman even though she is your wife as well."
Luke lowered his head, as he knew he had made this mistake, but he just couldn’t control himself.
He was finally able to meet his other wife and thought that maybe all of them can be together.
"Just be careful next time and don’t ignore your wife for another woman, at least not when all of them are together."
With that, Nyx transformed into black light and merged into Luke’s body.
After all these talks, Luke sighed once more and thought, "Today is really my bad day.
With that, he moved towards the bed as well and lay down besides Aurielle.
"Honey, I am really sorry, and I promise I will never ignore you again." Luke said as he slowly leant close to her.
He held her waist gently and cuddled with her, with his face buried in her neck, where he smelled her scent, which also helped him get calmer.
Aurielle heard Luke’s voice and also felt his gentle touch as his hot breath touched her neck. But she still didn’t say anything.
Finally, after some time, Luke fell into a deep sleep, while Aurielle was still awake and thinking something else.
"Does he love her beauty that much? ... or her status?"
Aurielle was lost deep in thought when she remembered Naivara’s face and the guards behind her.
Then slowly she turned towards Luke, who had already fallen into a deep sleep.
She looked at his handsome face, which she never felt when they first met.
But soon her thoughts again spiraled further, sinking deeper with every passing second.
"Or is it because she is a real princess... and I am an exile?"
"Am I not special enough... is that why he doesn’t show interest in me?"
She trembled when this thought finally came into her mind and settled down like it was really this reason.
A tear dropped onto the pillow from her eyes as she looked at Luke’s sleeping face.
"Please... don’t leave me."
With that whisper, she leant in and hugged him tightly, like maybe this was the last time they would be together.
In response, Luke unconsciously wrapped his arms around her as well.
And in that fragile silence, both of them drifted into sleep together.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 54: All of This Was an Act
paragraphs: Oryn looked toward Naivara, who was sitting beside the window seat in the carriage but she seems lost in thoughts while she was looking outside.
Naivara was thinking about the moment when she looked at Luke eyes and only saw genuine sincerity.
But when he got harmed and she tried to help him but at that point Aurielle suddenlyl shouted at her angrily and didn’t let her touch Luke, like she was the one who harmed Luke.
"He is also my husband; why would I hurt him?" She muttered in a very low but disatisfied voice that Oryn didn’t hear at all.
Seeing she was still lost in thought, Oryn got angry and said in a loud, dissatisfied voice.
"Naira, are you still thinking about that loser?"
Naivara suddenly comes out of her thoughts as Oryn’s loud voice enters her ears.
She turned toward him and gave him an disatisfied look.
"Oryn, that’s enough!" She said with a slightly angry voice, on which Oryn’s face turned to disbelief, but Naivara continued.
"I know, you don’t like him, but he is still my husband and I don’t like if you keep repeating those words toward my husband."
With that She turned her face away from him and kept looking outside.
But Oryn’s face became ugly, and he shouted with an angry voice.
"So, now you are going to take his side!"
Naivara heard his word clearly, but she didn’t replied and just kept looking outside.
Oryn grew even more furious at her reaction as he abruptly stood up inside the carriage and pointed a finger directly at Naivara as he shouted.
"Does your younger brother’s words not matter anymore?!"
"Don’t forget Naivara; he won’t be able to upgrade his realm in his entire life because he is talentless, and that’s the truth."
An irritated expression appeared on Naivara’s face as he was still saying that word.
With a swift motion she turn toward him and gave him a glare, like dare to say that one more time.
Oryn didn’t flinch, but he shouted even more loudly so that those guardians who were following them outside also heard Oryn’s angry voice.
"I don’t know how much that exiled princess consumes her resources to rank up that waste to the first stage of Iron Knight!"
"But I am sure she wouldn’t have more and that’s the max he can reached with his exile princess wife."
Naivara face changed as she also felt Luke realm, even though she got suprised, but now it’s seems that Aurielle has given him some special medicine.
"Do you think he cares about this wife stuff?" Suddenly Oryan’s face changed to disgust when he thought about how that bastard was reaching his hand toward her sister, and he said.
"All those protecting his wives and all those vows are lies!
He finally let the dam loose and said those words, which he felt the moment he saw that talentless hero.
Finally Naivara faced change as a slight confusion appeared in her eyes; on this, Oryn faced change to slight smile, and he continued.
"He knows, he is talentless, so he can’t able to survive in this world!"
Naivara rose her face at this and looked at Oryn’s eyes.
"So he need someone."
Oryn’s face changed to contempt when he thought about this.
"And what’s the best option? when he have five princess wives."
Oryn saw Naivara’s expression start becoming even more confusing, so a delightful feeling occurred inside him, and with a smile, he continued.
"And don’t forget the most important thing, Naivara!"
He stepped closer to Naivara as he spoke on this Naivara’s expression shifted and a baffled look crossing her face as she thought.
"What’s the most important thing?"
Oryn smile become wider, seeing her confused expression.
"He is a HUMAN!!!."
Naivara’s eyes widened and her breathing stopped for a moment as the Oryn’s last word entered her ears.
Oryna nodded with satisfictation as he said the final word.
"You know, humans always lie, and they like to play deceitfully."
"So he knows that Aurielle’s resources are consumed by him and she can’t help him anymore, and that’s why he needs someone else."
Naivara’s body trembled slightly as those words entered her ear.
Oryn stepped even more close to Naivara and looked at her eyes and said.
"So when he saw you, he knew what to do."
Oryan stopped in front of her, but he could feel Naivara’s body trembling more than before, like even those little bits of trust she had towards Luke were shaking.
So he finally said the word that finally broke the camel back.
"All of that was an act, Naivara... all of it!!! "
"NO!"
Naivara suddenly shouted as she punched Oryn in the face, his eyes widen in shock, because it was too fast and the very next moment.
BOOM!
With a deafening bang, he tore through the carriage door and was blasted straight toward the ground nearby.
His body slammed into the earth with brutal force, carving out a small crater as the impact echoed through the area.
Dust and debris rose upward, which swallowed the crash site for a moment.
"What’s happened?"
"Is it an attack?!"
"Someone call the guards!!!"
The surrounding people were stunned for a brief moment, then panic erupted.
Fear instantly spread through the crowd like wildfire as they realized this was the first time someone had dared to attack the central district of Stormveil Territory.

Many people’s faces turned pale as their eyes widened in shock and disbelief. Some people even instinctively stepped back, while others froze in place, unable to process what was happening, while a few others even dropped what they were holding as their hands began to tremble.
As their voices rose and chaos spread through the area, the patrolling guards finally noticed the disturbance. And without hesitation, they charged toward the source of the commotion.

The Golden and Silver Guardians expressions instantly turned serious as they assumed it was an attack targeting the princess and prince. In an instant, they summoned their armor and weapons and equipped them in a swift motion.

The golden knight woman scanned the surroundings warily, her sharp eyes narrowing as she searched for anything suspicious. At the same time, she issued quick orders to the silver knights, her voice sounding urgent and controlled as she prepared for possible combat.
"Go check it!"
The silver knight nodded, but before she can move.
BOOOM!

Suddenly a heavy pressure belonging to the peak knight realm descended on the surrounding area, and everyone from gathering crowds to the patrolling members and even the peak knight guardians was pressed instantly into the ground.
"YOU ARE LYING!!!"
"Princess!!"
The golden knight women instantly identify the voice and gritted her teeth, as she utter those words, even though she can resist this pressure, but it was also difficult even for her.
"Who messed up the princess’s emotions?"
That only thought occurred to her mind, as she remembered, after her mother got in a coma; whenever the princess becomes unstable, then destruction follows.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 55: The Hope That Should Not Have Bloomed
paragraphs: Naivara was always alone from birth, as she had no friends, and even in those parties she attended, every man gazed only at her body curves or private parts, which often made her uncomfortable.
"Mom, I don’t want to attend those parties, because I don’t like how they see me."
In a luxurious room, small Naivara said this to her mom.
Her mom smiled sadly and replied.
"Just don’t look at them, sweetheart, and everything will be fine."
Small Naivara nodded as she asked.
"Mother, can we go to the island that we went to last time?"
Her mom nodded.
On a beautiful beach two people were playing; one of them was Naivara and the other was her mom.
"Mother, this place is so beautiful; I always want to stay here!"
Naivara’s mother smiled at her daughter’s happy face.
The whole surrounding was burning along with the huts, and people were running away from the attackers.
"Mother!!!"
Naivara shouted at her mother to call her back but-
"Run, Naivara, run away!!"
Her mother shouted as she cut down the demon, who had suddenly invaded the island, while trying her best to protect Naivara.
But the next moment Naivara’s eyes widen as she raises her hands toward her mother to warn her.
"Moth-"
PUCHII!
But it was too late; her eyes widened as a female demon who looks different from others suddenly appeared behind her mother and pierced her body with a red dagger.
"NO!"

She screamed when she saw this; her mother also got stunned from the sudden attack, and then she felt her body become weak, but as her body started falling toward the ground, her worried gaze only followed Naivara, who was crying as she extended her trembling hands towards her.
The female demon saw all of this and laughed at Naivara before disappearing in black light, leaving her in despair.

Inside a luxurious palace that was situated beneath the sea and that looked like some kind of paradise, inside was only two person one, One was a strikingly beautiful woman, lying motionless on a bed.
Her body doesn’t bear any wound, but she seems to be in deep sleep.
The other was a beautiful woman who has ocean colored hair and ocean colored eyes, she looks with expectant eyes toward the sleeping woman who has a peaceful expression.
But after a moment a tear appeared in her eyes, as it’s been 10 years, but she has not awoken and talked to her; not once has she called her name.
"Mother, I will be a good girl, so please awake."
She spoke in a low voice as the tear dropped to the ground.
Knock!
After that, a knock sounded, followed by a voice.
"My lady, His majesty has summoned you."
Naivara paused as she heard those words, and then she wiped away her tear and replied.
"Ok."
With that, she left the room, but she still gave a last glance at her mother before closing the door.
"This cursed person is still here?"
"If she hadn’t insisted on going to that island, then maybe her highness would be alright."
"What do you think? Why has His Majesty summoned her?"
The maid who cursed her with a dissatisfied face heard her coworker’s words.
On this her face changed to even more dissatisfaction.
"What else? She would have killed someone or crippled again."
"What? Again?"
The other maid shut her mouth with one hand as she did hear the rumors about the youngest princess, who often got angry and lose control.
Then she asked her in a low voice.
"Why?"
The other maid who was cleaning the photo frame paused and gave a small look toward the Naivara, who was moving like she didn’t care about their talks.
"What else? Just some men looked at her, and she got angry."
"Huh? Isn’t she going to be offered on the ritual day anyway? Then why does she care about other men’s gazes?"
Naivara heard the gossip of maids with one ear and let it out with the other ear.
"It’s not the first time; even though she knows her fate and knows that these maids are of her stepbrother and sister, she never shuts them up."
Naivara thought about one time she killed one maid who talked bad about her, but instead the sea king punished her harshly.
She sighed as she finally reached the huge majestic door, which demanded to kneel, just standing in its presence, and then knocked.
"Come!"
Just after a moment an equally majestic voice comes from the inside.
"Greeting, Sea King."
Naivara, after entering the large room, which is King Hall, bowed toward the throne.
In the hall only the king is sitting, as other seats are empty at the moment.
"In an hour, you have a marriage to attend."
Naivara’s pupils widened as his majestic voice entered her ears, but the next moment she sighed and let it be.
"Then someone else will be chosen for ritual?"
Naivara got a little curious and asked back; on this, she shut her mouth the next second.
"No!"
But surprisingly the sea king answered, but she got even more confused after hearing this, and then his voice came again.
"Your marriage is going to happen with a talentless human hero, and it will be just a formality!"
Naivara’s eyes widened. "Human? Talentless hero? Formality?"
But before she can think more, "Just follow the ceremony and return back; after that, I will deal with the aftermath."
With that, she suddenly found herself teleported to the main location of Sea Palace, a place directly connected to the Holy Church.
"Marriage Successful"
She saw her husband for the first time. He is pretty normal looking, with black hair and blue eyes.
She had so many suitors visiting her that Naivara could no longer find any new men to her liking, but then he smiled at them.
Naivara got stunned for a moment because in those eyes, she saw a genuine smile.
A smile she almost forgot, because every man only looked at her with a lustful gaze as they were scanning their trophy.
"Why is he with Selene?"
Naivara suddenly felt uncomfortable because she saw Luke enter the temple hall with Selene hand in hand while they were laughing.
"I will challenge you to a duel of honor."
"Idiot" Naivara saw how he lost his control when someone proposed to Selene.
Then a thought comes into her mind.
"If someone proposes to me, will he also challenge them?"
But the next second she shook her head, because there are thousands of men who would be there to propose to her.
"So how many can he even beat?"
During the duel.
"Will he survive?"
This thought comes into Naivara’s mind as she sees Luke get blasted away with Lumien’s one punch.
Inside the ship.
"I am leaving."

She gave a final look toward her husband one more time and muttered.
"Formality"
Then she shook her head, because her fate was already decided.
"Luke"

But then she saw how close Aurielle and Luke had become.
"Is that what a husband and wife relationship looks like?"
She questioned in her mind as she saw Luke asking worriedly toward Aurielle, and she felt a little uncomfortable about this.
"NO!"
This thought comes into her mind as she sees her guardian attack Luke.
"Is he alright?"
Naivara thought worriedly and moved toward him, but her outward expression didn’t change.
"DON’T TOUCH HIM!"
But Auirelle suddenly shouted at her, and she instinctively backed away.
She felt a pain in her heart as she saw Aurielle taking care of Luke.
Inside the carriage.
But when she heard Oryn talking bad about Luke, Naivara felt irritated, though even she doesn’t know why.
"All that was a lie!!!"
But when she heard this word, her mind went blank for a second.
Because she knows she is just some trophy and no one will care if something happens to her.
But still-
"You are my wife, and I will protect you!"
But those words feel kept echoing in her mind, and it feels genuine, and for the first time a little hope ignites in her heart.
Because maybe a miracle will happen and he will somehow save her? Wouldn’t that be good?
Wouldn’t she get loved by a husband instead of just being a plaything for men?
Wouldn’t he also hold her face worriedly and look at her eyes lovingly like he looked at Aurielle’s eyes?
But Oryn says all this was a lie. "Did Luke really lie to me?"
"Was it really he who was after my money but not me?"
"YOU ARE LYING!!!"
She felt angry at Oyrn word and finally punched him straight in the face because she didn’t believe him.
Naivara knows maybe he will come to her, as she has seen his eyes, and they contained trust when he said those words.
"Princess!"
She heard her guardian’s voice but didn’t react.
Soon, everyone saw a very beautiful woman as her hair flowed like water in all directions, while her eyes including the cornea gradually turned a deep, complete blue.
Naivara took a step toward the location where Oryn had crashed.

"Damn it, why is she angry?"
He asked himself, because he can’t accept that she is angry because of that talented hero.
"Princess, please stop!"
The guardian saw this and realized the situation was turning bad, so she hastily shouted at Naivara.
Naivara paused slightly as she heard her voice but then continued, like she wanted to teach him a lesson about breaking the only hope she held.
Naivara summoned tens of water spears and launched all of them at once at Oryn.
BOOM! BANG!
An explosion occurred at his location, forming some small dust cloud, but soon it was removed by wind.
Everyone watched as a small blue spherical barrier formed, shielding the prince.
"Naivara, what are you doing? Stop this immediately."
Oryn shouted at her as he saw the energy of the barrier was rapidly depleting.
The guardians, seeing that her words are not having any effect, also got worried.
Because she couldn’t attack the princess, but she also had to save the prince.
Then she said something which finally stops Naivara.
"Princess, His Majesty will not be happy if he finds that you have harmed the prince."
Naivara finally stopped as her face changed to horror because she remembered whenever she didn’t listen to his words, he gave her very harsh punishment.
She gritted her teeth as her eyes soon returned to their normal color, along with her hair, then she gave a death glare to Oryn, who flinched upon seeing it.
But the next moment, Naivara turned around and started walking toward the Count’s mansion.
"Saved."
Oryn took a breath of relief as he saw she finally left, and with the help of his silver guardians, he stood up and dispersed the crowd.
The patrolling guards of the territory also left without questioning anyone.
The golden guardian saw all of this, then left one here to guard the prince while she followed the princess.
Oryan looked toward the departing guardian and muttered something in a low but murderous voice.
"That trash hero will pay for this."
His guardians heard his voice, but no one said anything, and then they followed him toward the Count’s mansion as well.
[Chapter End]

sentences.text: Naivara was always alone from birth, as she had no friends, and even in those parties she attended, every man gazed only at her body curves or private parts, which often made her uncomfortable.
"Mom, I don’t want to attend those parties, because I don’t like how they see me."
In a luxurious room, small Naivara said this to her mom.
Her mom smiled sadly and replied.
"Just don’t look at them, sweetheart, and everything will be fine."
Small Naivara nodded as she asked.
"Mother, can we go to the island that we went to last time?"
Her mom nodded.
On a beautiful beach two people were playing; one of them was Naivara and the other was her mom.
"Mother, this place is so beautiful; I always want to stay here!"
Naivara’s mother smiled at her daughter’s happy face.
The whole surrounding was burning along with the huts, and people were running away from the attackers.
"Mother!!!"
Naivara shouted at her mother to call her back but-
"Run, Naivara, run away!!"
Her mother shouted as she cut down the demon, who had suddenly invaded the island, while trying her best to protect Naivara.
But the next moment Naivara’s eyes widen as she raises her hands toward her mother to warn her.
"Moth-"
PUCHII!
But it was too late; her eyes widened as a female demon who looks different from others suddenly appeared behind her mother and pierced her body with a red dagger.
"NO!"

She screamed when she saw this; her mother also got stunned from the sudden attack, and then she felt her body become weak, but as her body started falling toward the ground, her worried gaze only followed Naivara, who was crying as she extended her trembling hands towards her.
The female demon saw all of this and laughed at Naivara before disappearing in black light, leaving her in despair.

Inside a luxurious palace that was situated beneath the sea and that looked like some kind of paradise, inside was only two person one, One was a strikingly beautiful woman, lying motionless on a bed.
Her body doesn’t bear any wound, but she seems to be in deep sleep.
The other was a beautiful woman who has ocean colored hair and ocean colored eyes, she looks with expectant eyes toward the sleeping woman who has a peaceful expression.
But after a moment a tear appeared in her eyes, as it’s been 10 years, but she has not awoken and talked to her; not once has she called her name.
"Mother, I will be a good girl, so please awake."
She spoke in a low voice as the tear dropped to the ground.
Knock!
After that, a knock sounded, followed by a voice.
"My lady, His majesty has summoned you."
Naivara paused as she heard those words, and then she wiped away her tear and replied.
"Ok."
With that, she left the room, but she still gave a last glance at her mother before closing the door.
"This cursed person is still here?"
"If she hadn’t insisted on going to that island, then maybe her highness would be alright."
"What do you think?
Why has His Majesty summoned her?"
The maid who cursed her with a dissatisfied face heard her coworker’s words.
On this her face changed to even more dissatisfaction.
"What else?
She would have killed someone or crippled again."
"What?
Again?"
The other maid shut her mouth with one hand as she did hear the rumors about the youngest princess, who often got angry and lose control.
Then she asked her in a low voice.
"Why?"
The other maid who was cleaning the photo frame paused and gave a small look toward the Naivara, who was moving like she didn’t care about their talks.
"What else?
Just some men looked at her, and she got angry."
"Huh?
Isn’t she going to be offered on the ritual day anyway?
Then why does she care about other men’s gazes?"
Naivara heard the gossip of maids with one ear and let it out with the other ear.
"It’s not the first time; even though she knows her fate and knows that these maids are of her stepbrother and sister, she never shuts them up."
Naivara thought about one time she killed one maid who talked bad about her, but instead the sea king punished her harshly.
She sighed as she finally reached the huge majestic door, which demanded to kneel, just standing in its presence, and then knocked.
"Come!"
Just after a moment an equally majestic voice comes from the inside.
"Greeting, Sea King."
Naivara, after entering the large room, which is King Hall, bowed toward the throne.
In the hall only the king is sitting, as other seats are empty at the moment.
"In an hour, you have a marriage to attend."
Naivara’s pupils widened as his majestic voice entered her ears, but the next moment she sighed and let it be.

"No!"

Formality?"

chapters.title: Chapter 56: The Sea Princess’s Feelings
paragraphs: **Morning.
As I awoke in the morning, the first thing I saw was the sleeping face of Aurielle, which looks so beautiful that I just want to stare at her all the time.
Then I felt Aurielle’s soft body tightly clinging to my body as she was in my embrace, which brought a smile to my face.
Then my eyes lower toward her red lips, which feel so intoxicating as they’re calling me to taste them, and so I did!.
SMOCCH!
I kissed her lips gently at first, then sucked her lips.
I felt Aureille move slightly but didn’t wake up; instead, her lips reacted to my lips as she also kissed me back.
"So good!"
I exclaimed this in my mind because that’s the type of morning I always want.
After kissing her for a few more minutes, I reluctantly separated from her.
Still, I licked her lips last time to taste her and finally stood up from the bed.
But then the Quilt rolls slightly on this, and Aurielle’s hot, exposed body comes into my view.
"Damn it! This is not good for my weak little heart."
On this my little brother also moved slightly as if he were agreeing with me.
Because I could literally see her private parts were exposed partially from the dress she is wearing.
As Aurielle slept in a hurry yesterday, so she forgot to change clothes.
And now, it was ripped open in some places, like her breast, which was half exposed and would let you see the real deal if you slipped her clothes a little.
"Control yourself, Luke!"
I forcefully slapped my face to compose myself before heading toward the corner room, where a bathtub was located.
[Warning: Significant emotional fluctuations detected in one wife.]
But just as I took a step forward, I heard the system’s notification and froze in surprise. Had an entire day already passed?
[Wife: Aurielle — Emotional state unstable. Detected emotions: jealousy, anger, love, fear, resentment, worry, and numerous overlapping emotional responses.]
Then a new system screen pops up in front of me, which shows the list of emotions Aurielle shows during one day.
"That’s a lot," I muttered before recalling the system’s words.
It had said that even resentment or anger could generate rewards, although they would alter the rewards as well.
[Interaction with Second Wife: Naivara Tidewhisper detected. Emotional fluctuations registered. Calculating results...]
"What?" I got surprised. What does this mean? I can get rewards from all wives if I interact with them.
Then I remember those mage and potion rewards, so that’s why it was given like in the form of five.
I waited for the system to calculate the emotion while continuing to walk toward the bathroom.
[Second Wife: Naivara Tidewhisper — Emotional fluctuations detected.]
[Worry / Hope / Jealousy]
[10× Return Activated.]
As I splashed water on my face, I got stunned.
"She was jealous? But of whom?
Then I read other messages. I got even more confused. Worried and hopeful?
Because the system only showed emotions directed toward me while calculating rewards, which makes the whole thing even more confusing, especially since her expression hadn’t changed much.
While rubbing my face with a towel, I muttered, "Seems like there’s more to her."
Soon the system calculated the rewards and showed them to me.
[Rewards granted: Queen’s Ward x 10
Type: Enchanted Protective Ring
Grade: Arcane
Rank: Silver]
"Wow!"
"A silver rank artifact, amazing," I muttered after seeing its rank but got confused when I saw its grade.
"System, what are the grades in this world?"
[Luke, it follows the same you have heard in those novels and comics, but still I will show you the rank.]
Artifact Classification
1. Enchanted
2. Refined
3. Arcane
4. Noble
5. Grand
[Here are the starting five, which you need to know for now.]
As I was reading the classification, I noticed the system’s last words, which annoyed me, so I said,
"Fine. I’ll read the book and find more information myself. Don’t think I don’t have other sources."
But after hearing my reply, the system only shows this "I don’t care" expression.
"Yeah, you only care if Rod enters every hole. Horny system!"
As I made those sarcastic remarks, the system displayed a shocked expression, as if I had somehow wronged it.
I ignored his drama and took out one ring from the system space to inspect it.
Soon a finely crafted silver ring adorned with a small sky blue crystal set within a crown shaped setting appeared in front of me.
So I gently touched the azure crystal, and a faint azure blue glow spread across its surface as the surrounding Aether flowed through it.
"Beautiful!"
These words escaped my mouth, and then I asked the system to show its info.
[Description]

A defensive enchantment ring commonly bestowed upon royal heirs and high ranking nobles. While not designed for combat, the Queen’s Ward is renowned for its reliable protection and self sustaining enchantment.
The crystal embedded within the ring serves as an Aether reservoir, continuously drawing in ambient Aether from the environment to replenish its energy reserves.
"So it has history."
After reading its description, this thought comes into my mind, as this name makes sense.
"Queen’s Ward"
After that I checked its ability as well.
[Enchantments]
Spherical Barrier
When activated, the ring generates a translucent spherical barrier around the wearer.
Effects:
* Protects against physical and magical attacks.
* Shields the wearer from environmental hazards such as strong winds, debris, and elemental effects.
* Can expand slightly to protect nearby companions.
[Aether Absorption]
The crystal naturally absorbs surrounding aether to replenish the lost energy.
{If the shield is destroyed, it requires significantly more time to regenerate.}
Inscription: *"May Her Majesty’s grace stand between thee and all harm."*
"Ok, that’s insane."
I muttered after reading its effects, because it was an arcane grade artifact with the ability to channel Aether through itself, and this one was exceptionally good.
Because at the Silver Rank, the shield it generated could withstand attacks from Golden Knights to a certain extent before breaking.
The system even claimed that it could endure a single strike from a Peak Golden Knight, which was absolutely ridiculous.
"System, you are awesome."
I laughed while saying this to the system.
[There are still rewards left from Aurielle. After you see them, we’ll see if you still have the same praise for me.]
[Chapter End]

I am also incredibly grateful to Chex_Geam, SavageSauron, Yodalo, EternalVoidRuler, Unknown_Pervert999, AdiKai, Kr4n4, Mare_Nectaris, krishna_rajput_07, crimsonoverlord, Gilly1210, and Peter_kessignton and many more which names I have not mentioned here, because it will take too many words, for your Power Stone donations.
Believe me, it is your support that keeps me motivated.
Knowing that people are reading my novel and perhaps even enjoying it enough to support.
And this means a lot to me. Every donation, vote, and comment encourages me to continue writing and improving the story.
Many fellow readers have already joined, and we’d be happy to welcome more members into the community!

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Eclipse Queen Regalia
paragraphs: [Return system reward calculating.]
[Congratulations, Luke, for gaining an A rank gift bundle, which has more gifts than a normal package.]
"Wow, that’s great."
I smiled, but then quickly calmed down.
Because not everything inside the package would be worth A rank value. Some items could have an extremely high value on their own, which would naturally reduce the quality of the other rewards.
"I know you, System."
I said with narrowed eyes, but the system remained completely silent.
Then I clicked open the gift bundle.
[A ranked gift pack rewards.]
[10 iron knight realm warhorses x 100.]
[10 iron knight archers x 100.]
[1 bronze knight archer elite x100]
I checked starting three rewards, which are related to military growth, which is kind a good, as Blackstone Highlands still doesn’t have enough soldiers.
After reading everyone’s description, I also found that for 100x rewards, I have the option to take the large number or upgrade it to one quality higher.
So, I thought about it for a few moments before finally making a decision.
For warhorses, numbers are good, and the same even for archers because territory walls are completely empty, and I need large numbers to place on them.
Then I finally looked at the Bronze Knight, who was an Elite unit, and selected the upgrade option.
Soon, it changed into a Silver Knight Elite.
"Nice" Then I looked toward the remaining rewards, but the next moment a tear appeared in my eyes.
[Size changing clothes x100.]
"Yeah, do you know the embarrassment of being naked at the front of everyone, because I have felt it many times?"
I literally almost cried with happiness, because with this, I would no longer have to worry about being naked after my Titan transformation ended.
Just imagine it: if someone saw a one or two foot long dragon peeking out from below my waist, what would happen to those girls minds?
And as for the men... their confidence would probably be shattered on the spot.
[Girls will probably go crazy... and as for those men? Who cares about them anyway?]
As I was smiling happily, the system’s horny words instantly appeared before me.
"Well, in our time those small females often do go crazy at us." When I thought it was enough, then Nyx’s voice also came out.
There, those two were floating beside me. While Myrkhal remained quiet, I could see that he was once again curious about this new building we were in.
"I am not interested in showing my things to everyone."
I shooed them away with an irritated voice while checking the other rewards.
[Luke, wait.]
But then the horny system voice comes, as it seems very important.
I gave him an annoyed look but still nodded and asked.
"What?"
Nyx and Myrkhal also got close and looked focusedly at the horny system, like it was going to say something that could make them gods in a sec.
My eyes twitch at this, but I don’t say anything.
[These clothes are not simple, Luke; they can not only change size, but they can also change design according to your thoughts.]
When the system spoke those words, a bad premonition rose in my heart, because I know where this is going.
[So, why don’t you try this on every girl and wear your previous world’s sexy costume or dress? like a bunny dress or those bikinis.]
Nyx and Myrkhal nodded from the side, like they had gotten enlightened and finally found a goal.
"What? Enlightened? They believe the system’s rubbish words, even though the idea is good and I would love to see Aurielle in a bunny dress or even in a bikini."
I shook my head as those thoughts started getting weird, then ignored all three of them.
Because now the system was giving a separate lecture, while both titans listened as though they had finally found their master.
"Were they bachelors their entire lives? And when did they become so close to the system?"
With those thoughts in mind, I checked the next reward, and what I saw was crazy.
[Eclipse Queen Regalia (Relic Tier)] {System note: already upgraded.}
*"A crown is not worn by the worthy. It is taken by the victorious."*
A legendary armor forged from Nightsteel, Void Silver, and Abyss Crystals.
Soon, an armor appeared in my hands, feeling light and cold. At that moment, Nyx and Myrkhal also noticed it and came toward me, as they found this new armor somewhat interesting.
Then I lifted the Eclipse Queen Regalia for inspection and saw that its black violet plates were becoming darker and darker, even inside the room, which had sunlight coming through the window.
After that, I noticed its silver edges catching and reflecting the light, making the entire armor look even more regal.
Then my gaze turned toward the while faint violet runes that were drifting across its surface as if the armor itself were breathing in silence.

This armor consisted of a crown, which was black and silver in color and looked almost the same as the ones I had seen in movies, like the small crowns queens or princesses wear, rather than the large crowns worn by kings.
Then it’s chest armor, which is solid on the chest but filled with plates on its waist and hip sides.
Then finally the separated part, like long bracelets for both hands and legs, while a shoulder guard is also present.
And the below part consists of small armor, like leggings, which provides protection for the legs.
And finally, if we combine everything, then there is a black cloak behind it, which really makes it perfectly regal for any queen.
"Hmm...this armor looks normal, but the materials used are of good quality."
Nyx from the side rubbed his chin and said thoughtfully, but then Myrkhal opened his mouth after a long time and said.
"This armor contains something; if it is unleashed, it will grant the wearer enough strength to cross realms entirely and fight against them."
"What?" I was shocked, because even my Titan armor wasn’t that crazy.
"Is this armor really this strong?" I asked back to everyone, and at that moment, the horny system finally spoke in its usual tone.
[So, Luke, do you like the gift?] the system said proudly to me.
Nyx confusedly looked from the side, while Myrkhal simply floated closer, then sat down on my head and kept staring at the armor, trying to figure out what was hidden inside it.
[If you think this armor only has appearance, then you are hella wrong.]
I paused slightly at the system’s teasing, because I really wanted to know what was so special about it.
"Okay, tell me... or show its abilities then."
So I got straight to the point.
[Ok, as you wish, so here is the Queen Class Relic Armor, Eclipse Queen Regalia.]
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 58: The Armor That Defies Realms
paragraphs: [Ok, as you wish, so here is the Queen Class Relic Armor, Eclipse Queen Regalia.]
Passive Ability
Sovereign Physique
The armor continuously strengthens the wearer.
Effects:
* Increased strength.
* Increased speed.
* Increased durability.
* Increased reaction speed.
The enhancement grows stronger at night.
"Well, its first ability is sure good, and it’s a passive one." Nyx settled down on my shoulder and spoke, while Myrkhal, on my head, also nodded.
Passive Ability
Abyssal Resistance
Effects:
* High resistance to curses.
* High resistance to poison.
* High resistance to mental attacks.
* Increased resistance to darkness based attacks.
"This!" Nyx stood up suddenly and floated close to the system screen and read it again and again.
I got confused by Nyx’s reaction and asked him. "What’s happened?"
He stopped as he heard my voice, but when he turned, I could see his eyes were showing genuine excitement.
"Do you know, Luke, that the demons invading your world are just a fake type of Abyssal spawn?"
I shook my head at Nyx’s words, as I just got into this world and don’t know much about its history or the demons.
Well, if someone heard this, then they would laugh at me for sure, because I am a hero who is summoned literally to fight those demons.
But who can I blame? The moment I arrived, I was declared talentless and thrown out without any importance.
Nyx nodded understandingly and told me, "Those Abyssals are very crafty and often use curses, poison, and mental attacks."
He paused slightly as he was lost in thoughts, and then after a moment he said.
"I have seen so many worlds get destroyed because they don’t have any fixed measure or permanent cure for this."
He stopped and looked at me; finding I was listening, he continued, "Even though your world has light elements, which are natural banes for them."
"But still having something that can protect the person from those is very good." He finally finished his sentence as he praised this armor.
Then he added another line, that even though this world doesn’t have Abyssal demons, those demons often use similar abilities, though at a very weak level.
Then suddenly the system voice comes out.
[Luke, that’s why it is Relic tier, which comes on the 7th ranking, and even the kingdom has only a few of this type.]
When I read the starting words, I got happy, but when I read the last part, I got worried.
"Doesn’t then this is a time ticking bomb?"
I asked the system as sweat starts forming on my forehead and the cold queen armor suddenly starts feeling like a hot potato now.
But as I finished those sentences, I heard the system’s laughing voice, and then a few breaths later he calmed down and said in a teasing voice.
[Well, it is only one ability that makes it Relic tier; otherwise, its grade would be only Grand tier, the 5th rank, which any famous kingdom level specialist can craft.]
I finally relaxed after hearing this. So, if a person doesn’t use its unique ability, or at least doesn’t use it in front of everyone, then there is no need to worry.
I nodded and then checked its other ability.
Ability I
Shadow Acceleration
Darkness explodes beneath her feet.
Effects:
* Sudden bursts of speed.
* Rapid directional changes.
* Increased attack momentum.
"Pretty handy ability," I muttered as Nyx also nodded, though not excited as much.
Ability II
Phantom Sovereign
Creates several shadow afterimages.
Effects:
* Confuses opponents.
* Conceals real attack paths.
* Makes it difficult to predict movements.
"This will really come in handy in many situations." I said those words, on which both of them just looked at it, but didn’t get impressed.
Ability III
Queen’s Execution
The armor channels shadow energy into her weapon.
Effects:
* Greatly increases attack power.
* Armor piercing capability.
* Wounds become difficult to heal.
"In a one versus one, defeating this is going to be difficult."
Ability IV
Eclipse Wings
A pair of shadow wings manifests behind her.
Effects:
* High speed aerial movement.
* Mid air combat capability.
* Rapid repositioning.
"A flying ability." My eyes lit up, because who from the modern century wouldn’t want to experience the thrill of flying like those superheroes?
"Your form transformation ability also has a titan unlocked, who has wings." Myrkhal, seeing my excited expression, said with a normal voice.
Nyx from the side just shook his head, because every true titan can fly from birth.
I got excited thinking about that titan and decided to try soon.
Ability V
Abyss Armor
The armor enters an overcharged state.
Effects:
* Greatly increases defense.
* Reduces damage taken.
* Increases physical strength.
* Enhances all shadow abilities.
"Interesting ability, but not enough." Myrkhal again muttered something that I didn’t understand, but when I checked this ability, I got stunned because doesn’t this look the same as my third form?.
Then I checked the final ability of this armor with the numb expression as this have so many abilities.
But still one thought comes into my mind.
"Worthy of relic rank armor."
And Finally checked it’s last ability.
Ultimate Ability
Queen’s Descent
The armor releases its full power.
Effects:
* Massive increase in physical power.
* Massive increase in speed.
* Massive increase in shadow energy output.
* Every attack carries explosive shadow force.
"THAT’S IT! I KNEW IT! "Before I can even read!, Myrkhal suddenly shouted as he finally found the things that were bugging him.
"What’s happened?" Nyx asked confusedly from the side. On this, Myrkhal stopped and start telling him the answer is he found.
I ignored their gossip and also read the ability.
"What the hell!"
"Is this a joke?!"
I was shocked beyond words, because this was insane; no, it was beyond insane.
"I don’t know how massive the increase is, but seeing the name ’Queen descent,’ it does not look normal."
I muttered absentmindedly. "Because it was not." Myrkhal voice come from the side as he nodded.
"If the chosen person is wearing this armor, then if they are on the Silver Knight stage, then they can fight even the Golden Knight stage."
My mouth got closed fully because I had seen that golden knight and heard people saying it.
That golden knight is the realm’s, who can defend the city alone.

And a silver knight who is the start of a real knight but still not on the level of a city level powerhouse; if someone wore this armor, then they could fight against a city level powerhouse, which is crazy.
[Luke, that is the ability that makes it Relic tier. But don’t be happy soon, as it comes with a seven day resting period, meaning a one week cooldown.]
As I was getting high about thinking this, the system finally came and dragged me toward the ground.
"What do you mean?" I asked him back while giving an irritated look. From the side, Nyx, who is also reading the description again to check what’s Myrkhal told him, also got curious.
[Well, for one thing, this armor is rechargeable, so the wearer doesn’t have to worry about stamina consumption or aether.]
I nodded then I tried to ask something, "Can we fill the—"
[No, it can’t be filled or recharged with energy, as its source is Void itself. And it also takes time to repair the damage its Aether circuits have taken after this ultimate ability.]
[at least now.]
I shut my mouth, as the system already read my loophole method and told me in advance.
Nyx smiled because he also guessed what Luke was thinking.
[So, that form consumes all the energy at once, and for five minutes that person can enter a queen state.]
"Ok," I nodded, and then I asked him an important question whose answer I already knew.
"System, I definitely can’t wear this, right?"
[Yes, Luke, this armor is made for a queen, and you are a man who has to conquer those queens, so how can you wear such an unmanly thing?]
System roasted me while giving the reply.
"The last part was not necessary."
I sway my hand at the system screen and finally check the last two rewards.
[100 gold coins x 100.]
"You know me, system." A satisfied smile appeared on my lips, because with this money, now I have some capital to buy many things.
But when I saw the last rewards, I paused and washed my eyes again with the water.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 59: A Ring for My Wife
paragraphs: But when I saw the last rewards, I paused and washed my eyes again with the water to confirm that I was not hallucinating.
"Did you guys also see the same things? That’s what I am seeing?"
I asked Nyx and Myrkhal for confirmation without removing my gaze from the system info, because everyone knows one thing or the whole of Valtharion.
That only one being who can do this, and now here my system is doing the same thing.
"Yes!" Nyx said with a normal voice, as this reward is just okay, while Myrkhal still nodded with his smiling mouth.
"System, you are the best buddy!" I start laughing and praise the system more and more because it has given me this.
[1 random E rank Origin skill awakening fruit x100.]
[Luke, this fruit will not work on you, so just chill.]
As I was thinking about unlocking many abilities with this fruit, the system, like every system, poured water on my dreams.
Then with an expected look, I asked him a question.
"So, this fruit also can be used one time by a person, right, Mr. System?"
System screen glitch, then suddenly a old Sage’s voice coming.
[Luke, you have finally grown up; I really did not waste my time on you.]
I ignored his shameless behavior, but then he added another line, which soured my mood more.
[Though it can only be used by Bronze rank and below.]
I froze for a moment, because doesn’t this mean? I can’t give to Aurora?.
The system saw my confusion and gave me a long explanation.

[Luke, if she were bronze rank, she could take it, but if the person already has a higher rank origin skill, then it will only give them an additional origin skill related to their existing origin and not affect their cultivation talent.]
I nodded with a slightly regretful face.
"But it’s still ok."
With that, I finally dried the water on my face with the towel, then moved back toward the bed.
Aurielle had already awoken and was now looking outside at the passing pedestrians and carts.
But as I took a step forward, I froze in place.
Because I noticed her deep purple eyes gazing outside while sunlight from the window shone through her hair, making her so beautiful that I couldn’t take my eyes off her.
Sensing my gaze, Aurielle slowly turns her face toward me, but after a moment she returns back her gaze toward the window.
"She stills seems angry."
Nyx came close to my ear and said.
I got confused. How do they know? Because all the time, they were sleeping inside me.
Nyx, seeing my confusion, told me that when only they are sleeping, they can’t hear or see what’s happening outside, but at normal times, they are just resting inside me.
"So, now I become some kind of house?" I muttered absentmindedly, at which Nyx and Myrkhal both gave me an amused look and then left the room so I could talk to her alone.
"Honey, good morning."
I moved toward her and spoke with a loving voice while smiling, but she didn’t reply; she just kept looking outside.
"Sigh.
I sighed slightly at this and came closer to her before sitting beside her.
"I am sorry if my words hurt you." I reached toward her hand and interlocked my fingers with hers as I said with a sad voice.
She still remained silent, so I stepped closer, wrapped my arms around her waist from behind and rested my head on her shoulder, then followed her gaze toward the passing pedestrians.
Aurielle’s body trembled slightly on my sudden hug, but she still didn’t look at me.
"So, you are not going to forgive your handsome husband?" Her mouth twitched slightly on the mention of her handsome husband.
I noticed this, and a small smile appeared on my lips, and then I continued.
"How about this?" I slowly bring my face close to her cheek, on which she flinched slightly as she felt my hot breath.
Then I said in a loving voice. "A hundred kisses from a handsome husband." With that, I kissed her again and again.
"No need." But after some kisses, she brings her hands to stop my face and says this, though her face is still upset.
