paragraphs: "Here, try this."
Soon a small rainbow colored fruit appeared in my hands, which looks like a small peach.
Though, this time Aurielle didn’t ask me anything; instead, she picked the fruit from my hand and gave me a curious look.
I smiled and told her the effect of this fruit, and the next moment her reaction was what I had expected.
"This is crazy, Luke!"
She exclaimed and tried to put the fruit back into my hand, which makes me confused.
Aurielle didn’t saw my confused look; instead, she said excitedly.
"Luke, I have heard about this fruit and even saw it in the auction hall."
I nodded, and she continued with a smiling face.
"This fruit can also give talent to the person, according to its rank, if they are consuming it for the first time."
"Ok, and?"
Her smile got reduced a little, and she gave me an irritated look.
"You should take this to awaken the cultivation talent instead of wasting it on me!"
She finally said the sentence, which I have felt she was about to say.
But I just shook my head and gave it back to her.
She looked confusedly and asked me why I was not eating it.
"Honey, I have already eaten it, and this one is for you."
Her pupils widen, because this type of fruit, depending upon its rank, can be sold at different prices.
Even the lowest rank can be sold for thousands of gold, and now my husband is saying he has two.
But after the moment, she shook her head and brought the food to her mouth because she had already guessed.
"Definitely that goddess."
I watched Aurielle curiously, wondering which change will occur after she consumes the fruit.
I waited a few minutes but found nothing happened; only Aurielle’s eyes became blank.
"This is a normal process, Luke."
Nyx from the side told me as he also observed her blank eyes and then said, "Just wait, and it will be over soon."
After waiting for five minutes, finally Aurielle’s purple eyes returned back to normal, and she smiled lovely and suddenly kissed me with burning intensity
"Mhmmmmm."
I tried to say something, like which ability she awakened, but she didn’t stop or separate, only kissing me with overwhelming desire while hugging my body tightly.
"Huff... huffff..."
Finally, she separated after a few minutes, and my breathing got rough this time.
Then slowly I raised my gaze toward her, and there she licked her lips, like she tasted something delicious, but then she paused and her eyes narrowed.
"Darling, why do your lips taste something like my lipstick?"
She asked me while coming close with a smile on her face.
"Damn it!"
I got shivers seeing her devilous smile and curse.
Because it seems like I didn’t wash my mouth properly, and when I kissed her in the morning, that lipstick flavor was left on my lips.
"I don’t know what you are saying."
I tried to look at her eyes while saying little loudly with the expression.
"Don’t frame your innocent husband."
"Ahh, it seems like my cutie boy likes to kiss his wife in her sleep!"
But she didn’t buy it and instead said with a teasing voice; then she came close to me and whispered in my ear.
"I didn’t get anything special, only a shadow cloak ability.
"What?"
I got confused and held her waist in a hug, then asked back, "Why?"
She shook her head.
"It seems like a lower rank, fruit, and my talent is high level, so it’s natural."
As she talks more, I understand something.
"So, it depends on talent rank as well."
After that she told me it was not all waste, as normally a person with origin skills can learn new skills related to their origin, but the time it takes varies depending on talent.
"So it’s saved my 2-3 years of work."
She smiled as she again gave me a small peck on my lips.
I nodded and brought out the Queen Eclipse armor set and showed her while holding it in my hand.
"Won’t you look at this?" She got surprised by seeing another gift and asked me confusedly back.
"Why are you giving so many gifts to me today?"
After hearing her confusing voice, I leaned forward slightly and whispered in a romantic voice.
"So you will not get angry if I go more rougher today."
Her ear suddenly turned red on this, and she pushed me away before taking the armor in her hand.
As she was observing this armor, I said with a smug expression.
"This is a special queen armor set, which can only be worn by the most beautiful queen."
Aurielle turned towards me and gave me a speechless look as I was faking it too much.
"Really, the goddess of luck told me this personally; after all, this is not normal armor."
[0-0, When did I?]
I ignored the system’s mocking words, but Aurielle’s face changed slightly at the mention of the Goddess of Luck, but fortunately she didn’t react this time.
"What’s so special about this armor?" she finally asked me, to which I nodded and told everything about its ability and its power.
I saw, in the start, Aurielle’s face did become interested, but as she heard more and more, her face became shocked, and then finally she freaked out.
"Luke, this is insane. "I nodded. Yeah, this armor is insane.
"Who cares?" I hold her shoulder to calm down, then bring my hand to caress her cheek.
"For me, you are the most beautiful queen, so if you don’t wear this, then who will?"
A small blush appeared on her face as I again started talking so romantically.
"You are really being so romantic today." She said while standing up and asked me how to wear this.
On this I asked the system.
[Just let her drop blood on this, and after that, with a thought, she can summon this armor fully or partially.]
I nodded at System Word, but he added one more word.
[But remember, she can use the ability of this armor only when the full armor set is summoned.]
Soon, I told her how to bind and about the ability to use conditions.
"Ok, I am doing it." She finished her sentence and summoned her purple sword, then made a small wound on her hand.
WHOOSHH.
Aether flow increased as her blood made contact with the armor, and then it started glowing but in a dark color.
The silver lining on it lit up and shone brightly, which nearly blinded both of us if we had not closed our eyes instantly.
Fortunately, it’s morning, and no one noticed that a bright silver light is coming outside from the third floor of the inn room.
As the light slowly reduced, I heard the armor connecting together.
CLICK CLANK.
Then finally saw that a black-violet armor began forming around Aurielle’s body piece by piece.
Elegant silver edged plates covered her arms and shoulders, each engraved with intricate runes that glowed faintly beneath the surface.
The chest armor was looking both regal and imposing; it was crafted so perfectly that it could protect her without sacrificing the graceful appearance expected of a queen.

Below her breast, layers of dark metallic plates wrapped perfectly around her waist and hips, showing her figure to its fullest while a long black cloak flowed behind her like a curtain of living shadows.
Her raven black hair spilled freely down her back, contrasting sharply against the dark armor.
Then a crown-shaped diadem forged from black silver rested upon her head, enhancing the natural nobility in her features.
And beneath it, her violet eyes shone with loving light as she looked at me.
I smiled at her, then looked down toward her legs. There, black greaves engraved with violet crystal patterns protected her legs, while razor-edged gauntlets covered her hands.
"If someone says they have seen the most beautiful women in this world, then it should be only my wife, or else I will beat them until they agree."
I said while smiling at her.
"You sure have learned how to praise your wife more and more." Aurielle comes close to me as she teases me.
But my gaze moved toward her hips, which sway like a seductive swan, that are inviting me to claim them.
"Honey, does this armor feel ok?" I asked her as I brought my hand towards her back and slowly touched her bottom armor.
She got confused by this question, but she still said, "Yeah."
But then she felt a hand rubbing her lower back; her face turned red as Luke was not only rubbing it but also pinching it.
"Honey, this armor is so soft~"
I lost in those soft feelings as my hands melted in them, but then I heard Aurielle’s speechless voice.
"Because that’s not my armor."
I froze in my place after seeing her reaction, then lowered my gaze toward her back, and my face became red.
Because I didn’t know when, but my hands had slipped under armor and it was kneading her bare ass.

"Shameless." But then I heard Aurielle’s voice, on which the smile returned back to my face, and I brought my face close to her ear and bite it, while my one hand continued its previous job, which shouldn’t have stopped.
"Ahh." I heard her small moan, and I got even more excited, so I whispered this into her ear.
"Honey, I can’t control it anymore."
"Wait!" I heard her panicked voice, but I didn’t care; instead, I brought her to bed, then removed her lower armor.
"Ahh, Luke, it’s morning, and we have a function to attend this afternoon."
I heard Aurielle’s panicked voice again, which contained shame also, but my focus was only on her sacred region, because it was already wet.
"Honey, you are so wet already, and you say I am shameless."
I teased her, and her face got so red that she brought her hands to cover it.
A big grin appeared on my face, and then I unzip my pants and bring out my little brother.
"No mercy for naughty girl," I said to her, and with a forceful thrust, I entered inside her sacred region.
"Ahhh!!"
Soon 1 hour finished as I was not able to control myself and cummed inside her more than a few times.
"If that cat woman comes to clean this, then what will she think?"
Aurielle gives me an annoyed look while standing up weakly as white liquid drops from her lowered region and half the places on the bed are also messed up.
I rub my hair embarrassingly and say it. "I am sure we are not the first one who does this type of thing here."
Aurielle shot me an even more annoyed look and finally stood up completely while heading toward the room with tub water.
But I can see her bare ass moved so seductively, like another invitation is there to visit.
"Damn, she is too hot, even more in this armor."
I shook my head in regret, as I am not able to enjoy her to the fullest; then I saw that I am messed up as well, so I hurriedly move to the tub room as well.
"Wait!!! Luke, we can’t, LUKE!"
Sadly, I wasn’t able to resist her charm and wasted another half an hour before we got fully dressed.
"My lord and my lady, should I come in?"

We heard Margaret’s voice from the outside, at which Aurielle glared at me, so I nodded and cleaned all the bedsheets by myself as Aurielle met Margaret outside and started preparing for the function.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 61: The Princess Who Stole the Hall
paragraphs: "My lord and my lady, should I come in?"
I heard Margaret’s voice from the outside, on which Aurielle glared at me, so I nodded and cleaned all the bedsheets by myself as Aurielle met Margaret and started preparing for the function.
After everyone got ready, we got down; there, all the twenty bronze knights were already fully armoured and standing near the carriage as Kai was in the lead.
"Master!"
Everyone shouted the moment we got close.
I nodded at them and entered the carriage together with Aurielle.
Surrounding people also noticed this, as nobles don’t come into this district, so after seeing knights and a carriage, they thought it maybe belonged to some rich merchant.
With a loud horse cry, the carriage finally starts moving toward the main district because there is Count has set up the destination for this function.

As we were travelling, I observed Aurielle, who is now wearing a royal black gown, which has a V cut toward the chest area, while the dress tightly clung to her waist and she was also wearing the black silver crown on her head.
Seeing a single piece of armour from Queen Eclipse’s set makes me confused.
"Can’t she used atleast one ability of her armour with single part?" I asked back to the system in my mind.
[No, even though she can be summoned one part but she can use the ability only when she has summoned the full armour set.]
I nodded, then also checked my appearance, which is a black suit type dress with silver lining on both shoulders.
"You look okay, Luke."
I heard Nyx voiced, who is sitting on my right shoulder while, Myrkhal on left.
I also nodded at them, then sat patiently.
After travelling for more than 10 minutes, we finally reached the central district.
Far in the distance, a colossal gate was place on the landscape and its golden bars gleaming like a symbol of wealth and power.
As sun was still high so beneath its shadow, numerous noble carriages stood parked in silence, each one bearing the marks of prestigious houses that had gathered on the sides.
Soon two guards dressed in knight armour come toward our carriage as they guide us toward the parking area.
"This way, sir."
The two guards bowed to us and showed the direction.
I nodded at them while looking around and found that we are the last ones.
But I didn’t care and gave Aurielle my shoulder; she smiled and locked her hands with mine on my shoulder, and then we started moving toward the gate.
"Sir, welcome to Stormveil County."
I nodded at them, but as we entered the gate, I soon found a few maids come to us and told that knights and maids have to attend the different party.
Aurielle nodded beside me, indicating this is what happens most of the time.
So I ordered all my knights to behave properly and take care of themselves along with Margaret.
"YES SIR!"
All of them shouted, but the attendant didn’t react much.
"Seems like they are used to a knight’s high pitched sound."
This thought occurred to me as my knights along with Margaret followed the maids, but Margaret turned towards us and gave a bright smile before following them back.
"Shall we then, honey~?"
As they left, I leant toward Aurielle and said in a playful voice.
"Are you still not satisfied?"
Her eye twitches because I have literally not let her rest from the moment we awoke.
A large grin appeared on my face after seeing her reaction, which for me looks cute.
"It’s your fault for being so beautiful~"
I said playfully those words before we started moving toward the main entrance, which was heavily decorated.
Large red and white flowers were arranged perfectly along both sides of the path, while a long red carpet stretched across the ground.
The rich scent of some expensive agarwood filled the air, spreading throughout the entrance and creating an atmosphere of elegance and luxury.
Maids holding flower baskets stood on both sides of the path, their heads lowered respectfully as they waited in silence.
As we stepped onto the red carpet, the maids began scattering flowers along our path.
We did not stop, continuing forward at a slow and steady pace as the petals fell around us.
As we reached the front gate of the mansion, two guards bowed toward us and then, with a gentle pull, opened the gate.
The moment the gate opened, everyone inside, who were enjoying their food or drinks while talking or discussing, stopped and turned their gaze toward the gate with thoughts.
"Who will be this late?"
Soon they found their answer as the standing guards shouted the name of the entering guest.
"LORD OF THE BLACKSTONE HIGHLANDS!"
"HERO OF THE GODDESS OF LIGHT!"
"BARON LUKE VOIDHEART!"
"He is here along with his wife!
"THE DAUGHTER OF HUMAN EMPEROR!"
"BARONESS AURIELLE VALMONT!"
Everyone’s attention turned toward the entrance as a couple walked into the hall hand in hand, appearing the moment the guards finished their introduction.
"Is this the exile princess?"
"She looks so beautiful."
Many noblemen were captivated by Aurielle’s appearance as she entered the hall.
She wore a black royal gown with exposed shoulders, while a silver black crown rested upon her head, perfectly complementing her beauty and giving her an elegant presence.
Almost everyone forgot about the man beside her, as it’s not necessary at all.
Many noble women got jealous of this, as their husband or their love interest was now staring hard at the exile princess.
"But still she got married to that talentless man, and now her future has already been ruined because of it."
They told themselves these words and other women as well, which finally reduced their jealousy somewhat.
"It seems like you have become the star of this party."
Luke leaned toward Aurielle as he whispered those words into her ears.
"Damn it, this is too much. Stay away from her, you scum."
Many men, seeing how that talentless hero is getting lovey dovey with Aurielle, become so jealous that they curse Luke in a low voice.
Aurielle didn’t care about the other man’s reaction, as she just smiled slightly at his voice and got closer to Luke’s shoulder.
Finally, the guards shut the gate down, and both of them reached toward one corner before observing everyone.
Luke has already heard that most of the people coming today are the younger generation.
Like, almost all barons under Stormveil County or near it, if they got the invitation, did come here.
But for viscounts and counts, they send their representative only, like their child.
After a moment Luke saw an acquaintance, the Baron Cedric, whose light black hair was combed perfectly this time, and he was smiling while talking to the person in the middle.
Then he noticed that there were two more people beside Cedric, who was drinking calmly, and one of them he had already met.
"Oryn."
[Chapter End]

"Oryn."
Luke muttered in a low voice, and from the side, Aurielle heard his voice and also followed his gaze.

"Darling, calm down."
Aurielle’s expression also changed when she noticed Luke’s anger, but she still spoke gently to him while he continued glaring at Oryn.
Oryn noticed Luke entering the hall but chose to ignore him.
However, when he suddenly felt an intense gaze upon him, he turned around and found Luke staring at him with an angry expression.
Oryn calmly looked back at him because he didn’t take this talentless hero seriously at all and already had planned to make him a cripple.
Rowan and Cedric also noticed Oryn’s gaze and followed his line of sight.
There, they saw the couple who had just entered the hall, both of them looking toward Oryn with an intense and angry glare.

"She looks hotter than before."

"Baron Cedric, keep your filthy eyes from her, or else I will help you in removing them."

"Calm down, Rowan."
Oryn saw the situation getting worse and intervened.
"Hmph."
On this Rowan just hmph and calmed down somewhat and bring his drink to his mouth while looking at Aurielle, who was now telling something to Luke.
"My stupid brother is finally gone, and now she is clinging to that waste?"
Rowan muttered angrily as he watched how they were being lovey dovey.
Oryn heard him and smiled, thinking that he could use Rowan to deal with this waste hero.
"I can understand you, Rowan."
He placed his hand on Rowan’s shoulder as he try to calmed him down, and then he continued.
"I know, because of your stupid big brother, you haven’t been able to express your love to the princess ever before.
"But—"
He paused slightly and thought about the info he had gathered about Rowan.
"A talented person, but because he was the third son, he didn’t get enough attention and also stopped chasing Aurielle when Roland started pursuing her."
He smiled at the Rowan and said to him in a slightly tempting voice.
"Now, your big brother is gone; that’s your best chance."
Rowan paused slightly on this and turned to look toward Oryn, who is one of the sea prince.

"I am pretty sure that she would have already found out that this hero is totally useless, and if now you go and propose to her, then she will definitely say yes."
Rowan heard Oryn’s words completely and understood what he was trying to do.
Even though he was not foolish enough to blindly trust him, a thought still crossed his mind.
"That’s what the worst can happen?"
He turned back his gaze toward Luke, who is now also looking at him, and thought about the info he has gotten.
"A talentless hero who can’t cultivate and stopped at the first stage of the knight realm but has some kind of special ability or items that let him transform into some kind of giant form."
"But he is still an Iron Knight, and I am a peak Bronze Knight."
A sly smile appeared on his face as he compared his strength to Luke’s.
Aurielle told Luke that the brown haired man with light black eyes is Rowan Ashenford and the youngest son of the Ashenford family.
"He tried to pursue me when I was in the academy which bring me many troubles."
"But suddenly he stopped all of this as Roland started pursuing me."
Luke heard Aurielle’s angry voice, and then he looked toward the Rowan, who was also looking at him.
But when Rowan smiled, Luke became angry that if fighting was not allowed here, he would love to beat that bastard’s face and break all his teeth so he couldn’t smile anymore.
"Huffff..."
Luke took a deep breath to calm down his anger and turn toward Aurielle with a smile.
"Don’t worry, honey, your husband is here, and from now on, if anyone has bad thoughts about you, then they can forget about standing on their legs again."
Aurielle brought her hand to cover her mouth as a soft laugh escaped her.
Then, she leaned slightly toward him and whispered into his ear.
"Ohh my~, how manly my man has become~"
With that, she gave a small peck on his cheek, on this Luke’s face became a little red.
"How is it that she can always tease me and catch me off guard?"
Luke thought as he coughed to hide his embarrassment.
Other men who were returned back to their discussion after Luke’s and Aurielle’s late entrance.
But they still divided some of their attention toward Aurielle, so when they saw that she gave a kiss to that waste hero, they gritted their teeth in jealousy.
"Bastard!"
Rowan cursed as the wine glass in his hand shattered.
As every’s men mood starts becoming worse because of Aurielle’s actions.
STEP
STEP
STEP
All of them heard the sound of boots clicking against the floor, as if someone had stepped forward. They immediately turned their gazes toward the stairs.
"Count Magnus Duvall!"
A wave of excitement spread through the hall as the Count finally appeared. Everyone looked toward him, finally getting the chance to witness the presence of this legendary figure.
Luke also observed the Count.
The Count seems to have a height of 6.1 feet, and his body appears to be muscular, but he doesn’t look bulkier; instead, all the muscles are compressed to the extreme.
So if someone saw him for the first time, they might think he is lean built.
Then his hair is dark ash black, which is naturally kept, but in some places it is uneven.
And finally, his light silver eyes, with storm shades in them.
Overall his face looked mature but without any sign of old age.
He walked forward with an upright posture, carrying himself with natural authority.
His black and white noble attire had only a few golden linings, showing that he was not someone who favored excessive luxury or unnecessary extravagance.
Then beside him was the Countess Vivienne Duvall.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 63: The Arrival of the Imperial Siblings
paragraphs: Then beside him was the Countess Vivienne Duvall.
The Countess was still beautiful even in her thirties, even after becoming the mother of three children.
She have a height of 5.8 feet and long silver blonde hair that was neatly maintained.
Then her eyes were violet grey in color, and her face had a gentle expression as she smiled at everyone.
She was wearing a violet, noble dress with jewelry embedded in many places.
After reaching down, they stopped and looked at everyone, then with a smile The countess said to everyone.
"Thank you so much for coming here and being a part of our youngest daughter Nyra Duvall’s 20th birthday."
Everyone smiled at the countess’s words and raised their glasses high in the sky, and we also followed suit.
Seeing everyone appreciating her words, The countess, with a smile, turned back toward the stairs and said.
"Now let’s welcome our children along with special guests."
The Count Magnus just stood silent beside Countess all the time, who doesn’t seem to like having much of a talkative personality.

When everyone heard the countess’s words, they got surprised because they knew that the sea king’s daughter and son had come, but only one was standing here. Then the other one was only a single person, so why was she saying guests?.
But soon everyone got their answer.
Six figures, two men and four women, appeared at the high end of the stairs and came down with normal expressions, while some smiled at everyone.
"What? Why are they here?"
Suddenly Aurielle’s body starts trembling as her hold on Luke tightens.
Luke was observing the six figures who had become the center of attention, including the children of House Duvall, when he suddenly stopped.
He felt Aurielle’s hands trembling slightly as her grip around his arm tightened.
"What’s happened?"
Luke asked her while trying to calm her down, but the next moment he heard the people’s shocked voices and then also turned toward the stairs.
"His highness Therion Valmont and her highness Lysandra Valmont!
There, in the center, he saw a beautiful young woman wearing blue violet noble attire that matched the color of her eyes.
Her long dark silver hair flowed naturally with every step she took, but upon observing closely, he noticed that the ends of her hair carried a faint bluish sheen.
Then on her right side were two women.
The first one was wearing brown colored noble attire and had moonlit blue eyes.
Her long hair was dark brown with a faint bluish tint on its end that also flowed gracefully with each step.
Then the last woman on the right side is Naivara Tidewhisper, my wife.
She was wearing a different dress this time, as it was a dark blue with silver lining noble dress, and each step she took, her long oceancolored hair also swayed gracefully.
Then I turned my gaze toward her left side and found two men and one women
The first one is 6 feet tall and has green grey eyes as he walks calmly in his white and green noble attire.
Then, the next person who caught his attention seemed to be Therion Valmont, as everyone’s gaze was directed toward him and the woman standing beside him.
He has bright golden hair and black eyes, but he moves with an indifferent expression, like he doesn’t care about anyone.
And was forcefully sent here.
But the woman beside him was stepping down excitedly, and her face was full of a smile that will make everyone think of her as a sweet and cheerful woman.
Her long hair was also bright golden, but her eyes were deep amber colored.
Her dress looks ridiculously expensive, as it was embedded with many rubies, which shine with each step she takes.
"Aurielle is it because of them?"
Luke asked Aurielle in a low voice because all three of them share the same surname, which means they are her relatives.
Aurielle, who was trembling while looking at the ember eyed women, turned to look toward her husband when she heard his question and with weak movement; she nodded.
Luke got confused as to why she would be that afraid of her, but he didn’t dwell on it and thought, Maybe something happened in the past.
Then he brought his left hand to her shoulder and pulled her into a gentle half hug.
"I am here."
He only said this, but it’s somewhat calmed her down.
As everyone was busy looking at the prince and princess, no one noticed Aurielle’s reaction other than two people.
Naivara’s mood was off because of the previous incident and her outbreak.
So from that time, she shut herself inside her room and didn’t come out even after Nyra and Octavia called her.
She only came out today because it is her friend’s birthday party, and she doesn’t want to spoil it.
But when she reached the stairs, she found that the other two important guests also came, who were the imperial prince and princess.
Though she didn’t care about much them.
Then with Elias, who is the count’s only son, and Octavia, who is the count’s eldest daughter, along with Nyra, they come down.
But soon, she heard everyone’s shocked voices.

She have a height of 5.8 feet and long silver blonde hair that was neatly maintained.

She was wearing a violet, noble dress with jewelry embedded in many places.
After reaching down, they stopped and looked at everyone, then with a smile The countess said to everyone.
"Thank you so much for coming here and being a part of our youngest daughter Nyra Duvall’s 20th birthday."

The Count Magnus just stood silent beside Countess all the time, who doesn’t seem to like having much of a talkative personality.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: A Treasure From the Sea Empire
paragraphs: But when she heard that the hero is talentless, she sighed in relief.
And now she is meeting one of the wives of that talentless hero here, which is a bit interesting, because this brings her the memories of her little step sister, and she muttered in a very low voice.
"Where would she be?"
But the next moment her face became cheerful because down below, there she saw her, and she was clinging to some men who have black hair and blue eyes and are 6 feet tall.
"Is this the hero? Her husband?"
She thought while looking toward them, then a thought came into her mind: he is just average, not very handsome or cute.
"We greet your highness!!!"
Everyone immediately placed a hand over their chest and bowed in the noble etiquette of greeting, their voices echoing loudly throughout the hall.
As I watched everyone perform the greeting, I also moved my hand toward my chest to follow, but Aurielle quickly stopped me and spoke.
"You are a hero, so you are not bound to any emperor."
I nodded and lowered my hands, then I noticed, that my wife Naivara and Count family also didn’t greet them.
"Seems like they have done it before."
This thought crossed my mind as I watched the Countess walk toward Nyra and gently take her hand.

Moments later, the Count’s family, along with the Imperial Prince, Princess, and Naivara, moved toward one side of the hall, where an highly decorative chair resembling a small throne had been prepared for them.
Every chair was placed in an equal line, so the moment they sat down, everyone felt that they were being treated as equals.
But still in the center Count himself settled, while his right side contains womens while his left side contains mens.
But still one sit was left toward men side and everyone got confused, but soon all of their gaze turn toward one person.
Oryn saw everyone’s gaze come on him, so he gritted his teeth and moved toward the left side chair without looking toward Naivara, as he was still afraid she would freak out.
Soon, everyone settled down, and the Count’s heavy voice filled with authority and pressure echoed through the hall.
"Begin."
Then side gates opened as many maids with trays containing luxurious food and wines and delicacies came into the hall one by one.
After filling every food and placing the new food, all the maids returned, and the real celebration finally started.
"Congratulations, Lady Nyra Duvall, for your 20th birthday."
A young man who is the son of some count comes toward Nyra’s seat and congratulates her.
"You have become even more beautiful than the last time I saw you."
He kept showering her with praises, causing Nyra to smile in amusement. However, the others could only look toward the men with impatient expressions, waiting for the real purpose of their visit.
"You can continue praising her later. Show your gifts first, and then we will judge whether your sweet words hold any truth."
"Here is a ruby that can only be found in the Beast Empire, and it is highly appreciated by beautiful ladies."
Soon everyone saw that the young man brought out a small wooden box that contained a shiny green ruby.
"Thank you for your gift Sir Crater."
Nyra smiled and gave him a reply before waving her hand.
Soon, a female knight standing below the stairs approached him.
Since all the chairs were placed on a raised platform, Nyra didn’t come down by herself.
The female knight took the gift and carefully placed it on the large table to the left side.
The Count and the others’ expressions did not change at all after seeing the gift the young man presented.
However, the young man still maintained his smile and returned to his group.
Then more and more people come and congratulate Nyra while giving gifts, which are mostly wearable or decoration objects.
But all the people who comed were related to count somehow like, some were their children while some were their brother or sister.
But then Oryn, who was sitting and waiting patiently, stood up after seeing all the count relatives are done.
Everyone gaze turn toward the sea prince and looked at him, with curious eyes that were clearly asking.
"What special gift are you going to give?"
Nyra had been maintaining her smile throughout the greetings of the arriving guests, but she finally got a brief moment to relax.
However, her relief did not last long, as the Sea Prince soon approached her.
Oryan was not married, but he has tasted many women and often doesn’t let any beautiful women of his age go, if his eyes land on them.
But this time, he has to control his desire, as the person in question is the daughter of Magnus Duvall.
A legendary figure, who is an apostle of the Storm Temple and holds a little bit of authority to move the Templar Knights.
And his strength is also formidable; that’s why their father sent them here, as they also have an old relationship.

Because when the demon attacked the island where Naiavara was, at that time this same legendary figure rescued both Naiavara and her mother, which is why the sea king always wants to maintain a peaceful relationship with him.
"Lady Nyra, here is a specialty of our sea empire, which is very hard to find, but I have brought it out for you."
Everyone got more curious when they heard his claim that the things are rare even in the sea empire for a prince.
Nyra also smiled and became a little expectant, while the others seated beside her looked toward Oryn with curious expressions.
Seeing the mood is set, he brings out an ocean clam and slowly opens it in front of her.
Soon a brightening moonlight appeared, but it didn’t blind anyone; instead, everyone who saw this felt their mind become somewhat calm.
Then everyone saw that the moment the calm shell fully opened, a small pearl appeared in it, which was emitting this moonlight.
Oryn smiled when he noticed the pleased expression on Nyra’s face after seeing the gift.
The others seated beside her also looked intrigued, finding the treasure interesting.
Only Naivara looked normal, because she had seen an even bigger pearl in the palace.
"Lady Nyra, this beautiful gift named Serenity Pearl and it has a mind soothing light."
Oryan said with smug expression while presenting forward, on which this time, Nyra personally comes down and takes it.
"Thank you, Prince Oryan."
With a smile she thanked him, and then returned back to her seat, while Oryn, more happily than before, also returned back to his seat.
Then exclamations explode.
"Wow, I have heard about this pearl, as it was so costly that only high level people had the capacity to buy it."
Everyone starts discussing excitedly because they know they have another tale to share.
Countness also smiled happily at this.
Luke also became intrigued, as this was the first time he had seen an item with such an effect.
Meanwhile, Aurielle, who was beside him, was still leaning against his shoulder while holding onto him tightly.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 65: The Count’s Mysterious Present
paragraphs: Then Prince Therion also stepped forward and presented her with an Arcane grade sword, causing the crowd to erupt in excitement once again.
Because only viscounts and above were able to afford this grade of sword, as many barons are still living with only enchanted grade swords.
"Ah, if only I could get my hands on an Arcane grade sword..."
"Do you know? The last Arcane grade dagger that appeared on the Capital Auction hall was sold for 20,000 gold coins."
Count Magnus and Elias also examined the sword, and after a brief look, they found it satisfactory.
Because Elias also has an arcane grade sword, which his father gifted him on his 18th birthday.
The Countess smiled brightly at the gift, while Octavia only gave a slight nod toward it, as she was not particularly impressed.
"Thank you, Your Highness."
Nyra properly thanked him, to which he nodded with the same boring expression and returned back to his seat.
But this time Nyra didn’t return back toward her seats, as the imperial princess was already moving toward her.
"You have grown so much, little Nyra~"
Lysandra playfully pinched Nyra’s cheeks while saying in a cheerful voice, on which Nyra’s face became red.
Because whenever Lysandra visits their territory, she often does this.
The Count simply looked at everything with a calm expression, while the Countess smiled happily, already accustomed to Her Highness’s behavior.
Meanwhile, Octavia could only shake her head.
Everyone from the crowd smiled at this, but Luke just stood there and didn’t react much, and the same for Aurielle as well.
"Here, the present for my little sis."
Lysandra presents the deeds paper of some mines to Nyra while saying this.
Nyra looked worriedly towards the deed paper and completely ignored the sis part.
Because the imperial princess always told Nyra to call her big sis but she didn’t dare.
But the deed paper she was holding belonged to some large mine, which is almost equal to the worth of some viscount territory.
Lysandra saw Nyra’s hesitation and said it with a normal voice.
"You have grown up, Nyra, and now you will have many things to spend money on. That is why you should take it.
Nyra got stunned by this, and finally, with a reluctant expression, she took the deeds.
The Count’s expression remained unchanged, as wealth held little importance to him. Meanwhile, the Countess only smiled warmly at Nyra.
But Oryn, from the side, saw all of this with a jealous expression.
Because he was never given much money, as there were many other princes and princesses in the Sea Empire.
So when he saw someone receive mines worth the value of a Viscount territory, he became jealous, but he quickly controlled his expression and hid it.
While Therion still didn’t care about his stepsister this move and just calmly looked at the front while waiting for this event to be over.
"Damn it, if someone donates that mine to me, I will become a viscount in a single day."
"You? Look at your face and your title, which belongs to a baron. Even if someone mistakenly gave it to you, the next day it will be gone, and you will be found dead in some gully."
Luke heard everyone’s exclamations along with their mocking voices towards each other.
Then he asked Aurielle about the worth of Viscount territory, but she answered, "It depends on their size and specialty, and still the minimum one has."
"100,000 Gold Coins."
Luke’s mouth fell silent after hearing the price, and he glanced toward the system inventory.
The 10,000 gold coins were still lying there quietly, but now he no longer felt as overwhelmingly wealthy as he did at the beginning.
After Nyra thanks the princess and she returns back toward her seat, everyone eyes turns toward the remaining seats.
On this Naivara stood up first, and with a little smile, she reached toward Nyra.
"Here."
She presented her a blue bracelet and said.
"With this you can unleash a Silver Peak attack five times."
Nyra’s eyes widened, as she knows about this type of artifact, even though its rank is not high, but only master craftsmen can make it.
"Thank you, Naivara."
She thanked her, to which Naivara only nodded before turning back toward her seat.
However, as she turned, she glanced slightly toward Luke and saw that he was still being lovey dovey with Aurielle.
"Can’t he control himself? Doesn’t he see that his wife is also here?" she thought with an irritated expression before finally sitting back in her seat.
Lysandra, who often looks toward Aurielle, also noticed Naivara’s gaze and muttered something in a low voice.
"Interesting."
Finally, Elias gave Nyra an silver rank armor, and her mother gave her a small hairpin.
Nyra kept a warm smile on her face the entire time, never allowing even the smallest sign of disrespect toward the gifts presented by her family members.
Finally, the Count stands up, and the crowd instantly becomes quiet, as everyone’s gaze turns toward him, including Luke and Aurielle.
"Father."
Nyra saw her father finally coming, which means he is going to give her something good, which he always does.
Magnus saw the smile on Nyra’s face, and also a small smile appeared on his lips for a moment before disappearing.
"This is your birthday present."
He said those words before passing her a magic scroll.
Nyra got confused after seeing this while other members of the chair also raised their brows with curiosity.
As everyone became curious, the count said something that cleared their doubts but also generated a new curiosity.
"This thing will save your life in danger."
That’s the only word he said before returning back towards their seats.
Everyone became curious and started guessing about what that magic scroll was, and so was I.
"Hey, Nyx, what is that?"
I called Nyx, who was sleeping inside me.
Nyx woke up but didn’t come outside; instead, from the inside, he replied.
"It’s a teleportation magic scroll."
With that, he returns back to sleep.
"teleportation."
I thought about those words, then nodded. Yeah, a definitely life saving item.
[Chapter End.]

"It’s a teleportation magic scroll."
With that, he returns back to sleep.
"teleportation."
I thought about those words, then nodded.
Yeah, a definitely life saving item.
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 66: They Mocked Him Until He Revealed This
paragraphs: Finally, all the high level noble and special guests are done with their gifts.
Then viscount and baron turn comes.
From the viscount, first come Rowan Ashenford, with a smile, moves to Nyra’s seat and congratulates her before presenting a beautiful dress, on which she smiled and told the female knight to take it.

After Rowan, other viscounts also present their gifts one by one, but sadly the nobles have already become numb, as they have now seen those high level gifts, which results in not a single gift making the crowd explode in excitement.
Soon Baron’s turn comes, and Baron Cedric this times moves first.
He gifted a beautifully crafted necklace embedded with a red ruby.
As the event continued, Aurielle’s condition gradually improved, and she felt much better.
She was now able to stand steadily without any trembling.
Luke asked Aurielle, "Does the noble give more than one gift?"
Aurielle got confused why he was asking this, but she nodded and told him.
"They do give, but their first gift is special and second gifts are just money and other things, which are not worth showing in front of crowd."
Luke nodded thoughtfully as he looked toward his inventory and smiled because he was going to shock everyone.
But just as last baron finished giving their gifts, crowd gaze turned toward the corner.
Yes, the place where Luke and Aurielle were standing.
Luke calmly looked at everyone and nodded to Aurielle before stepping forward toward the main platform.
"Will he shed a crocodile tear when asking money?"
"Because his territory was once a part of Stormveil County."
"Well, he will definitely be, because I have heard his territory condition is very bad and will not survive much longer if he doesn’t do anything."
As Luke was moving, surrounding people started gossiping about him and his territory.
Luke expression didn’t change much in response, but Aurielle’s face changed to anger.
Because theses bastard didn’t come to help their territory when it was needed, and now they are thinking about territory.
The seated members also heard the crowd’s gossip, causing the Count’s expression to change slightly.
He knew it was his fault for being unable to provide help in time, even after giving them his word.
Magnus also doesn’t like that situation, because when an imperial order comes along with a valid reason, they also threaten him to not intervene in royal matters.
Therion’s face didn’t change much; he just gave Luke a glance and found him weak, before turning back his gaze toward the door.
Lysandra was still smiling cheerfully, as if her face didn’t hurt while maintaining this smile.
Countess and Elias also looked toward Luke with pitying expressions, as they believed maybe he was really here to ask for help.
While Octavia just looked with normal expression without much care and Nyra still has the same smile, which she maintains toward every guest.
But only Naivara’s thoughts and emotions were in turmoil as something was forcing her emotions to grow with the chaos unfolding, but she still maintained her emotionless expression.
While Oryn just gave him a disgusted face.
Finally, Luke reached below the platform as everyone looked down toward him.
But his didn’t look first at Nyra; instead, Luke turned his face toward Naivara and looked into her eyes.
She faced his gaze without changing expression, so after a few moments he finally shifted his attention toward Nyra.
Everyone remained quiet and didn’t disturb him, as they simply thought it was his last futile attempt.
Luke brought a smile to his face and said with happy voice.
"Congratulations on your 20th birthday, Lady Nyra."
She nodded at Luke with a smile.
"When we were preparing gift for your birthday we thought, it should be memorable and helpful."
Many nobles remained silent and listened quietly, but some still mocked him.
"What can a territory without money even give? So what’s even the point of thinking those?"
Those voices sure reached toward the front as well, but Luke’s smile didn’t falter, and from the side, Oryn looked toward Luke with a mocking expression as if those words were true.
"So, here is the first gift to Lady Nyra from me and my wife along with our territory."
The moment his words ended, a small vial of black-silver liquid appeared in his hand.
"A potion?"
Everyone got confused by this and thought.
"What’s so special about this?"
Nyra and other seated members also looked curiously at the black-silver liquid inside the vial but waited for Luke to explain.
Luke smiled and told her.
"Lady Nyra, have you heard about the rank breakthrough potion?"
Nyra got confused with Luke’s question but still nodded, though on this many people already guessed where this was going and again mocked him.
"That’s it? Did he really think that Lady Nyra was going to consume his potion, whose quality will definitely be abysmal compared to what she will use in the future?
Nyra’s face also changed to awkward on this, because she was really planning to take the breakthrough potion but with less potion toxicity.
But the next moment Luke’s voice echoed through out the hall, which shut up everyone’s mouth.
"I know Lady Nyra at peak Iron Knight realm; that’s why I am presenting this breakthrough potion with zero percent potion toxicity."
A long silence appeared inside the hall as everyone’s mouth really shut up.
Only Aurielle was smiling proudly with an expression.
"That’s my man."
Even the seated members got surprised, because they know a zero percent toxin potion can be made, but it’s so costly and takes time.
Because of that, many high-level master alchemists prefer to make higher-level potions rather than waste time on this.
But the next moment they heard something even more absurd than a free toxin potion.
"And after consuming this potion, the person can not only safely make a breakthrough easily, but it can also stabilize their first realm of bronze tier instantly."
This time, everyone not only got silent, but also their mouths got fully opened, and the potion in Luke’s hand now seems like an elixir rather than a potion.
Even the Count raised his brow in surprise, as this type of potion was incredibly rare and could only be found in ancient ruins or the royal treasury.
Other seated members faces were also the same as count, but Oryn’s face becomes ugly while thinking.
"Where did this waste hero get this elixir?"
Then his gaze turned toward Aurielle, who was smiling while standing in the corner, and soon everyone’s gaze also turned toward her.
Then understanding dawned on them.
"An exiled princess is still a princess; maybe she got this from someone, and now she is presenting this as a gift."
But then a voice echoes throughout the hall, which instantly makes everyone’s expression suspicious.
"Impossible... it’s just a lie. He is definitely trying to poison Lady Nyra."
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 67: The Hero Under Suspicion
paragraphs: A few minutes earlier, when Luke brought out this potion, Rowan smiled mockingly while Cedric also laughed at him.
But when he said it was toxin-free, Rowan’s smile froze, and Cedric also stopped laughing.
The next moment, Cedric eyes narrowed as he fell into deep thought.
"His territory is so poor, then how did he get a toxin-free potion? Obtaining one requires a connection with a high-level alchemist, which should be impossible for him."
Then he turned his gaze toward Aurielle and saw her smiling proudly at Luke.
It was as if Luke was proving to everyone: "Don’t look down on us."
But then he recalled.
"Aurielle is already a bronze knight, so if this potion belonged to her, then why didn’t she use it?"
He got suspicious about this and told everything to Rowan.
Rowan, whose face has became ugly after seeing everyone shut up expression, heard Cedric’s words and also looked thoughtfully toward Luke’s potion.
But when he heard Luke next claim, he also got sure that Luke was lying, and it seems he wants to try to harm Lady Nyra.
But he got confused. "Why would he do that?"
Then Cedric from the side added his words.
"Sir, I think he already knows that Blackstone Highlands is doomed. Since your father will soon attack his territory."
"And if he doesn’t receive help, he will have no choice but to flee."
Cedric’s eyes narrowed as he looked at the vial in Luke’s hand, which seemed too suspicious.
"Also, as we have already seen, he doesn’t care about Aurielle, and he is also declared talentless."
Rowan heard Cedric’s claims, but he got impatient and gave him a glare, telling him to say it fast.
Cedric nodded and told him what he thought.
"Maybe he has already joined the demon whisper group and was planning to flee this land."
Rowan eyes become wide, as this reason seems to align with his conditon.
"And so he got one task to prove his loyalty, and that is to poison Lady Nyra."
Cedric finally said the last word while looking at the vial Luke was holding.
"What’s a monster!"
Rowan gritted his teeth because Aurielle is married to this beast, and now he will run away, and Aurielle will be sentenced to death because of his treason.
Cedric also noticed Rowan’s angry expression, so he suggested the idea.
"Sir, why don’t you expose him?"
Rowan paused at Cedric’s words and lost in thought; "he is right."
"Sir, just think, if you reveal his true face, then Lady Aurielle will definitely fall for you, and if there is a chance, then Lady Nyra will also fall in love with you for saving her life.
The more Rowan heard Cedric’s words, the more excited he became, and thought.
"Yeah, both of them will be mine."
With that, he took a step forward and shouted.
"It’s impossible..."
"He is lying. His real intention is to poison Lady Nyra."
The moment his loud voice echoed, everyone present in the hall, from the female knights to the seated members, turned toward him.
Rowan didn’t flinch; instead, he said loudly.
"Think, everyone; all of us know he is poor and his territory as well."
Everyone nodded as seated members just listened quietly, while Luke’s face became irritated.
Even though he was poor, "did he really need to shout and remind him of it again?"
Rowan looked toward the vial in Luke’s hand and said.
"As far as I know, Lady Aurielle is already a bronze knight."
On this everyone turned toward Aurielle, whose face became baffled as she muttered.
"Why do all of them, in every turn, like to bring their gaze toward this corner position?"
Rowan didn’t notice Aurielle’s baffled face; instead, he continued.
"So, just think, how did he get that potion, which he claims is almost equal to the elixir?"
Everyone’s eyes narrowed as they started feeling suspicious, and their facial expressions became like this.
"From where did he get this potion?"
Rowan nodded as he finally pulled everyone’s attention towards him, so he finally said the last word.
"So, I will request everyone to check his potion to see if it is poisoned or not."
On this everyone nodded, as seated members faces also changed.
Oryn smiled on Rowan words, that this waste was finally going to be exposed because he was also confused:
"How is he able to get something that can only be acquired by kings or queens or high-level beings?"
Count’s eyes changed as he thought, "Is this really true?"
Elias’s eyes narrowed dangerously as all the pitying feelings he felt earlier toward them were now gone; instead, he thought.
"If this is really true, then even if he is a hero, I am not leaving him."
While Vivienne’s face becomes worried about her daughter.
Therion, who was thinking, When will this be over?, finally felt little interest toward this ongoing drama.
Naivara’s face changed little this time, and she got worried while thinking.
"Does he really do that?"
From the side, Octavia’s eyes narrowed dangerously, while Nyra’s face turned pale at the thought of ingesting poison.
Luke, who has now become the center of everyone’s gaze, has an even more baffled expression.
"Why, I am getting so many stares today."
When he was in the middle of his thoughts, a voice came from the seated member, which instantly made everyone calm down.
"Then, let’s check it."
Lysandra, who was smiling all the time as she heard everyone’s voices, finally said this.
Count from the side also nodded, and then after a moment a small gate from the side opened and two people in alchemist robes appeared.
"My lord."
They greeted everyone, and with Luke’s nod, they took his vial.
Everyone looked focused toward the process, waiting for the result, while Rowan and Cedric smiled smugly like they had already decided him guilty.
The alchemist took out a small drop and checked under some instrument, which was glowing with different lights.
And finally, after a few moments, they told the result.
"My lord, this potion is the same as a normal breakthrough potion, but it has been refined to a degree where the medicinal materials blend perfectly. That alone is a miracle."
The count nodded, and other members as well, and they waited for them to finish.
"But We did find something extra in it."
The moment those words left, everyone faces changed, as Rowan and Cedric smile even got bigger, while Rowan start thinking about his harem life, that he will going to start from now on.
But the next moment, those dreams shattered before they could even properly form.
"And this material seems to be the reason it can stabilize the next realm instantly."
Everyone’s face changed again and became confused.
"Is there any poison in it?"
Finally, a voice came from the crowd, at which the alchemist shook their head and said.
"We didn’t find anything that is poison at all."
With that, Nyra’s face finally became relaxed, and Naivara also sighed in relief before returning back to her emotionless expression.
Meanwhile, Aurielle’s expression didn’t change much, as Luke had already used this potion in their territory.
All the seated members also calm down, but then they heard another shout.
"This is impossible, as he doesn’t have anything to get this elixir; then where does it come from?!"
"Unless he is colliding with demon whisper!"
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 68: When the Accuser Fell Silent
paragraphs: "This is impossible, as he don’t have any money or connections to get this elixir; then where does it come from?"
Rowan shouted at Luke, then raised his finger at him and added another word.
"Unless he is colliding with demon whisper."
The entire hall fell silent, as this was far too serious an allegation.
Luke heard every word Rowan said, but the those last words enter his ear, which were clearly a lie, he snapped.
With a swift motion, he turned toward him and said in a slightly loud but angry voice.
"Sir, Rowan Ashenford!"
Everyone’s attention shifted toward Luke’s angry voice, while Nyra grew worried because this was her birthday party, and someone was now accusing a hero himself of colluding with demons.
The moment Luke turned, Rowan and his eyes met, and then Luke raised his angry voice.
"I don’t know. What’s your problem with me?"
Luke paused on this and slowly looked around at everyone’s expressions, and clearly some of them were looking at him suspicion.
As there face was saying. "Like, how can a discarded hero without any support be able to get this?"
Then Luke slowly turned his gaze toward one corner, where his eyes met the only person looking at him with nothing but love and worry.
He can see her hands were trembling, as she doesn’t like the situation where her husband is treated like a traitor.
He moved his lips slightly, which makes Aurielle’s expression calmer somewhat.
"I’ll be fine... so don’t worry about me."
With that, he shifted his attention back toward Rowan and everyone, then shouted.
"I am a hero, summoned by the goddess of light herself!"
Then he raised his hand and pointed his finger toward Rowan and continued.
"Are you doubting that the person chosen by the goddess herself will collide with demons??"
Rowan heard Luke’s words and got nervous, because he doesn’t dare.
But Luke continues.
"If you don’t have any evidence, then please!, Sir Rowan!, stop making false allegations on other people’s!"
As Luke words finished which bring back the surrounding noble back to their senses and all of them thought.
"All summoned heroes have to fight demons, and the Goddess of Light is their natural bane. So how could the person she summoned ever collude with demons?"
Rowan also calmed down and regretted his words, realizing that he had said too much in anger.
Because of this now everyone was looking at him like he was the real guilty one.
Even seated members looked toward him with dissatisfaction, which brings sweat to his forehead.
But he still raised his voice, as there is still one main thing missing.
"But it still doesn’t answer: Where did you get that elixir?"
His voice sounded low this time, but he still made himself calm down because Luke will definitely not have an answer to this.
Luke narrowed his eyes as everyone’s attention again shifted back to him, though not with suspicion but with curiosity.
"Like, tell us your secrets, ohhh talentless hero."
Princess Lysandra smiled while seeing the situation becoming more interesting. and also got curious.
"Will he tell the secret?"
"Heh."
But the next moment everyone heard Luke’s mocking laugh.
"Ok, even though no one is obliged to tell their gift’s origin, I will still tell."
As Luke said those words, everyone’s expression became excited, while Aurielle’s expression became worried.
"Baron Luke, you don’t need to do that."
Suddenly Nyra’s voice comes from the platform.
And then she turned toward Rowan and with a displesed tone said in loud voice.
"I hope Sir Rowan Ashenford from now on you will not accuse falsely our guest!"
Rowan on this lowered his head more and become quiet.
After that Nyra shook her head and said to Luke in sorry voice.
"I am sorry that at my birthday party you have to faced such an allegation."
Luke turned toward Nyra, who was now saying sorry to him with an apologetic expression.
On this Luke shook his head and said.
"It’s not your fault, Lady Nyra."
Nyra sighed in relief at these words, but then Luke added another word.
"It’s just some idiots who don’t know their place spoiling other parties."
When the crowd heard Luke’s sarcastic voice.
They turned toward Rowan, who had now lowered his head more to avoid embarrassment, while some small laughs escaped from some noble mouths.
Rowan gritted his teeth but didn’t dare to say anything.
While Cedric also hides behind Rowan to hide his face.
Finally, Nyra took the vial with a smile and thanked Luke.
Luke nodded and said.
"Now, our second gift."
When everyone heard his words, they got baffled because they really thought he was just bluffing, but now here he is, bringing another gift out.
Soon a rainbow-colored small-sized fruit appeared in his hand.
The moment it appeared, surrounding lights seemed to dim somewhat, and the airflow increased.
Everyone’s eyes widened, then together they mutter a word.
"Origin Fruit."
Luke smiled seeing everyone’s reaction.
Even though Origin fruit was costly, it also depends on their rank.
So after Luke found out that it can only be effective against Bronze rank and below, he thought about selling some fruits to gain a large amount of gold coins.
And it’s also low level, so it’s fine because any high-level beings will not come for him.
Then comes the real problem, "Who to sell to or where to?"
Then he thought about the count function and his daughter’s birthday.
"Great.
He nodded as a large smile appeared on his face.
"Baron Luke, it’s too costly."
Suddenly Nyra’s voice brings Luke out of his thoughts about becoming rich.
Then he saw everyone’s expression become crazy, like they wanted to snatch this fruit and eat it themselves.
But they controlled it, because Count was still sitting on the high seat.
Then again, a questioning cheerful voice comes from the platform.
"Baron Luke, what rank is your origin fruit?"
Luke turned toward the voice, and yeah, he felt Lysandra’s intense gaze not on him but on the fruit in his hand.
On which he makes a sad face and brings one hand to his chest while saying in a painful voice.
"What should I say?"
"On that day it was a rainy night as the whole sky was filled with black clouds."
Everyone nodded and concentratedly heard his words.
"Then a sudden boom sound came as a single thunderbolt crashed toward our resting area."
"Gulp."
Someone gulped, as they were starting getting lost in the story.
"The place where it was stuck was so deep that I couldn’t see the end of it."
Some nodded; some imagined the scene.
"But the next moment more than 10 rainbow-colored fruits appeared above the holw, which were glowing so brightly that the whole forest was lit up."
"Wow."
Exclaiming sounds come from the crowd, but Luke continues with deep concentration.
"We got so happy because of this, but it didn’t last long."
"Soon they come, the guardians of the forest."
In the crowd, someone imagines a dragon coming, while others imagine the world-ending serpent.
Luke saw all those expressions, and his eyes twitched, and he thought.
"Was the lie too convincing?" then he continued.
"We fought day and night, and finally we got the victory, but—"
Luke took a long pause, on which everyone’s eyes were saying, "What’s next?"
Princess Lysandra watched and listened with an impatient expression, as she already knew he was exaggerating things.
"We lost our soldiers; we lost our money in those fights, but we were able to secure these fruits."
Everyone nodded good, but then they became confused, and someone asked.
"But you didn’t mention its rank."
Aurielle facepalmed after seeing her husband’s shameless behavior, which he often does whenever he is lying.
"Ahh, it’s a great, great E rank."
The crowd’s excitement grew with every great word Luke spoke, but when he revealed the final word E rank.
their expressions sank as they were brought back to reality so suddenly that they felt completely cheated.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 69: The Wife Who Came Back
paragraphs: Nyra thanks Luke again for the origin fruit and take it with smile when she finds it’s E rank.
Her family members also smiled on this, but Count’s expression didn’t change much.
After that, Luke returns to Aurielle, who have happy smile on her face.
"My husband sure knows how to boast."
She leaned closer and whispered to him, but Luke only smiled before looking toward the front.
The countess saw that the gift ceremony was over, so she stood up, at which point the noblemen and women both become quiet and turned to her.
She nodded at this, then smiled and announced it to everyone.
"Please enjoy your dance party."
No one shouted after hearing her words, but many men and women got excited because they were waiting for this.
Soon, the music starts as some singers dressed lavishly come into the hall along with people with musical instruments.
Many people approached their crush asking for their hand for a dance, while some husbands and wives were already lost in their own dance.
"Aurielle, do you want to?"
Luke, seeing everyone’s happy expression, also asked her, to which she raised her brow and smiled while asking him back.
"Do you know how to dance?"
Luke froze on this, then he got embarrassed, as he really never learned to dance, not even in his last world.
Seeing Luke’s embarrassed expression, Aurielle shook her head with a smile and then brought her hand towards him.
"Let’s go."
Luke came out from his frozen state and held her hand, while they moved toward the dance center.
Aurielle taught Luke the basics of dance, as he first put his hand on her waist and then one hand holding her hand.
Soon, they start moving slowly, step by step; Luke follows her guidance.
"It’s good."
He smiled and got close to her, to which she also smiled back.
Rowan, who was already feeling humiliated, became even more irritated at this moment.
Then he looked around and found that not a single woman came toward him because of that and his mood got even worse.
Cedric from the side also sighed, but what can he do? So both of them waited.
On the main seat, special guests along with the Count family were still seated; it was just that they were talking to each other.
But only one person’s gaze, with complicated emotions in it, was following a couple.
Naivara felt her heart ache a little, as something was again compressing it.
She tried to calm it down, but it just helped only somewhat because the next second those words repeated again in her mind.
"You are my wife, and I will always protect you!"
"Liar.
She finally muttered those words while giving Luke a betrayed look.
"I am here, so why do you never come to me? Why not a single time?"
Her eyes slowly start changing color as they are becoming completely blue.
"Was all of that really a lie? I just said one time, "Forgot me, and you did."
Her chair’s armrest suddenly cracked slightly because she wasn’t able to control her emotions.
Nyra, who was sitting with Naivara, suddenly felt something odd with her.
"Naira, are you okay?"
{Author note: Naira name will be a short name for Naivara and will mostly be called by her close ones.}
Nyra asked with a concerned voice while shaking her shoulders a little.
Naira, with a swift motion, turned toward Nyra, who got shocked on this.
"Why are her eyes changing now?"
Nyra felt little panic, as she knew what would happen if she lost control.
But the next moment Naira returns back toward Luke and Aurielle, which gives Nyra a hint as to how to solve this.
Nyra took a deep breath to calm down her recent shocked expression, then with a smile, she said to Naira in a coaxing voice.
"Naira, do you want to meet your husband? then why not go to him?"
Naira, who heard Nyra’s calm voice, suddenly paused, as she had never thought about this, and her eye color returned slightly.
But the next moment she shook her head and said to Nyra with a sad voice.
"I told him to forget me."
She lowered her head on this while clenching her fist tightly.
Nyra saw her expression and sighed because she knows about the ritual; that’s why she got so shocked. "Why would Sea King let his daughter Naivara to marry a hero?"
But when she heard that he was talentless and all the wives left him except Aurielle, she understood everything.
She held Naira shoulders gently and said.
"Naira, he is still your husband, and I am sure he will not be angry about your previous word."
Naira, who was feeling guilty, froze and abruptly turned toward Nyra with hopeful eyes and asked.
"Really?"
Nyra could see her eye color was returning slowly, which also calmed her down, and she nodded with a smile.
Then with a mischievous smile, she added.
"And maybe if you too have a child before your ritual, then your father will definitely cancel your ritual."
Naira, who was starting to feel better and hopeful after hearing Nyra’s words, suddenly froze, and her pupils trembled when she heard her last word.
"Naira, what’s happened?
Nyra got scared by Naira’s reaction, and in a slightly high voice she said it, on which Octavia’s gaze turned toward them.
"What’s going on, Nyra?"
Octavia tried to ask Nyra about Naira’s condition, but then she heard Naira’s somewhat down voice.
"No, if he finds out that I have lost my virginity before the ritual, he will kill both of us."
Nyra got silent, as she did hear about Sea King’s reputation: that he cared about only the strong; for the weak, he often discarded them.
But still, Nyra smiles and cheers up the now downcast Naiara.
"Still, right now you are here and you can spend all the time you want with your husband."
On this all three of them looked toward Luke and Aurielle, who were enjoying dancing with smiles on their faces.
Naira got conflicted; should she really approach him, and will he really accept him after all this?
But then she finally heard something that made up her mind.
"And Naira, you have all the rights to be with Luke as much as Aurielle has over him, because he is also your husband."
Naira finally nodded and thanked Nyra.
"Go for it and make him yours."
Nyra said with a cheerful smile, on this Naira blushed slightly, as she doesn’t have any experience with men.
Then she saw that Luke and Aurielle had returned to their position and were now seated while eating some food.
STEP
STEP
STEP.

Everyone was lost in their world, but all of a sudden the whole hall became quiet because everyone’s attention moved back toward the platform, and there they saw Naivara Tidewhisper, the daughter of the sea king.
Everyone becomes excited on this, because all the present men don’t have the guts to invite the women from the platform, as many become afraid with a count’s gaze alone.
So when she finally came down by herself, everyone thought, Who will be the lucky man to get the opportunity to dance with her? But some thought that they would be the one.
But with each step, many men on the way become heartbroken as she passes without turning towards them.
Soon, they noticed, she was not here for them, because she was heading toward the corner position, which has become too popular today.
And after a few moments later everyone got their answers, which they had already expected.
Because she was standing in front of Luke, a talentless hero.
"NO, maybe he has already eaten Origin fruit, so he is not talentless anymore."
Everyone thoughts with another sad expression.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 70: The Hero’s Solution to Jealous Wives
paragraphs: "NO, maybe he has already eaten Origin fruit, so he is not talentless anymore."
Everyone thoughts with another sad expression.
But next moment another thughts comes into their minds, that he only eat E rank fruit which have bronze-rank potential.
"So he is still not good."
With that they feels little better than before.
"Luke."
Luke, who was enjoying the delicacy with Aurielle, also saw the commotion when Naivara descend the platform and approached him.
Aurielle remained silent this time, though she was somewhat uncomfortable with the thought of having to share Luke with other women.
But she didn’t let her emotions control her.
Naivara, look towards the same face and same blue eyes, which have promised to her that he will protect her at all cost.
But now she is here in front of him; she doesn’t know what to say.
So after a moment later she gathered her courage and asked him the word she thought in her mind.
"Dance with me."
Naivara froze in place, as this was not what she wanted to say, but the next moment she heard Luke’s replied in a normal voice with a smiling face.
"Sure."
Naivara relaxed somewhat and gave her hand to him.
Aurielle looked towards Naivara, then to Luke, who was about to hold hands with her.
On this she repeated her words to not disturb him, but sadly she can’t control herself, and spoke before even thinking.
"I also want to dance again."
Luke got stunned after hearing Aurielle voice, and sweat started appearing on his forehead.
Because in front is his new second wife and behind is his first wife, and now he has to choose one.
With a worried face he looked forth and behind while thinking.
"What should I do? If I have more than one body, then this will easily solve—"
Then he paused mid-thought as finally a small lightbulb that was covered in spiderwebs for years inside his head lit up.
"Took him long enough."
Nyx, who was watching everything from inside, facepalmed because Luke took too much time to figure this out.
While Myrkhal was in a mediating position, as his face kept changing so fast that counting them would be tough for normal eyes.
Luke heard Nyx’s voice, but he ignored it and muttered something in his mind as he activated his first form of Nyx, the titan knight.
"Shadow of Nyx.
In this form there is not any dramatic change, like what happened at the Lucien fight in the marriage hall, and everything is the same, but he can use the ability of his titan in this form.
Soon everyone present in the hall got surprised.
Because of Naivara, everyone’s attention was already on that corner, so when Luke’s shadow rippled, everyone suddenly narrowed their eyes while thinking.
"Is this an ambush or his doing?"
Then they look toward Count, who was still seated and was calmly looking toward Luke, so they sigh in relief.

While the prince and princess’s eyes changed slightly to curiosity because they did hear about Luke’s giant ability, but the thing that was happening was something different, which even they didn’t know.
After a moment, a shadow.
No, not a shadow; instead, the same replica of Luke came out from his shadow with the same dress, and even his expression was so identical that no one could tell who was real or who was fake.
"There is a difference."
But then a voice from the crowd drew their attention back, and after looking carefully, they finally noticed the subtle difference, that no one would have found without close observation.
The replica was was little bit darker than the original Luke.
But the next moment, that darkness also disappeared, and now both Luke look like ditto copies, which shocked everyone.
Even seated members got surprised because they did hear about all types of clones abilities, but shadow clones should be dark, as they have never seen an identical shadow to original bodies.
"Because then it would be a doppelganger, not a shadow."
Luke smiled on this and shook his head at his previous foolish behaviour.
When he heard the name ’Shadow of Nyx’, he often thought that he is summoning a shadow, which should be true.
But then he heard Nyx say that his ability is perfect to extreme and the most important thing; he is a void titan, not a shadow titan.
At that time, he finally focused on his words, when he told him, "that he summoned an image of himself from the void."
In a sense, it is his reflection, a shadow, but not a real shadow.
"And now I can summon a real one."
He nodded then held Naivara’s hand while his clone held Aurielle’s hands.
Both women come out of their frozen state after feeling Luke’s touch.
Then both Luke smiled and said together, "Shall we?"
On this the crowd again becomes shocked.
"Can his clone talk? Or are they just mimicking?"
Luke heard everyone shocked voiced and thought.
Well, this is not special but definitely hard, because he has to concentrate to control both bodies.
It’s like thinking two different things at the same time, like your mind split into two.
With that, the four of them slowly moved toward the center of the dance floor again and started dancing together.
Luke has already found that his clone can mimic and remember his actions, so he doesn’t have to always control their actions.
Everyone had already stopped, as they were now watching both Luke and the princess dancing.
From the crowd someone in a single motion gulped down the drink he was holding and then cursed Luke.

"Come into the dark alley, and then we will see you."
But the women who heard their voices make distance from them, because the person who cursed first was really ugly and mocked him in low voice.
"Blaming others, while all faults are his own looks."
After some time, a few people got bored from their dance, so they chose their own partners and also started dancing.
Luke looks at Naivara’s ocean-coloured eyes, which are asking to drown in them, while her lips, which have pink-coloured lipstick, also suit her well.
"Luke."
When he was about to observe her necklace as well, he heard her low voice, on which he slowly raised his face and again looked at her eyes.
"I am sorry for earlier."
Luke paused for a second after hearing her words and became confused.
But after a moment he understood.
"She is talking about the words, "weak"."
He smiled at her because he didn’t mind, as he knew he was too weak to fight against the golden rank, too weak to save her from her ritual.
"It’s ok, I don’t mind."
She smiled with relief, that Luke has not taken those words seriouslly.
then without averting her gaze, she leaned toward him, as she tiptoed to get close to his face and whispered a question with a hopefull face.
"Did you really mean it? when you said you would protect me?..."
Luke step stops on this for a moment before continuing back. On this, Aurielle also noticed Clone Luke paused for a moment as well before continuing.
"What’s he talking with her?"
She muttered those words under her breath while giving a sidelong glance towards them with curious face, but the next second she got the reply.
"She is asking if my words about protecting all of you are true or not?"
She got stunned by his sudden talk, because all the time they were dancing quietly without a single word.
She took a breath to calm down and look towards his face, who is now smiling, and then she asked.
"And what did you say?"
Her voice was filled with curiosity but also with little hope, wanting to know, "Is Luke really serious about us?"

sentences.text: "NO, maybe he has already eaten Origin fruit, so he is not talentless anymore."
Everyone thoughts with another sad expression.
But next moment another thughts comes into their minds, that he only eat E rank fruit which have bronze-rank potential.
"So he is still not good."
With that they feels little better than before.
"Luke."

So after a moment later she gathered her courage and asked him the word she thought in her mind.
"Dance with me."

"What should I do?
If I have more than one body, then this will easily solve—"

"There is a difference."
But then a voice from the crowd drew their attention back, and after looking carefully, they finally noticed the subtle difference, that no one would have found without close observation.
The replica was was little bit darker than the original Luke.

Even seated members got surprised because they did hear about all types of clones abilities, but shadow clones should be dark, as they have never seen an identical shadow to original bodies.
"Because then it would be a doppelganger, not a shadow."
Luke smiled on this and shook his head at his previous foolish behaviour.
