But then he heard Nyx say that his ability is perfect to extreme and the most important thing; he is a void titan, not a shadow titan.
At that time, he finally focused on his words, when he told him, "that he summoned an image of himself from the void."
In a sense, it is his reflection, a shadow, but not a real shadow.
"And now I can summon a real one."
He nodded then held Naivara’s hand while his clone held Aurielle’s hands.
Both women come out of their frozen state after feeling Luke’s touch.

It’s like thinking two different things at the same time, like your mind split into two.

chapters.title: Chapter 71: A Love Beyond the Chains
paragraphs: Her voice was filled with curiosity but also with little hope, wanting to know, "Is Luke really serious about us?"
While they were talking, they didn’t notice that some people were already looking toward their position.
So the moment they saw the tension between Luke and his wife.
All of them thought maybe they would find something interesting, so they become quiet and soon everyone again became quiet.
Even musicians and singers stopped, while seated members also looked curiously at them.
A complete silence spread across the hall, but those four didn’t notice at all, as they were already lost in their eyes.
The clone’s smile didn’t lessen even a bit, and then everyone heard both Luke’s voice filled with love and sincerity at the same time.
"For me only one thing is most important."
Naivara and Aurielle kept looking at their husband’s eyes and waited.
The crowd also held their gaze, but Rowan was fuming with anger and jealousy.
The same scene was happening with Oryn as well, because he still doesn’t like his step-sis with this hero.
But Nyra looked at all of this with romantic feelings, as she is finally going to see a proposal and genuine words of love.
"That is you."
His eyes curved slightly as a genuine smile formed on his face, which is filled with only love, and he continued.
"Nothing shall touch my wife, as I am standing here."
"For me, your happiness is everything, and it will always be."
Naivara and Aurielle got frozen by his romantic words.
Then Luke brought out another queen’s wards ring and held it in his one hand.
Everyone who was also lost in those romantic moments came out of their thoughts when they saw a ring with an azure crystal appear in Luke’s hand.
He gently held Naivara’s left hand and he lifted them slightly.
Then with a smile on his face, he showed her the ring and said.
"In my world, there is a tradition."
Everyone looked toward the ring, then focused on his words, which were somehow attracting their attention towards it.
"A husband and wife always share a wedding ring."
Naivara’s eyes moved toward Luke’s hand and saw a ring was already there, and when she looked sideways, she saw Aurielle was also wearing the same ring.
Then next moment, Luke pulls her left hand slightly and brings the azure crystal ring while saying in a loving voice.
"So, you also deserve this."
After that he pushed the ring onward, and finally it settled on her ring finger.
Naivara looked at Queen Ward with complicated emotion, as this is the first time after her mother that someone else gave her a gift without asking anything in return.
She moved her gaze toward Luke face and there he was, still smiling at her and telling her that this ring would also protect her in his absence.
"So romantic."
Nyra muttered with a happy expression after seeing Luke proposal.
While the nobles men look at him with jealousy, because they can see.
A small smile has formed at Sea Princess’s lips; it means Luke has made some places in her heart, which some of them have tried before but were not able to.
As everyone was lost in their thoughts, a single person was smiling sinisterly.
Oryn observed all of this with angry face, but when he saw Luke putting a ring on Naivara, slowly a sly smile appeared on his face as he muttered.
"Father will not be happy with this big sis."
While Lysandra shook her head and muttered.
"Seems like my little sis really fell in love."
Because there Aurielle was looking deeply at clone Luke’s eyes when he muttered those words.
After that, they danced a few more times before finally Naivara returned back to her seat while Luke returned with Aurielle.
Many nobles also get relaxed, as this dancing session is around its ending.
"Naira, you are awesome!"
Nyra shook Naira gently with an excited voice.
But Naira’s face turned slightly red on Nyra’s compliment, and she muttered.
"It was ok."
Then look at her ring, which was glowing with azure light as it’s proves she is the wife of Luke Voidheart.
Even though they are bounded by chains, which also shows they are married, but no ones believe it.
"Wife..."
She muttered those words in a low voice with a small smile on her face as she lost herself in her thoughts about a happy life.
In which Luke and Naira were on the same island that she likes and were enjoying it.
Nyra shook her head with a helpless smile when she saw Naira lost in her world and turned toward Octavia.
"Sis, will I also be able to get such a romantic husband?"
Octavia, who was talking with their mother, stopped at Nyra’s voice and turned toward her with a complicated expression.
"Nyra, all these things are good, but for real life, strength is necessary in this world.
Nyra excited expression gone as she become confused when her sister told her those words, then she understood.
"The husband should be strong and able to protect you all the time with his strength, not with his word."

After remembering her father’s words, Nyra with compilcated face looked toward Luke, who is now feeding his wife with a loving smile, while Aurielle was giving him a glare for treating her as a small child.
"Haha."
Her expression softened slightly, and a small laugh escaped her lips before she even realized it.
As she continued staring at them, or at Luke.
Because she didn’t notice when her gaze only followed Luke’s movements.
His smile, his gesture, and then his hand, which gently wiped the food from Aurielle’s lips.
"I know it’s wrong."
Then Nyra muttered those words absentmindedly as her gaze reached his face, then his lips, and finally at his blue eyes.
Which only carried love for his beloved.
Then a thought comes into her mind.
"Is it wrong to think about a loving husband?"
Nyra suddenly stood up from her seat and said those words outside in low voice, as her gaze still remains on Luke.
Octavia and their mother give confusing looks toward their sis and daughter.
But then Vivienne’s expression brightens.
"Is she finally choosing her fiance?’
She become happy with this thought as they set up this function and make it grand, because the count and countess want to choose an engagement partner for both of their daughters.
For that, they even prepare a show of strength to help them more.
"But if she can choose any nobles before that, it will still be good."
She nodded, but then she felt a tap on her shoulder and turned toward her right.
"What’s happened, Octavia?"
Vivienne saw Octavia’s facial expression become ugly while looking toward the front, so she also followed her gaze.
But the next moment her face also froze, and she muttered.
"Why him?"
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 72: The Husband Who Cannot Stop Causing Trouble
paragraphs: But the next moment her face also froze, and she muttered.
"Why him?"
Because Nyra has already descend from the platform and was now moving toward Luke, who was happily eating food with his wife.
But now it was too late, as she couldn’t shout at her to stop in front of the crowd.
Naira, who was lost in her world, also came out from it and looked toward everyone.
All the nobles were standing silently like they have frozen and that’s why the whole hall became silent.
Count, who was always maintaining an emotionless expression all the time, sighed after seeing his daughter’s destination.
Oyrn felt his luck had become worse after he met this hero, and now it’s proven again.
With an angry face, he gritted his teeth because the woman he wants to make his was now heading toward that useless hero.
But the nobleman has another thought.
"Why are we even here?"
"Just call this hero and be done with this event."
Many men felt the world is unfair because he got two most beautiful people as his wives, and now the third one is also going toward him.
Luke and Aurielle were enjoying their little company alone, also felt the silence. So they turned toward the center and got stunned.
"Another woman?"
Aureille muttered with a dangerous voice, on which Luke got baffled and said.
"What have I done?"
Aurielle didn’t hear his words because she saw Nyra was coming toward them, but her gaze was only on Luke.
She felt uncomfortable with this, but when her gaze turned downward toward her chest, she sighed in relief and muttered.
"She is still a greenhorn, definitely not this big-breasted horny type."
Luke, who has a "don’t frame an innocent man" expression, heard Aurielle’s words.
On this his eyes twitched, and he turned toward her while giving a glare and muttered something in a low voice.
"You are finished tonight."
Aurielle’s face became red from shame as he uttered those words in public.
"Sir, Luke, can I dance with you?"
But then both of them paused as they turned toward Nyra, who was standing with a big smile as she extended her hand toward Luke.
Luke looked at her hand, then slowly turned sideways and returned instantly to his initial position.
Because literally every man was glaring at him, like he had slept with their wife.
And surprisingly Rowan was included in them along with many married men.
"Shameless people; they have wives but are still thinking about other women."
Luke muttered those words in a very low voice that only Aurielle heard, who in return gave him a speechless look.
After that he slowly turned his gaze toward the platform, and there Naivara was glaring at him like it was all his fault that her friend wanted to dance with him.
Then his gaze moved sideways, and there Octavia shook her head with a helpless expression.
Next, Nyra mother was looking toward Nyra with a worried expression, then the count was just looking calmly at him.
But when his gaze moved toward Therion, his eyes twitched slightly.
Because he was still looking outside, like this life-and-death situation is not even worth watching.
"Brother, then why are you here? Just go outside already."
Luke thought and looked toward Lysandra, who was smiling at him, but when his eyes met hers, she waved her hands happily at him.
"Weirdos."
He thought, before finally looking toward Oryn, but the next moment he brought back his attention toward Nyra.
As Oryn was giving a death glare, it was like if someone gave him one chance and he would definetly gonna erase Luke’s existence from this world.
Nyra waited patiently for Luke to do what he is doing.
She can’t say she has fallen in love with him, but she definitely wants to know him more.
So she thought about the way to get close to him, and "dance is one of them."
Luke, under the gaze of everyone, finally accepted Nyra’s hand in dance.
"It is just a dance!"
He shouted in his mind, but others saw he accepted another wife.
"It will be my pleasure, my lady."
He kissed her hand softly before slowly leading her toward the center of the dance floor as their hands still held together.
"I am going to hate dancing floor from now on."
Those words come into his mind because he is coming too much to this floor.
There were a few couples who were still there and were listening to everything along with everyone.
But when they saw Luke was coming with Nyra, they instantly cleared the space for them.
Soon, the music started playing again, and Luke and Nyra began dancing together.
In the start Luke was going slow, but Nyra, with a mischievous smile, speed up the process.
"Sir hero, are you enjoying this?"
She asked him with a playful smile as she came close to him.
Luke’s face becomes a little red as Nyra gets little too close, and he can see her cleavage clearly, which is distracting his thoughts.
Nyra got confused by Luke’s reaction, then she followed his gaze, and the next instant her face also got red as she hastily tried to move backward.
But.
Her shoes slipped in a hurry, and she felt like her legs were losing their grip on the ground.
"I am going to drop."
Her eyes widen when this thought enters her mind because falling in front of so many nobles and even her parents is too much for her.
As her thoughts were running wild, she felt a strong hand suddenly grip her waist and pull it toward it.
"Ah."
A small sound escaped her mouth when her chest collided with Luke’s broad chest because he pulled too forcefully.
"Sorry."
Seeing Nyra’s little pained expression, Luke apologized to her, but.
Nyra’s attention was somewhere.
"Ah, he’s holding my waist so tight."
A blush appeared on her face, and she replied with a meek voice.
"It’s fine."
With that, she separated from him as Luke held on to her waist, loosening a little bit.
After that they continued their dance with hands holding together; it’s just now things were becoming a little weird.
After a moment, when Nyra calmed down, she raised her face and looked at Luke’s eyes, which were also looking at her and said with a gratefull face.
"Thank you for saving me."
Luke smiled at her and said.
"How can I let such a beautiful lady like you fall?"
Nyra’s face blushed even more after hearing his cool words, and a thought appeared in her mind.
"He is so cool!"
Aurielle was eating roughly as her full attention was only on him.
"If he dares to cross the line, then he will regret it."

She muttered those threatening words as a piece of steak entered her mouth, because Luke was in natural form, where he don’t know, which words to control and end up making the opposite person fall for him.
While Luke was enjoying his dance with Nyra, or at least that’s what it seemed to everyone, he didn’t know that behind him something was occurring.
Rowan watched Luke’s every move as he moved together with Nyra toward the dancing center.
Then he heard Baron Cedric’s voice.
"Sir, Rowan."
Rowan paused as he shifted his attention from Luke to Cedric, who was smiling proudly like he wanted to give an important suggestion.
"Sir, now that Luke is not with Lady Aurielle, why not? You go and propose to her?"
[Chapter End]

Because literally every man was glaring at him, like he had slept with their wife.
And surprisingly Rowan was included in them along with many married men.
"Shameless people; they have wives but are still thinking about other women."
Luke muttered those words in a very low voice that only Aurielle heard, who in return gave him a speechless look.
After that he slowly turned his gaze toward the platform, and there Naivara was glaring at him like it was all his fault that her friend wanted to dance with him.
Then his gaze moved sideways, and there Octavia shook her head with a helpless expression.
Next, Nyra mother was looking toward Nyra with a worried expression, then the count was just looking calmly at him.
But when his gaze moved toward Therion, his eyes twitched slightly.
Because he was still looking outside, like this life-and-death situation is not even worth watching.
"Brother, then why are you here?
Just go outside already."
Luke thought and looked toward Lysandra, who was smiling at him, but when his eyes met hers, she waved her hands happily at him.
"Weirdos."
He thought, before finally looking toward Oryn, but the next moment he brought back his attention toward Nyra.
As Oryn was giving a death glare, it was like if someone gave him one chance and he would definetly gonna erase Luke’s existence from this world.
Nyra waited patiently for Luke to do what he is doing.
She can’t say she has fallen in love with him, but she definitely wants to know him more.
So she thought about the way to get close to him, and "dance is one of them."
Luke, under the gaze of everyone, finally accepted Nyra’s hand in dance.
"It is just a dance!"
He shouted in his mind, but others saw he accepted another wife.
"It will be my pleasure, my lady."
He kissed her hand softly before slowly leading her toward the center of the dance floor as their hands still held together.
"I am going to hate dancing floor from now on."
Those words come into his mind because he is coming too much to this floor.
There were a few couples who were still there and were listening to everything along with everyone.
But when they saw Luke was coming with Nyra, they instantly cleared the space for them.
Soon, the music started playing again, and Luke and Nyra began dancing together.
In the start Luke was going slow, but Nyra, with a mischievous smile, speed up the process.
"Sir hero, are you enjoying this?"
She asked him with a playful smile as she came close to him.
Luke’s face becomes a little red as Nyra gets little too close, and he can see her cleavage clearly, which is distracting his thoughts.
Nyra got confused by Luke’s reaction, then she followed his gaze, and the next instant her face also got red as she hastily tried to move backward.
But.
Her shoes slipped in a hurry, and she felt like her legs were losing their grip on the ground.
"I am going to drop."
Her eyes widen when this thought enters her mind because falling in front of so many nobles and even her parents is too much for her.
As her thoughts were running wild, she felt a strong hand suddenly grip her waist and pull it toward it.
"Ah."
A small sound escaped her mouth when her chest collided with Luke’s broad chest because he pulled too forcefully.
"Sorry."
Seeing Nyra’s little pained expression, Luke apologized to her, but.
Nyra’s attention was somewhere.
"Ah, he’s holding my waist so tight."
A blush appeared on her face, and she replied with a meek voice.
"It’s fine."
With that, she separated from him as Luke held on to her waist, loosening a little bit.
After that they continued their dance with hands holding together; it’s just now things were becoming a little weird.
After a moment, when Nyra calmed down, she raised her face and looked at Luke’s eyes, which were also looking at her and said with a gratefull face.
"Thank you for saving me."
Luke smiled at her and said.
"How can I let such a beautiful lady like you fall?"
Nyra’s face blushed even more after hearing his cool words, and a thought appeared in her mind.
"He is so cool!"
Aurielle was eating roughly as her full attention was only on him.
"If he dares to cross the line, then he will regret it."

She muttered those threatening words as a piece of steak entered her mouth, because Luke was in natural form, where he don’t know, which words to control and end up making the opposite person fall for him.
While Luke was enjoying his dance with Nyra, or at least that’s what it seemed to everyone, he didn’t know that behind him something was occurring.
Rowan watched Luke’s every move as he moved together with Nyra toward the dancing center.
Then he heard Baron Cedric’s voice.
"Sir, Rowan."
Rowan paused as he shifted his attention from Luke to Cedric, who was smiling proudly like he wanted to give an important suggestion.
"Sir, now that Luke is not with Lady Aurielle, why not?
You go and propose to her?"
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 73: He Touched the Hero’s Wife
paragraphs: Rowan turned his gaze toward Aurielle at the mention of Cedric’s words, who was now eating her food roughly while looking angrily at Luke.
Cedric nodded with a shy smile when he saw Rowan’s attention shift toward Aurielle.

On this Rowan nodded and decided. "Since this hero has already made fun of me, then how can I lose the chance of getting revenge?" With that, he placed his wine glass back toward the table before both of them moved toward Aurielle, who was still looking at Luke.
"Aurielle, you have become even more beautiful during my absence."
Aurielle, who was ignoring everyone’s gossip and only focusing on her husband, heard a familiar sound that she didn’t want to hear.
Slowly she turned toward the Voice, with a wine glass still in her hand, and there was Rowan, who was smiling, while behind him was Cedric, who was giving him lecherous smile.
Aurielle ignored them and returned her gaze toward her husband.
Rowan didn’t get angry about this; instead, a brighter smile appeared on his face as he said.
"Aurielle, I have heard what happened with you, and I was truly sad for all that."
She still has not responded, but Rowan got a little close to her while continuing.
"You are so beautiful and talented and deserve someone better, but they married you off to a waste of a hero without your permission. On this I know you are upset, and I can understand your pain."
When he said those words, Aurielle suddenly turned toward him with a swift motion and gave a death glare that was clearly saying.
"One word and I will not care about the count but will kill you."
Rowan didn’t flinch from this, because he was not only a peak bronze knight but was also the holder of a C-rank Origin skill, so he knew he could easily subdue Aurielle.

But Baron Cedric, who is just a Peak Iron Knight, when he felt Aurielle’s murderous intent toward them, nearly jumped backward but controlled himself with his full willpower, as he didn’t want to make a show of himself in front of everyone.
Even though Aurielle was in the corner, some nobles still sensed this commotion and turned their gaze from Luke and Nyra toward her with an interesting expression.
Rowan continued.
"You know this, Aurielle; that useless hero has not given you anything, but instead he consumes all your resources and only have takes advantage of you."
Aurielle’s anger is somewhat reduced, but instead it’s turned to slight confusion.
"When did Luke consume my resources? Instead, he always gives me and our territory everything."
Aurielle thought this, which Rowan mistook for his words working, so he continued with new enthusiasm.
"You have seen his real self, Aurielle; he is not trustworthy at all."
Rowan continued as his gaze turned toward the dance floor, where Luke suddenly pulled Nyra closer.
"Look, he just got separated from you and now is already flirting with Nyra."
Aurielle also turns her gaze toward Luke, who is really holding Nyra too close.
Then Rowan makes a sad expression, like he has sacrificed so much.
"Aurielle, you already know how much I love you."
Rowan saw that Aurielle didn’t react to his voice, but he didn’t mind and continued while getting a little closer to her with each word.
"I have never married or even touched another girl, because in my heart there is only one woman, and that’s you."
He lied with a straight face about the girl part, because all of the girls he used were already discarded after he was done, so who would find the truth?

Cedric from the side smiled on this, because he also knows about Rowan’s hobby, so after he gets bored from Aurielle, he will also be able to get a taste of her, which is why he doesn’t mind if she doesn’t become his because in the end she is going to end up in his bed.
Aurielle comes out of her thoughts as she turns toward him.
"So, marry me instead and forget about that waste."
As he finished his final sentence, he reached out and suddenly grabbed Aurielle’s left hand.
Auriele’s pupils dilated, as she doesn’t like other men touching only her husband.
But Rowan was smiling like he had won her heart, but the next moment Aurielle suddenly swung her right hand and gave a hard slap to Rowan’s face.
SLAP!
Everyone in the hall heard a loud slapped sound and instantly turned toward it.
Luke, who was dancing with Nyra, also heard the slap sound and turned toward it.

But the next moment an endless rage burned inside him because he saw Rowan was glaring at Aurielle with bloodshot eyes, and his right cheek had a hand-slapped print while his hand was holding Aurielle’s hand forcefully.
Luke released his hand from Nyra and turned toward Rowan, then he muttered a word in a very low voice.

"Myrkhal Ascension." The next moment his body swelled and grew to a 12-foot-tall faceless titan whose whole body was white, but he didn’t waste any time to feel his titan form; instead, he activated the form transformation ability instantly.

The next moment, his white, flawless body cracked and again started swelling. As its size increased, some black-colored horns emerged from its head on all sides except the front, which gives him an appearance that he is wearing a thunder crown because lightning was jumping from one horn to another.
As the transformation completed, a thunder titan who has earned the title of warden of Storm Path appears in Luke’s position.
And surprisingly all of this happens instantly as Luke forces this transformation to be fast.
Nyra, who was just enjoying her dance, heard the slap sound, then felt Luke released her hand.

She saw Luke look angrily toward Rowan, but in the next moment, his body transformed into a white giant body in 1 second, and before she could process, "What is this?" She got baffled as that white giant body again in a second transformed into a being whose whole body was made of dark plate armor and six massive spines had grown from his upper back, while he also had grown horns, which were crown-shaped.
Nyra was stunned from all these transformations, as she had never heard anything about Luke’s power before, so she tried to ask him something.
But then she noticed Luke’s hind legs suddenly swell lightly as lightning appeared on his whole body the next second.
BOOM!

The ground where both of them were standing was blasted apart, and a heavy shockwave was generated, which nearly threw Nyra to the ground, but in a moment Octavia had already appeared beside her as she also shielded her from the shockwave.
Even though Nyra was glad for being saved, her attention shifted toward the front.
After being slapped by Aurielle, Rowan’s anger had already reached its limit, and he glared at her with angry eyes.
"How dare an exile princess slap me?"
This word comes into his mind because this arrogance should not be shown by Aurielle at all, whose whole territory was already dying.

As he was in the middle of thoughts, suddenly an alarm rang in his mind. His years of training and his realm allowed him to sense that something with insane speed was coming toward him and he had to do something.
So he hastily released Aurielle’s hand and turned sideways, the direction from which the threat is coming.
But the next second his pupils widened because he saw a black armor plate covering a large fist was already in front of his face.
Before he could use his Aether to protect himself, the fist connected with his face, and he felt his foot lose its ground and his vision blurred.
BANG!.
He instantly got blasted away and directly crashed toward the wall with heavy force.
Suprisngly not a single cracked appeared on the walls, as it’s made to bear even more heavy attacks.
After a moment Rowan blurred vision, also returned, and then he felt a metallic taste in his mouth as Blood was coming out of his mouth and nose.
He felt some teeth got broken while his nose also got tilted sideways then a slight pain run through his body, though not enough to make him cry, but definetly it’s feels uncomfotable.
He spat the blood on the ground and stood up, then looked toward the 15-foot-tall giant whose body was full of lightning, which was slowly returning back inside his body.
"Hah!"
The next moment, he released his peak bronze knight aura with a shout as the anger returned to its face.
But the next moment.
BAM!
A golden sword suddenly comes and embeds itself between him and the giant Luke.
"Both of you halt."
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 74: They Thought He Was Weak
paragraphs: A golden sword suddenly comes from the sky and embeds itself into the ground between him and the giant Luke.
"Both of you halt." The female golden knight’s words echoed as she moved toward them.
Luke, who was still burning with anger, also felt the female knight’s golden aura and calmed down somewhat.
"Luke." Then he heard Aurielle’s slightly worried voice, as she doesn’t want him to get hurt.
After turning toward her and finder she is safe, he finally got relaxed and released his titan form.
Everyone got surprised by the sudden appearance of the black-armored giant and was even more surprised when Aurielle said his name.

"I have heard of Hero’s giant ability, but wasn’t it a golden-haired giant?" One of the nobles asked his companion with a confused look, on whom the person gave him a look, "Bro, how would I know? Go ask him by yourself."
Seeing his companion look, he stopped asking him and turn back to observed Giant Luke.

But still everyone was surprised. "How can the person who is clearly a first-stage iron knight have punched a peak bronze knight?" Even though all of them know, because it was a surprise attack, or else even that would not have succeeded but still they got amazed and even more curious about Luke giant form.

The next moment, everyone clearly saw Luke’s giant form disappear, and his normal human appearance returned. Surprisingly, everything remained the same as before—even his clothes were completely intact.
Everyone was baffled because of this and thought. "When he became a giant, shouldn’t his clothes have been torn apart as well?"
But they didn’t know that Luke was wearing magical size-changing clothes, which saved him from such troubles.

"Sir Rowan, are you disrespecting my lord by still not recalling your aura?" Then all of them heard the female golden knight speak with displeased voice to Rowan, whose aura was not returned to normal as he was still angry.
But when he heard her words, clarity appeared in his eyes, and he hastily removed his aura back and looked toward seated members with a fearful expression.
Their count were displeased toward him, which sunk his mood, and then he heard another angry female voice.
"Sir Rowan, you have really got guts; first you falsely accused the hero, and now you have touched my sister without her permission!" There Lysandra, was looking at him with an angry face.
Aurielle, who was now holding with Luke, also heard Lysandra’s angry voice, but she didn’t buy it even a little bit, as she knows she’s just faking it.

But the same was not true for Rowan, who knows nothing about the truth and has now become too afraid.So he gathered his courage and spoke with apologetic voice, but didn’t add anything about the hero part.
"I am sorry, your highness; it’s just Lady Aurielle is an old acquaintance of mine, so I got excited after meeting her, and that’s why I touched her hand accidently."
The surrounding nobles gave him a glance, "Who are you making fool?" but still didn’t say anything, if there were really any punishment then only count and her highness will give him.

Lysandra looked toward Rowan, who was apologizing to her rather than to Aurielle, but she was smiling inside, because she had to maintain her image, and that’s why all this drama was needed, and now she will forgive him.
"I hope this will not happen again, Sir Rowan Ashenford!"
Rowan heard her words, which still contained slight anger, but he nodded with relief because he also knew if Aurielle were still princess, then he would have faced much more serious punishment.
Luke from the side also heard, and his expression became ugly as he looked toward Lysandra, who didn’t even look at their side.
Aurielle increased the grip of her holding hands and said to him, "Ignore them."
He turned toward her and saw her expression, which clearly saying she had expected this. Even though he doesn’t like it, he nodded and hugged her.
After the princess words finished, the female golden knight also removed her sword from the ground and returned back to the platform side.

Then the countess, seeing everyone has already done their dancing and now the mood of the party has been destroyed, announced the last part, which is to give her daughters the opportunity to find their husbands.
"Everyone, thank you so much for attending this function." She paused to see everyone’s reaction; on this, every noble nodded with smiles.

"Now the last part, where we will hold a small friendly spar for those who want to attend and have Iron and Bronze knight strength." After finishing her sentence, she also told them that the top 3 winners have the opportunity to get engaged if their daughters agree.
"This is crazy!" Many noblemen got excited after hearing this, while women shook their heads with regret as the countess didn’t mention anything about Elias Duvall also choosing a partner.
Seeing everyone’s excited expression, Countess nodded and ordered the maids to guide them toward the stadium.

Luke, along with Aurielle, also followed the crowd toward the outside, but his face still holds anger towards Rowan, and he thought, "If he got the opportunity during the spar, then he would definitely beat that bastard."

Aurielle, who was holding Luke’s hands, also felt Luke’s anger; on this she just shook her head, because she knew Luke was very overprotective of her and he was not going to calm down unless he taught Rowan a lesson.
So she looked at Luke with a worried face and said. "Just don’t get yourself hurt, okay, darling?"
Luke comes out of his thoughts when he hears Aurielle’s worried voice and nods at her while saying. "Don’t worry, your husband is very strong."
Aurielle smiled at Luke’s words and leaned against his shoulder while they moved toward the stadium.

After walking two minutes, finally, all of them reached a large stadium, which is made circular with seats placed on it. In the center was an arena platform, which is heavily fortified so it can bear the damage caused by participants.

Luke and Aurielle were finally done with observing the stadium, but then they got surprised because suddenly an influx of people from the outside started appearing on the seats, and among them were their knights and maids as well.

"So, the whole city will be going to see my performance." From the noble crowd, someone said, after seeing those specters. while others just shook their heads, because they were not going to participate in this fight and moved toward the VIP area to settle down to enjoy the fights.

After that we also moved toward the nobles area and saw few mages appeared around the arena and were setting up some type of magic circle. A few minutes later, they were finally done and chanted magic words which Luke doesn’t understand at all, which instantly made the magic circle glow, and the next moment, a transparent, blue color thin magic shield formed around the arena.

"Wow." Many civilians who were seeing this for the first time got impressed and a exclamations escaped their mouths, while nobles just watched calmly, because almost all nobles of viscount rank and above contain those shield magic formulas.
"I also have a formation mage in the territory, so after returning maybe I should arrange some magic scroll for her."Luke got amazed by those magic shields and thought about this plan.

Just after everything was done, the same female golden knight came toward the arena and announced the matching to everyone. Around thirty iron knights have applied for spar, including Luke and ten bronze knights.
She also announced that the first match will be going to battle royale, which is half an hour long, and the last four standing nobles from thirty after half an hour will be moved to the next stage.
She also told few rules that should prevent the fight from stagnating, that is.
-No standing in a single place for more than 1 minute.
-If more than four people remain even after half an hour, then elimination will occur from the lowest realm rank among them until the last four are left.
After finishing all this, she returned back toward the edge of the arena for safety; in case some noble was going to get seriously injured and was about to die, she would be able to save them.
"Don’t play with them." Aurielle said playfully to Luke after they summoned the Iron Knight realm nobles first into the arena.
Luke stopped mid-step and turned back toward her and also gave her a playful smile and said. "As you wish, my wife."
Surrounding nobles who were just standup got stunned after hearing their talks because they also saw Luke’s giant form and how he had punched peak Bronze knights.
"Gulp." Someone from the crowd gulped while giving him a wary glance before heading toward the arena with false hope that maybe Luke wouldn’t be able to beat so many iron knights together.
[Chapter End]

Lysandra looked toward Rowan, who was apologizing to her rather than to Aurielle, but she was smiling inside, because she had to maintain her image, and that’s why all this drama was needed, and now she will forgive him.
"I hope this will not happen again, Sir Rowan Ashenford!"
Rowan heard her words, which still contained slight anger, but he nodded with relief because he also knew if Aurielle were still princess, then he would have faced much more serious punishment.
Luke from the side also heard, and his expression became ugly as he looked toward Lysandra, who didn’t even look at their side.
Aurielle increased the grip of her holding hands and said to him, "Ignore them."
He turned toward her and saw her expression, which clearly saying she had expected this.
Even though he doesn’t like it, he nodded and hugged her.
After the princess words finished, the female golden knight also removed her sword from the ground and returned back to the platform side.

Then the countess, seeing everyone has already done their dancing and now the mood of the party has been destroyed, announced the last part, which is to give her daughters the opportunity to find their husbands.
"Everyone, thank you so much for attending this function." She paused to see everyone’s reaction; on this, every noble nodded with smiles.

"Now the last part, where we will hold a small friendly spar for those who want to attend and have Iron and Bronze knight strength." After finishing her sentence, she also told them that the top 3 winners have the opportunity to get engaged if their daughters agree.
"This is crazy!" Many noblemen got excited after hearing this, while women shook their heads with regret as the countess didn’t mention anything about Elias Duvall also choosing a partner.
Seeing everyone’s excited expression, Countess nodded and ordered the maids to guide them toward the stadium.

Luke, along with Aurielle, also followed the crowd toward the outside, but his face still holds anger towards Rowan, and he thought, "If he got the opportunity during the spar, then he would definitely beat that bastard."

Aurielle, who was holding Luke’s hands, also felt Luke’s anger; on this she just shook her head, because she knew Luke was very overprotective of her and he was not going to calm down unless he taught Rowan a lesson.
So she looked at Luke with a worried face and said.
"Just don’t get yourself hurt, okay, darling?"
Luke comes out of his thoughts when he hears Aurielle’s worried voice and nods at her while saying.
"Don’t worry, your husband is very strong."
Aurielle smiled at Luke’s words and leaned against his shoulder while they moved toward the stadium.
After walking two minutes, finally, all of them reached a large stadium, which is made circular with seats placed on it.
In the center was an arena platform, which is heavily fortified so it can bear the damage caused by participants.

Luke and Aurielle were finally done with observing the stadium, but then they got surprised because suddenly an influx of people from the outside started appearing on the seats, and among them were their knights and maids as well.

"So, the whole city will be going to see my performance." From the noble crowd, someone said, after seeing those specters. while others just shook their heads, because they were not going to participate in this fight and moved toward the VIP area to settle down to enjoy the fights.
After that we also moved toward the nobles area and saw few mages appeared around the arena and were setting up some type of magic circle.

A few minutes later, they were finally done and chanted magic words which Luke doesn’t understand at all, which instantly made the magic circle glow, and the next moment, a transparent, blue color thin magic shield formed around the arena.

"Wow." Many civilians who were seeing this for the first time got impressed and a exclamations escaped their mouths, while nobles just watched calmly, because almost all nobles of viscount rank and above contain those shield magic formulas.
"I also have a formation mage in the territory, so after returning maybe I should arrange some magic scroll for her."Luke got amazed by those magic shields and thought about this plan.
Just after everything was done, the same female golden knight came toward the arena and announced the matching to everyone.
Around thirty iron knights have applied for spar, including Luke and ten bronze knights.
She also announced that the first match will be going to battle royale, which is half an hour long, and the last four standing nobles from thirty after half an hour will be moved to the next stage.
She also told few rules that should prevent the fight from stagnating, that is.
-No standing in a single place for more than 1 minute.
-If more than four people remain even after half an hour, then elimination will occur from the lowest realm rank among them until the last four are left.
After finishing all this, she returned back toward the edge of the arena for safety; in case some noble was going to get seriously injured and was about to die, she would be able to save them.
"Don’t play with them." Aurielle said playfully to Luke after they summoned the Iron Knight realm nobles first into the arena.
Luke stopped mid-step and turned back toward her and also gave her a playful smile and said.
"As you wish, my wife."
Surrounding nobles who were just standup got stunned after hearing their talks because they also saw Luke’s giant form and how he had punched peak Bronze knights.
"Gulp." Someone from the crowd gulped while giving him a wary glance before heading toward the arena with false hope that maybe Luke wouldn’t be able to beat so many iron knights together.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 75: They Called Him Talentless, Thirty Against One
paragraphs: When Luke and others reached the arena, the female golden knight gestured for them to come inside, on which all of them nodded and stepped through the shield, entered.
Luke got curious seeing this scene, as this shield allowed entry but not exit. After a moment, finding everyone was already inside, he also stepped in.

The surrounding specter watched the nobles with excited expressions, who were going to fight. Because most of the time, they were just living their lives by working, but when something special occurs, they also get the chance to participate, though with limits.
But still only a few times have they seen fighting-type events, and even rarer is a fighting spar between nobles.

Among the crowd, the Blackstone Legion was seated on the bottom side with Margaret in between them, while Kai, the owl summoner, was situated at the front of the group. Their gaze was on their master, who just stepped inside the arena.

"This time, my lord is going to win for sure!" From the crowd, a young knight whose realm was Iron Knight said excitedly when he found his lord was inside the ring. Many knights also got excited and praised their lord as well, while keeping saying, "No, it’s our lord who is going to win!"

Kai and others heard their bicker but didn’t comment on it, because if they found out that their master had killed the early silver knight with his early Iron Knight realm, then what would happen with their weak hearts? So they just sneer among themselves.
Margaret and Kai didn’t react to their companions behavior; they just kept looking at their lord, already knowing the answer of who was going to win.
"What do you think? Who is going to be in the next round?" Princess Lysandra leaned slightly toward the right-side chair and asked Therion with a cheerful smile.

Therion, who seemed to be lost in thought but was actually looking toward the huge gate with the same expression as he had before. ’When this is over, I have to go training or fight.’ didn’t heard Lysandra words or he did, but choose to ignore it.
Lysandra’s eyes twitched at his behavior, then she shook her head and turned to the left side; there was sitting a blue-haired boy, or a blue-haired sea prince.
"So, what do you think, Sea Prince?" She asked him this time again with the same cheerful smile.
Oryn, who was lost in thought as his one hand was in his pocket, which was holding a runestone, suddenly got startled by the voice.

"Ahh, yes, Lady Lysandra, I don’t know." He answered hastily, with a relieved expression, that she didn’t saw the runestone, but his voice did get a little shutter in some places, which piqued Lysandra’s curiosity, and she looked at him with narrowed eyes.
Oryn got little sweat formed on his forehead after feeling her curious glares, but he kept his cool and didn’t react.

Finally seeing he was not reacting to her, she sighed with a bored face and returned back to her position as she leaned on her seat with a lazy expression while muttering. "Why am I stuck with these two boring guys?

Nyra was happy, seeing Luke also got in the arena, but then Naivara’s voice comes from the side chair, "He is already married, so don’t let your illusion run wild, Nyra." At this, Nyra’s eyes twitch, and then she turns to Naivara and says, "Naira, don’t be so jealous; it’s not like I am stealing your husband." Naira on this also turned toward her, and gave a glare, which is asking, ’What do you mean?’
On this Nyra just smiled and shifted back her attention toward the arena. Naira got a little irritated seeing Nyra didn’t answer her, so with a sigh she also turned her attention back to the arena.

In the arena, most of the iron knights got close to Luke as they were preparing to eliminate this wild card first. While some peak iron knights were still not afraid of him and one of them was Baron Cedric.

Luke shook his head with amused smile after seeing their reactions and thought ’sometimes ago they were saying, I am an talentless and not worthy of princess and here they are now, being afraid of same talentless hero.’ after that he activated his titan form, while waiting for the golden knight to start the fight.

The closest iron knights were already wary of Luke, so the moment Luke’s body suddenly grows into a 12-foot-tall giant with dark blue hair and azure blue eyes, they instantly back away, afraid to get eliminate by him at the start.
But then reality hit them; the match had not started yet, so Luke also couldn’t attack them, and their faces got a little red because they got afraid just after seeing his transformation.
"Wow!!!" When Luke transformed into titan form, all the specters got crazy, because for the first time, they had seen someone turn into a giant.
Seeing people’s excited expressions, Luke didn’t react much and summoned Velzareth as well.

Soon, the crowd, which had gotten calmed down somewhat, again became shocked when they saw a giant black armor with blue runes shining on it and a blue cape fluttering behind it appear just beside Giant Luke and attached to its body.
While the crowd became excited from the appearance of knight armor, the nobles reaction was competely different from theirs.

’What’s this?’ All of them thought with a confused expression because they had seen knight armor, but most of them summoned and called it from the spatial rings, not like this, directly hovering in the void and attached to the whole body.
’We have to be more careful.’ This thought comes into their mind, and they get more wary of Luke, so some peak Iron Knights, who were confident in their strength, also come forward and surround Luke.
The golden knight watched all of this and saw everyone is already prepared; So she waved her hand and shouted. "Begin!"
So the moment those words escaped her mouth, all the iron knights suddenly attacked Luke’s place. CLANG! CLINK! CLANG! BAM!

The sound of the sword and different weopans colliding with the ground echoed, ’Wait... collided with the ground?’ This thought comes into their mind before a punch lands on their back and they become unconscious.

"Wow, amazing!" The specter saw fully what happened because the moment ’begin!’ words left the golden knight’s mouth, Luke disappeared from his place, and all the attacks hit the empty area. Then, the next moment, he appeared behind an early iron knight and knocked him out with one punch.
He kept disappearing and reappearing behind one iron knight and another, and soon half of them were already eliminated within under 30 seconds, which was insane.
The remaining knights hurriedly moved and gather around while surrounding the giant armored Luke, who is now in the center of the arena.
"Did you see what’s happened?" One knight asked warily to the other knight, to which he shook his head with fearful expression but said with trembling voice, "Maybe he has the ability to teleport.
"What!!!" When they heard his words, they also felt he was right and got shocked, because movement abilities are very effective and teleportation is even better, but they are also very rare.

Luke didn’t care for reaction and again used void step to appeared behind another knight, then the knight also went down with a punch. He keeps doing this until only one iron knight remains. Baron Cedric.

Baron Cedric, who was confident about his strength earlier, now felt, ’Why is he competing with this monster?’ Because even after seeing his teleportation, everyone was unable to do anything to him, as Luke instantly just appeared behind or beside or on any sides, which really makes it hard for them to fight against him.

The female golden knight saw all of this but didn’t announce the result, as they have to fight and survive among them for 30 minutes, but when she saw it, Luke was defeating them like a child. She decided that it’s better to let these men lost, if they are so weak.
"Thud." Baron Cedric also got dropped to the ground as Luke’s heavy, giant punch hit his face, which also broke his nose.

"Luke Voidheart is the final winner of Iron Knights!" The female golden knights announced the result with a loud voice; on this, the whole crowd erupted with cheers, while the nobles seated inside the VIP area grew quiet. Because the same person who they thought was talentless, now defeated large numbers of opponents, even while being under the lowest realm.
Aurielle also watched all of this and shook her head with a helpless smile. ’Ahh...I should have expected this, because he likes to show-off.’

"Sis, did you see? He defeated all of them instantly." Nyra shook Octavia’s shoulder while shouting excitedly. Vivienne from the side watched, her daughter’s reaction with a helpless expression because it seems she might have fallen for this hero, who is already married to five princesses.

Naira was also happy for Luke’s victory, but when she heard Nyra’s excited shout from the side, her face fell, and she gave her a look while saying it. "Nyra, control your emotions; if someone saw you shouting so happily for a married man, they would think wrong about you."
Nyra, who was happily sharing her happiness with her sis, heard Naira’s jealous voice and got stunned. Then she calmed down and just observed the arena, like all the previous reaction was an lie.

Count looked at Luke’s victory without change of emotion, while Elias was also the same because he had already seen Luke punching Rowan, a peak Bronze knight, so he was not much surprised, but he still got curious about Luke’s giant form.
Oryn gritted his teeth, as he didn’t like this at all, but then he felt the runestone in his pocket heat up a little.
’It’s time already?’ A large smile appeared on his lips on this, because now this waste hero will be going to finish for sure. And the next moment he crushed the runestone inside his pocket.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 76: The Hero’s Celebration Turns Into Disaster
paragraphs: Eleven people, all of them wearing black robes and covering their faces with hoods as well. All of them were sitting at the large table, while at the head was sitting another black-robed man, but his robe had the symbol of a golden mask with black flames spreading outward like wings in the back, while the others had a golden broken mask surrounded by three black flames in the back.

"Is everything ready?" The head seat person asked the other black robed man, who nodded and said. "All demonic arrays are already prepared, and he will also do his job." The head seat man nodded and looked around.

Total of ten Peak Black Chorus members, who have the strength of platinum peak rank, while he himself is an Early Demon Ascendant with early diamond rank strength. ’With this lineup, Count will definitely be going to die,’ he thought excitedly and shouted. "Beyond the cracks lies the truth!"
"Beyond the truth lies our salvation!!!" the other ten members shouted with frantic expressions. He nodded, and soon everyone left the table.

When Luke was enjoying everyone’s cheers, Nyx also was looking around, but Myrkhal, who was beside him, suddenly turned toward one direction, and his face glitched as it kept changing from one face to another.

Nyx noticed Myrkhal’s strange behavior and followed his gaze; there Oryn was seated on his seat, which looked normal to him, but then Myrkhal’s glitch finally stopped, as an demon face appeared on it.

Nyx got shocked. ’Demons?’ So he concentrated on Oryn, and on this same moment Oryn crushed the rune stone and Nyx felt a very minute amount of demonic energy was leaked from his pants pocket, and when he tried to focus more, he found out a rune with a magical array engraved on it but now it’s was broked.
’This is bad.’ This thought comes into his mind, and he instantly shouts toward Luke, "Luke, get out of the stadium... now!"
Luke suddenly heard Nyx’s worried voice and got confused, but before he could respond to it.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! ... BOOM!

Ten explosions occurred simultaneously inside the city in various locations, and the next moment, ten thick beams of demonic light pillars shoot toward the sky from those places. When they reached the sky, an enormous redish color demonic magic array appeared in the sky, which was covering the whole central district of Stormveil County.

’What’s happening?’ Luke looked around confusedly to find out what the hell was going on, but sadly there were no answers; instead, panic exploded among the civilians. They scream and try to escape, while some jump down.
"This redish light is making them panic?" Luke muttered in low voice, because he can also feels, that his emotions was getting interfere, like something was making him more irritated.

Luke tries to calm his emotion and turned his gaze toward Aurielle and his knights, maids; fortunately all of them were okay, which calmed down his heart, but when he turned toward seated members to check on Naivara, he got shocked.
Because there Count was flying into the sky without any wings, ’No, he is not flying... he is floating.’ This thought automatically comes into his mind when he sees some aether surrounding the Count.
WHOOSHHH! But the next moment, the demonic array, which was situated in the sky, released a redish light beam toward the stadium.
Count, who was looking at the array warily, instantly saw this attack and used his power to counterattack.

CRRRACKLE... A thick bolt of lightning was released from his right hand and collided with the light beam, KRA-KOOOOOM!. A loud explosion sound comes, then comes the shockwave, which nearly blows away the standing people.
"What the hell!" Luke cursed after seeing this powerful attack, because he literally felt that only a missile attack could generate this sound... and shockwave.

KZZZZZAAAPPP!!! But it seems not over, as the count raised his left hand as well and channeled another lightning strike toward the light beam, which was getting a continuous supply from the ten demonic pillars.
Luke saw the situation was not good and instantly ran toward Aurielle, but then—

"WHOOOOOOOM..." The light beam suddenly got large and overwhelmed the lightning before crashing on everyone. "NO!!!" Everyone who saw this scream in fear, while Luke’s thoughts slowed for a second, and he tried to find any solution, which didn’t come.

The next moment the whole stadium suddenly got quiet, but no explosion came and not anyting else. The civilians opened their eyes slowly and found out that they were safe. ’Then what was that demonic light beam done?’ This thought comes into everyone’s mind.
But soon they found their answers, as all knights were gone and many seats were empty, without anything left. "No ash, no body parts, or anything; they just vanished."
Count also looked around with angry eyes, as this was the second time someone attacked his county, his city, his home.

"Father!" Octavia’s worried voice comes from the ground, because she noticed all the knights who were below the golden stage had disappeared. This means Nyra, Naivara, Elias, and her mother Vivienne are also gone.
Magnus heard his daughter’s worried voice and then looked toward the ten demonic pillars and said. "All of them are transported to the secret realm, so go ahead and destroy those pillars fast."

Octavia felt little relief after finding that all of them didn’t transport to the demon land but the secret realm, because going into demon land, means death. But from secret realm, they can atleast saved them.

Magnus saw his daughter smile, but he didn’t say anything, because he knows, it’s not simple and that secret realm will also going to be dangerous for them; then he looked toward the prince and princess as she was an early golden knight and the prince was a mid-golden knight, so they were left.
"I hope both of you can help us in this situation," he said normally, because for him, only stronger people can demand respect, not everyone.

"Sure, count on us; we will help with our full strength." Lysandra smiled and said to Count Magnus, who nodded. While Therion got excited that finally he would be able to fight against someone. And soon he got his wish fulfilled.
The sky distorted, and ten black-robed figures fell from above. "BOOOOOOM!" "BOOOOM!" "BOOOOM!" Each landing created a shockwave, forcing the dust around them to spread.
The golden knights of Stormveil County hastily raised their Aether while mages cast their mana shields to absorb the shockwave that’s generated from their landing, or else all the civilians will die.
VMMMMM! The magic shield shook heavily under the impact but successfully blocked the force, leaving only dust and wind passing through.
Count Magnus looked at the front, because a single black-robed figure was also floating on air and was standing in front of him.
"Demon Ascendant?" Count Magnus muttered, remembering the being in front is from the demon whisper group named The Infernal Choir.
"kekekekee. " Kavos laughed after seeing the mission half-successful and mocked Magnus. "Magnus, have you ever thought? That your territory will be attacked again?"

Magnus heard the black-robed man’s voice, but instead of reacting to his words, his mind became focused on something else. That voice... why did it feel so familiar? It was buried deep in his memories, yet he couldn’t place where he had heard it before.
Seeing Magnus’s lost expression, Kavos continued in a mocking tone. "Your daughter and son, along with your wife, will all die, just like your father, mother, and brother did."

"KRRRRRAAAAA!" Suddenly, Count Magnus released his aura, which shook the entire battlefield as a wave of pressure exploded from his body. Dust rose from the ground, and the civilians felt their bodies become heavy under the overwhelming presence as they looked terrified toward above.
Octavia also looks worriedly toward her father, because she has never seen him so angry before.

Magnus’s eyes become bloodshot red because he remembered... remembered that day when his everything was snatched from him. His family members were killed and the person who did this is the person standing in front of him.

"Heh," Kavos chuckled at Magnus and said mockingly. "Did you really think? that I died when demons attacked my territory?" Magnus didn’t reply to him, but instead the wind around him started to become fast, and black clouds started gathering above him.

Kavos saw all of this and shook his head, because when demons attacked his territory, he joined the infernal choir organization, and that’s why he was able to save his life, though it was not bad, as he got so much power and faster realm growth, which is almost comparable to a prodigy.

"Let’s take our fight somewhere, because I am pretty sure you don’t want to destroy your territory by our fight, right?" Kavos, with a laugh, said to Magnus, because if they fought, then those demonic magic array will also get damaged, which Kavos also don’t want.
Magnus heard Kavos’s voice and paused. His eyes quickly scanned the surroundings, and the next moment, he shot into the sky. Kavos followed him, and soon both of them moved far away from the city.
The nine Black Chorus also launched themselves toward Magnus and Kavos direction, while one remained to control the situation.
"It seems like we have a problem here." Lysandra said after finding one black-robed man, who was a Radditing diamond rank, which is above golden rank.

"Well, we should go and deal with those ten pillars, and for him... our guardians will take care." Therion said, and in the next moment, two diamond knights wearing black robes appeared from their shadows.
Octavia nodded at them before also leaving some golden knights to evacuate the civilians while she moved toward one pillar, while the prince and princess also chose one pillar and charged towards it.
"Ughhh... what’s happened..." Luke slowly opened his eyes, and he felt his whole body heavy, like he had taken a ride on a super-fast train for the first time, but it shakes a lot.
When he finally fully opened his eyes and saw the scenery in front of him, his mouth got fully opened, and a curse escaped his mouth.
"Holy Hell!"
[Chapter End]

sentences.text: Eleven people, all of them wearing black robes and covering their faces with hoods as well.

All of them were sitting at the large table, while at the head was sitting another black-robed man, but his robe had the symbol of a golden mask with black flames spreading outward like wings in the back, while the others had a golden broken mask surrounded by three black flames in the back.
"Is everything ready?" The head seat person asked the other black robed man, who nodded and said.
"All demonic arrays are already prepared, and he will also do his job." The head seat man nodded and looked around.

Total of ten Peak Black Chorus members, who have the strength of platinum peak rank, while he himself is an Early Demon Ascendant with early diamond rank strength. ’With this lineup, Count will definitely be going to die,’ he thought excitedly and shouted.
"Beyond the cracks lies the truth!"
"Beyond the truth lies our salvation!!!" the other ten members shouted with frantic expressions.
He nodded, and soon everyone left the table.

When Luke was enjoying everyone’s cheers, Nyx also was looking around, but Myrkhal, who was beside him, suddenly turned toward one direction, and his face glitched as it kept changing from one face to another.

Nyx noticed Myrkhal’s strange behavior and followed his gaze; there Oryn was seated on his seat, which looked normal to him, but then Myrkhal’s glitch finally stopped, as an demon face appeared on it.

Nyx got shocked. ’Demons?’ So he concentrated on Oryn, and on this same moment Oryn crushed the rune stone and Nyx felt a very minute amount of demonic energy was leaked from his pants pocket, and when he tried to focus more, he found out a rune with a magical array engraved on it but now it’s was broked.
’This is bad.’ This thought comes into his mind, and he instantly shouts toward Luke, "Luke, get out of the stadium... now!"
Luke suddenly heard Nyx’s worried voice and got confused, but before he could respond to it.
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM! ...
BOOM!
Ten explosions occurred simultaneously inside the city in various locations, and the next moment, ten thick beams of demonic light pillars shoot toward the sky from those places.
When they reached the sky, an enormous redish color demonic magic array appeared in the sky, which was covering the whole central district of Stormveil County.
’What’s happening?’ Luke looked around confusedly to find out what the hell was going on, but sadly there were no answers; instead, panic exploded among the civilians.
They scream and try to escape, while some jump down.
"This redish light is making them panic?" Luke muttered in low voice, because he can also feels, that his emotions was getting interfere, like something was making him more irritated.

Luke tries to calm his emotion and turned his gaze toward Aurielle and his knights, maids; fortunately all of them were okay, which calmed down his heart, but when he turned toward seated members to check on Naivara, he got shocked.
Because there Count was flying into the sky without any wings, ’No, he is not flying... he is floating.’ This thought automatically comes into his mind when he sees some aether surrounding the Count.
WHOOSHHH!
But the next moment, the demonic array, which was situated in the sky, released a redish light beam toward the stadium.
Count, who was looking at the array warily, instantly saw this attack and used his power to counterattack.
CRRRACKLE...
A thick bolt of lightning was released from his right hand and collided with the light beam, KRA-KOOOOOM!.
A loud explosion sound comes, then comes the shockwave, which nearly blows away the standing people.
"What the hell!" Luke cursed after seeing this powerful attack, because he literally felt that only a missile attack could generate this sound... and shockwave.
KZZZZZAAAPPP!!!
But it seems not over, as the count raised his left hand as well and channeled another lightning strike toward the light beam, which was getting a continuous supply from the ten demonic pillars.
Luke saw the situation was not good and instantly ran toward Aurielle, but then—
"WHOOOOOOOM..." The light beam suddenly got large and overwhelmed the lightning before crashing on everyone.
"NO!!!" Everyone who saw this scream in fear, while Luke’s thoughts slowed for a second, and he tried to find any solution, which didn’t come.
The next moment the whole stadium suddenly got quiet, but no explosion came and not anyting else.
The civilians opened their eyes slowly and found out that they were safe. ’Then what was that demonic light beam done?’ This thought comes into everyone’s mind.
But soon they found their answers, as all knights were gone and many seats were empty, without anything left.
"No ash, no body parts, or anything; they just vanished."
Count also looked around with angry eyes, as this was the second time someone attacked his county, his city, his home.
"Father!" Octavia’s worried voice comes from the ground, because she noticed all the knights who were below the golden stage had disappeared.
This means Nyra, Naivara, Elias, and her mother Vivienne are also gone.
Magnus heard his daughter’s worried voice and then looked toward the ten demonic pillars and said.
"All of them are transported to the secret realm, so go ahead and destroy those pillars fast."
Octavia felt little relief after finding that all of them didn’t transport to the demon land but the secret realm, because going into demon land, means death.
But from secret realm, they can atleast saved them.

Magnus saw his daughter smile, but he didn’t say anything, because he knows, it’s not simple and that secret realm will also going to be dangerous for them; then he looked toward the prince and princess as she was an early golden knight and the prince was a mid-golden knight, so they were left.
"I hope both of you can help us in this situation," he said normally, because for him, only stronger people can demand respect, not everyone.
"Sure, count on us; we will help with our full strength." Lysandra smiled and said to Count Magnus, who nodded.
While Therion got excited that finally he would be able to fight against someone.
And soon he got his wish fulfilled.
The sky distorted, and ten black-robed figures fell from above.

VMMMMM!
The magic shield shook heavily under the impact but successfully blocked the force, leaving only dust and wind passing through.
Count Magnus looked at the front, because a single black-robed figure was also floating on air and was standing in front of him.
"Demon Ascendant?" Count Magnus muttered, remembering the being in front is from the demon whisper group named The Infernal Choir.
"kekekekee.

That your territory will be attacked again?"

That voice... why did it feel so familiar?
It was buried deep in his memories, yet he couldn’t place where he had heard it before.
Seeing Magnus’s lost expression, Kavos continued in a mocking tone.

"KRRRRRAAAAA!" Suddenly, Count Magnus released his aura, which shook the entire battlefield as a wave of pressure exploded from his body.
Dust rose from the ground, and the civilians felt their bodies become heavy under the overwhelming presence as they looked terrified toward above.
Octavia also looks worriedly toward her father, because she has never seen him so angry before.

chapters.title: Chapter 77: The Hero’s Legendary Archer, The Final Huntress Arrives
paragraphs: Luke found that he was inside of kind-some massive forest, because the trees surrounding him were huge, like 100 meters tall. All of them were green, and he also noticed that this is not some kind of rainforest, or else it would be more of a problem.
At least we are getting enough sunlight. Luke looked around and muttered; he also found out that there were only few insects that were chirping around, "Chirp... chirp..."

While Luke were observing the surroundings, both Nyx and Myrkhal also appeared outside and each sat on his shoulders; Luke felt their presence and turns toward them then He asked, ’if they know something, what’s going on?’
Nyx gave a brief look around before mentioning. "We are inside of some kind of large secret realm."
Luke’s eyes narrowed with worry as he remembered Aurielle’s explanation that secret realms were often small worlds or fragments of worlds that had become attached to Valtharion.
Sometimes a portal formed, which allowed them entry, or sometimes they were hidden in space, just waiting to be found out or forcefully torn open to enter it.
Though, the second method was risky because using a forceful method will make the realm unstable, and it can be destroyed after some time if not stabilized.

Nyx saw Luke’s worried face and told him about something. "I felt Oryn trigger some kind of mechanism, which activated those ten demonic light pillars, and that’s why that sacrifice magic array was formed."
"Wait!!!" Luke got stunned. "Sacrifice array?" He asked him back, with a worried face. "What does this mean?"
"The huge array in the that you saw was an demonic sacrifice array, and it seems that even Oryn don’t know when he activated.

Because whoever build this array wants to sacrifice the whole city to Demon God and will use that power to cross the realm," Nyx fully told him about the real work of the demonic array and then added. "The stadium array was the teleportation array of this secret realm. Though it is also linked with the sacrifice array, so if someone dies here, their soul along with their body will become nutrients for the mastermind.

"Damn it!" Luke cursed after hearing the full information, and his face became worried. "Does this mean everyone from the stadium was transported here? Was Count Magnus also here?" Luke asked Nyx with a hopeful expression, but Nyx shook his head and explained that, aside from mortals who had not started cultivating, everyone below the Golden Knight realm had been teleported.

"This is bad!" Luke’s worry increased. ’Doesn’t this mean we are trapped here without any way out?’ He thought this and also asked Nyx about this, on which he replied, There is always an exit from the secret realm; it’s just you have to find out.
Luke’s face finally became less worried, and he muttered. "Thank god." With that, he touched his heart, and soon five golden chains materialized in the air, which only he and his wives can see.

Three chains were going to the sky, ’likely outside the secret realm.’ With those thought, Luke turned toward the right side. The closest chain was in that direction. "So either Naivara or Aurielle is there." He muttered with a worried voice because he couldn’t order the chains to tell who the person on the other side was.
Then Luke checked his inventory. Inside his space ring, there were some food and water with some spare clothes. Which can be sufficient for few days.
While his system inventory contains many things, like gold coins, queen wards, etc.
After sorting this out, he did a quick summary of what he can use right now and what not.

The first things are the Iron realm’s warhorses and archers are out because, in this place, moving with an iron knight-grade army can be very risky. Because they can die pretty fast, which would be a total waste.

"So, I can only use this." Luke muttered with an hopefull and excited expression because he was finally going to summon another peak silver knight level combatant. With that, he clicked on the icon in the system inventory, which was displaying.
[Silver Knight Elite x 1].
The moment he clicked, a large roulette appeared in front of him, and many faces could be seen; surprisingly, there were men’s faces also present.

"System, you summoned elite men as well?" Luke asked with a surprised expression. Because the system is always horny and keeps sending one woman after another, likes he wants him to mate with all of them.

System, who was enjoying the sunlight breeze in his own world, heard Luke’s surprised voice. Then he replied without a bothered expression. "Yeah... there are some men, but why are you worried? Men will be summoned if you summon them in bulk. But if you are summoning a single elite unit, it should be beautiful women, or else what’s the point of summoning?

Luke’s eyes twitched after hearing the system’s expected words. ’So, the men in the options are just for show.’ With that, he finally pressed the red button, and Roulette started spinning from slow to very fast, and finally it stopped on a blue masked figure. "What?" he got confused, while Nyx and Myrkhal also looked with curious expressions; that’s what Luke will summon this time.
The next moment a blue-colored magic circle complex appeared in front of Luke. Nyx and Myrkhal looked curiously but couldn’t understand the magic circle, which baffled both of them.

The magic circle began to glow, its light growing brighter as the surrounding aether started rushing toward it. The air itself seemed to become empty, forming a small zone where not even a trace of aether remained.

Then, with a sharp whoosh, the magic circle collapsed and vanished. A small shockwave burst outward, sweeping away the dust around it and causing the nearby trees to tremble as the leaves rustled violently in the sudden disturbance.

Luke shielded his eyes from the dust, and after it finally settled, he, Nyx, and Myrkhal leaned forward toward the magic circle’s location with curious expressions. Soon, they found the answer they were looking for.

There in the front was standing a 5’10" tall slim woman, who was wearing the attire of a hunter, which consisted of a brown leather jacket, light green tight-fitted pants, and a brown bow hung upon her shoulder with a quiver full of arrows alongside.
Her long hair, which is green in color, reaches her waist, while her eyes, which can be seen from her normal blue mask, are brown in color.
"Vaelira, greet the master." Vaelira kneels down while greeting Luke in her normal silent type voice.
"Stand up, Vaelira," Luke said. Vaelira immediately stood up and moved beside him, but remains silent. "She is probably waiting for an order." Luke thought before checking her system profile.
[Vaelira — The Final Huntress]
Realm: Peak Silver Knight.
Origin Skill: The Final Hunt (S Rank)
Description:
Vaelira possesses the power to create and master legendary hunting arrows.
Unlike normal archers who improve their arrows through technique, Vaelira develops new arrows as her strength and understanding grow.
Vaelira, each arrow represents a different method of hunting. For her a prey cannot escape forever. Because every hunt eventually reaches its final moment.
As the Vaelira’s realm increases, new legendary arrows are unlocked.

"Wow, that’s some awesome description!" Luke exclaimed after reading her description and gave her an amazing look, but Vaelira just stood there quietly without responding to him. Luke shook his head. ’She seems like the silent type.’
Nyx and Myrkhal got a little surprised after reading the system info, because this person chose her own path rather than relying on an existing path, which is amazing for a normal-born.

Luke with a curios expression thought for a moment, ’Do they remember who they are?’ because when he asked Aurora, she said she doesn’t remember her past at all, only knows all the fighting techniques and defensive experience. After that he didn’t ask anyone else, but after seeing her silent behavior, while remembering the method to create an arrow-type ability, he became curious and asked her.

"Vaelira, do you remember anything about your past?" Vaelira, who was observing her new master, got stunned for a moment after hearing her master’s words. After that she tried to concentrate but wasn’t able to remember anything at all.
"NO, master." She replied. After that she turned her gaze towards the surroundings to check out if there was any danger.
Luke sighed as he expected this, and then he asked the system, and his reply was also expected.

"Just enjoy the girl, Luke. What’s the matter with where they come from? and remember all of them are virgin." The system replied nonchalantly, clearly not having any intention to tell him anything related to this.
So, with a resigned expression, he checked her abilities, and just as he expected, every single one of them was crazy.
Current Unlocked Arrows:
1. Titan Breaker Arrow
Description:
A legendary arrow technique created to hunt massive creatures.
The arrow does not gain power through magic, aether, or energy compression.
Instead, after being released, the arrow undergoes a transformation, rapidly growing into a gigantic arrow carrying overwhelming physical force.
Effects:
• Massive size increase after release
• Extreme impact force
• Breaks through heavy defenses
• Designed to kill giant monsters and powerful enemies
• Uses pure momentum and destructive force
"Crazy!" That’s the word that escaped Luke’s mouth, and he completely ignored the name part, which is saying "Titan breaker."
Why did he say crazy? ’Because who is not a fan of massive attacks?’ Total destruction is the best attack one can have.
Nyx and Myrkhal just read system info calmly, likely not impressed by size-related power. But Luke didn’t care and checked her second arrow.
[Chapter End]
