chapters.title: Chapter 78: When the Storm Answers Her Call
paragraphs: 2. Eclipse Arrow
Description:
A legendary hunting arrow that hides its existence by absorbing surrounding light, which makes the arrow almost impossible to detect before reaching its target.
Effects:
• Suppresses aura presence
• Removes visible trajectory
• Hides the attack from enemy senses
• Perfect for killing unaware targets
• Stronger when fired from concealment
"Nice." Luke nodded, satisfied with the assassination-type arrow, and gave a look toward Vaelire, who was looking around with wariness.
3. Skyfall Arrow
Description:
A legendary arrow technique where the Vaelira fires a single arrow into the sky, causing it to transform into countless arrows that descend upon the battlefield.
Effects:
• Creates a rain of arrows
• Covers a large area
• Forces enemies out of hiding
• Controls enemy movement
• Attacks multiple targets simultaneously
"Ok, another nice area damage skill." Luke smiled and finally read her Ultimate, which is also called the Origin Skill.
Ultimate Ability - Celestial Hunt: Final Descent
Description:
The final technique of the S Rank Origin Skill — The Final Hunt.
Vaelira after combining the power of all mastered legendary arrows, does not fire toward the enemy. Instead, she sends the final arrow toward the heavens.
For her the sky itself becomes the hunting ground. Next moment the arrow returns as a celestial execution, carrying the combined power of every hunt before it.

Titan Breaker Arrow provides overwhelming physical force with it’s gigantic size. While Eclipse Arrow hides the attack within darkness and finally the Skyfall Arrow grants the power of heavenly descent.
Together, they create a single unavoidable strike. Known as The final moment of the hunt.
Effects:
• Combines all unlocked arrow abilities
• Massive physical destruction
• Hidden trajectory
• Unavoidable finishing strike
• Maximum power against a single target
{Note: This description is according to current unlocked arrows.}
"Why don’t I have anything like this??" Luke got jealous after seeing her ultimate ability because it was too broken.
’Just think, if someone dropped a gigantic arrow from the sky at overwhelming speed and the arrow was almost invisible.’
So the moment it collides with the enemy, it will gonna die immediately unless he has a very tough body or amazing speed to dodge the attack.
"Vaelira, let’s go," Luke said to her while moving toward the direction of the closest golden chain.

"huff...huff...huff..." Inside the forest, Nyra was running; her breathing was rough, which suggested she had been running for a long time. And there is a large claw wound on her back, from which blood was constantly coming out.
"What’s happening? Is my birthday cursed? First there was that interruption, and now teleporting to this strange place." Nyra cursed with an exhausted face.

RUSTLE! RUSTLE! Leaves and branches moved aside as more than ten demonic beasts appeared. Which look like normal wolf-type beasts, but their eyes were red and minute dark miasma was coming out of their bodies.

Among them were the ten Wild Beast Realm demonic beasts which was equivalent to the Iron Knight Realm, and they were 4 feet tall, while two Savage Beast Realm demonic beasts was equivalent to the Bronze Knight Realm, and they were 5 feet tall.
They were chasing Nyra from the moment she appeared in this place and were hell-bent to shred her into pieces.
"ROARRR!" two wild realm wolves jumped toward her back, with their claws extended.
Nyra turned slightly towards the upcoming beast, then three metal daggers appeared in her hand from the spatial ring.

With a little bit of her strength, she throws them toward the charging beast. But the next moment winds appeared around the dagger, which instantly increased the dagger’s speed, and then lightning surrounded them, which further increased their speed.

FWOOSH—CRACKLE! With a crackle sound, they tore through the air and struck both wolves, who, upon getting hit, got electrocuted and paralyzed, and with a thud, they dropped to the ground. While the remaining wind-lightning-covered dagger flew toward the savage wolf beast, but with a sway of his hand, it easily struck it down.

"tch...my power is not enough to harm the savage beast." Nyra clicked her tongue and muttered with a anoyyed expression because she was already running on low aether, and she also didn’t bring any supplements or potions with her.

BOOOOM! While Nyra was cursing her bad luck, the savage wolf behind her suddenly released a burst of terrifying strength. The ground beneath its feet shattered as it pushed forward, its massive body launching toward her like a raging beast unleashed.
’This is bad!’ The thought flashed through Nyra’s mind as she quickly turned sideways and threw ten daggers covered in wind and lightning toward the incoming savage wolf.
"Die!" With a shout, she released her fully charged Tempest Shot. The daggers tore through the air, carrying the power of her attack, and struck the beast directly.

THUD!!! But to her horror, the only sound that echoed was a dull impact. The daggers, even while infused with her fully charged Tempest Shot, failed to pierce the savage wolf’s tough hide. And the beast’s leather-like skin remained untouched.
Even after the attack, the incoming savage wolf’s speed didn’t slow down, and with a maddening charge, it reached toward Nyra.

CRASH! A deafening crash echoed through the area as the savage wolf’s claws struck the ground where Nyra had been standing just a moment ago. The impact shattered the earth, sending cracks spreading outward while dust and debris exploded into the air.

Nyra, who had barely managed to dodge the deadly attack, landed a short distance away. But her expression turned serious as she looked toward her right hand. There a deep claw mark had torn through her clothes and skin, with blood continuously flowing from the wound and dripping onto the ground.
The sharp pain reached her a moment later, reminding her just how close she had come to being ripped apart.

"I have to use it now," Wind told her, explaining that there were many enemies lurking around; that’s why she was not using her origin ultimate skill untill now. Even though she can’t defeat Savage Beast with her skill, at least she can gain enough time to escape.
But right now, hidden enemies were waiting for her to use her ultimate ability, so after she got exhausted, then they would reap the benefits.
She gritted her teeth with an ugly expression and finally called on her original skill. Because the remaining beast also caught up to her.
She closed her eyes and remembered what the pope had told her about her ability.

"Remember Nyra." A female pope who is wearing storm temple holy clothes and said to her in a calm tone. "Your origin is different than your father’s." She smiled at Nyra. "Your powers are locked, which is why it’s C-rank, because you are not strong enough to wield it."

She turned toward the storm god’s statue and muttered. "But you can still use the small power of your origin skill, and for that you have to form a connection with the storm and then call their power."
"BUT!" She moved close to storm god statue and knelt down. "But for that you have to become a Storm Herald, and then you can unleash its devastating storm powers."

Nyra suddenly opened her eyes, which were now shining with storm color. "ORIGIN SKILL: STORM HERALD!" She shouted while raising her left hand toward the heavens, and the next moment, the atmosphere began to change. The wind suddenly stops. The black clouds above begin gathering unnaturally fast.

"FWOOSH..." The air starts spinning around her as powerful winds spread across the forest. Small sparks of lightning begin appearing around her. "CRACKLE... CRACKLE..." The sky grows darker and the thunder echoes from above.
"RUMBLE... RUMBLE..." The pressure of the storm, forces every nearby beasts to feel the approaching danger as they look warily toward Nyra, who has become the center of the storm.

Blue lightning starts to gather within the clouds, then comes her voice; no, it’s a judgment. "ORIGIN ULTIMATE ABILITY: HEAVEN’S WRATH!!!" Nyra’s voice comes loudly, and everyone in the vicinity hears that. Next moment she bring her hand down in a swift motion.

Then—"KRRRRRAAAACK!!! " The first lightning strike descends. Then another. And another. "BOOOOOM!" Tens of lightning bolts rain down from the sky. And the forest is nearly swallowed by wind and thunder.
Every strike tears apart the ground. Every flash illuminates the storm. For that moment—she is no longer controlling the storm. She is the voice that calls it.

"Awooooooo...!" All the beasts present felt death when those lightning bolts appeared and cried out, while trying to run, but before they could run away, those lightning bolts descended instantly, and one by one, wild beast realm wolves died, while the savage beasts hastily dodged the lightning, but some lightning still stuck them. Which results the skin area becoming charred black, like coal.
"What’s happening there?" Other people who were also transported into the secret realm saw this spectacle and got goosebumps because someone who is able to summon this storm is a crazy person.

While others were guessing, Elias and Vivienne, who got teleported near each other, so they were able to find each other fast, instantly understood that Nyra was in danger and had forced to used her Origin Ultimate ability.
"We have to rescue her!" With that, both of them head toward Nyra’s location.
[Chapter End]

• Covers a large area

Vaelira after combining the power of all mastered legendary arrows, does not fire toward the enemy.

Next moment the arrow returns as a celestial execution, carrying the combined power of every hunt before it.

Known as The final moment of the hunt.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: The Demon Whisper Hidden Objective
paragraphs: The hidden demon whisper enemies near Nyra’s location felt dread watching this scene, because they were sure only peak bronze knights could come out safely from those lightning shower, but anything below would definitely get injured badly or even die.

After a moment, finally lightning storm end and only the whimper of the injured savage beast remained, because all the wild wolf beast was dead. the hidden demon whisper, who were the same people who had attacked Stormveil County and also activated the ten demonic pillar of light, the Infernal Choir, were heading toward her location.

"Do you think we can reach the Dread Apostle realm after sacrificing her to the Demon God?" One cursed adept, which is equal to a bronze knight, asked his companion with a slightly excited and hopefull voice.

There were a total of three black-robed men present here, who have a broken mask fragment beside a black flame symbol on their robes back, and all of them are in the Cursed Adept realm, which is the power system they have got by joining The Infernal Choir.

"Definitely, because the people with Origin abilities have most of the Origin of Valtharion in them, and the Demon God really loves this type of sacrifice." The other two cursed adepts laughed excitedly after hearing this, as they have just become cursed adepts, so they don’t know most of the things about sacrifices.
But the next moment, their pupils dilated, because the location where Nyra previously summoned her lightning is now empty.
"Where has she gone?" They looked around while shouting and got more confused, because they were clearly guarding the whole area and didn’t see her moving out.

Sadly the person they were finding was not here, because if they looked around clearly, then they would find a small piece of burning scroll on the ground. Which is clearly a magic scroll, then they would instantly understand. She has used a teleportation scroll.
"Uggg..." Nyra felt uncomfortable all over her body as her ultimate ability took a toll on her body.
She holds her forehead, as it’s throbbing in pain, then looks around to find where she got teleported.

"Fortunately, the father-saving item is a teleportation scroll, or else the situation can become even worse. " Nyra muttered while seeing she was beside a large river, and the surrounding trees were a little shorter than in the previous area.

"River?" She sighed in relief, but her voice still carried caution, because a river means she got water to drink and maybe found something to eat, but caution because a river means more dangerous beasts around it.
With careful steps, she reached toward the river, and after checking more than a few times and finding no one, she relaxed slightly, then removed her clothes and got naked.

"Ugggg." A pained grunt escaped her mouth when she cleaned the wound with river water. After proper cleaning and taking a bath, she bandages her back wound with difficulty while also wrapping a cloth around her right hand injury.
Then she changed into new clothes and started finding a safe place to spend the night, while also hoping to bet on the potion that Luke had given her.

"Sir Luke, will you come to save me?" She muttered hopefully as she looked down at her hand, which held a vial. Filled with black-silver potion. When he gave her this Iron Knight breakthrough potion, he mentioned that she could safely cross the realm and even stabilize the first stage of the Bronze realm.
"With this I will gain at least sufficient strength to protect myself." Finally, after a half-hour search, she found a safe cave, which doesn’t have any beasts, and settled down.
First she brings out a rainbow-colored fruit, which will help her unlock a new ability of her origin, so she eat it immediately.
After eating, her eyes turned blank as if she had lost focus. But inside her mind, a flood of knowledge about her new skill emerged, which will help her to survive in this dangerous place.
After five minutes of knowledge transfer, her eyes returned back to normal color, and a smile appeared on her face.
"Good!" She said loudly, because after her breakthrough, she will be able to gain one more skill, which brings her arsenal to three normal skills and her fourth ultimate skill.
"With this, I can find others as well." She muttered excitedly while thinking about her family, friends, and Luke.
Then she also gulped down the potion as well.
Meanwhile, in the other area, more than twenty savage bison types beasts, along with hundreds of wild bison beast bodies, who were in a demonic state, were strangled tightly by shadow.

"Ugh..." Among them were some Curse Adept members as well, because they got exposed from the start by Aurielle Shadow sense and their strength was that of peak bronze knights. But their fate was also the same; they can’t even breathe air.

"You are a monster!" A Dread Apostle, who is part of a demon whisper group called The Infernal Choir. He has brought fear and dread to many faces, and he even enjoys it, because demon gods like the broken sacrifices, but today, everything is going worse after they were assigned to kill this exiled princess.
Aurielle, who had been summoned, was now wearing the Eclipse Queen Regalia armor. And Looked coldly at the surrounding corpse and the remaining demon pawns, the person who was cursing her.

Even though the enemy is at around early silver rank strength, which nearly destroyed their convoy last time, here he was trembling and not even able to stand properly. ’Why?’ Well, because the armor she was wearing was already in the Abyss armor stage, in which an additional layer of shadow form over her armor, while giving the following buffs.
Ability V
Abyss Armor
The armor enters an overcharged state.
Effects:
* Greatly increases defense.
* Reduces damage taken.
* Increases physical strength.
* Enhances all shadow abilities.
Yes, because of this, she was able to seriously injure the Dread Apostle and also deal simultaneously with all other members.

"I thought you rats were hiding? Then why come out now?" Aurielle asked with an annoyed expression. Because now she has separated from her husband, and she is getting the feeling that Luke is definitely with other women.
"Hahaha." On Aurielle’s words, the Dread Apostle starts laughing crazily while holding his face.
Aurielle didn’t react to this reaction because she knew the power they had gained often corrupted their minds. So showing some crazy reaction is pretty normal for them.
After laughing for some time, he finally stopped and said with an excited expression.

"All heroes of this decade have been summoned, and so has our god plan!" But just as he finished speaking, Aurielle suddenly comes toward him with a blur and holds his neck tightly. "Ughhh," he grunted in pain and struggled to break, but the strength in those arms was too much for him, and he couldn’t break at all.
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 80: The Hero’s Grave Was Prepared
paragraphs: "All heroes of this decade have been summoned, and so has our god plan!" But just as he finished speaking, Aurielle suddenly comes toward him with a blur and holds his neck tightly. "Ughhh," he grunted in pain and struggled to break, but the strength in those arms was too much for him, and he couldn’t break at all.

Aurielle looked toward the struggling Dread Apostle with cold eyes because he mentioned all heroes. Though she doesn’t care about heroes of other empires and gods. But Luke is also a hero of this decade. This thought comes into her mind, which worried her most, and her eyes narrowed, then she asked him with a threatening voice if he didn’t answer, then he would face something worse than death.

"What do you mean? Tell me!" Aurielle loosened her hold on his neck slightly, but her aura deepened as the surrounding forest suddenly became more darker and the surrounding trees suddenly start covering in shadows. If someone saw this scene from above, then they would find that the small part of the forest area has become completely turn black, but some tentacles made of dark or shadow energy were waving at the sky and a dome shaped structure made entirely of shadow has formed there.

"Gulp." The Dread Apostle gulped down, because he felt a primal fear when he looked toward those shadows’ tentacles. So he knew, If he didn’t tell the truth, then his end would be something he doesn’t want.
"Our...god...plan..." "FASTER!" When he was saying it with a feared voice and was stopping more and more, Aurielle yelled at him, and he got more afraid and instantly told everything.

"Our God’s plan is to kill all the heroes before the awakening ceremony is held." The Dread Apostle’s body suddenly starts emitting smoke because he spoke something which he should not and trigger the mechanism which even he don’t know. "NO! please god no, please forgive me!" He shouted as more smoke come out of his body, but the next moment his eyes turned redish with black color included and his expression becomes frantic. then he shouted.

"You think of all this sacrifice we made for all of you!" His face, Become clearly visible as his hood got burned down by black flames which is slowly coming out of his eyes. and now his expression becomes more frantic. "ALL OF THIS WAS FOR HERO! HE WILL DIE FOR SURE! AND THIS PLACE WILL BE HIS GRAVE!"

Aurielle’s eyes become wide, and she looked around the forest. ’They prepared all this for Luke?’ Her breathing quickens and the next instant. "CRACK!" With a crack, she twisted the Dread Apostle’s neck, and his body dropped to the ground with a thud.

"This is bad," Aurielle muttered and tried to understand his words while calming her breathing, because she is afraid . Afraid something happens to Luke.: "Hero awakening ceremony held after one year; the hero was summoned." And I am sure those priests would have not told him, because he was declared talentless and they thought he would surelly die before the ceremony or they have already lost hope in Luke, even if he reached there. he will be useless.’

The more Aurielle thinks, the more confusing it becomes. She looked toward the burning body of the Dread Apostle, who seems to have triggered some kind of taboo, and now his whole body is slowly getting burned in black flames.
After that her thoughts were lost somewhere again. ’Luke is declared talentless, so why are they still targeting him?’

She shook her head and removed her overcharged armor state, before also recalling all the shadows. After that she climbed the nearest tallest tree and felt the golden chain direction, which were binding their hearts.
"I hope you are okay, darling." She muttered with a worried voice as she looked at the far distance where Golden Chains was going and also heads towards there.
Though Aurielle doesn’t know. The person she was worrying about was relaxing beneath the shade of a tree. While a beauty was doing all his work.
A Few Minutes Earlier.
"Achoo!" Vaelira looked toward her master, who is just sneeze badily. but didn’t ask anything, then killed another beast with her readymade arrow.

Luke felt someone was badmouthing him. but didn’t recall who, so he ignored it. He then looked around, and all he saw were the bodies of beasts from lower rank to even some with silver rank strength. But with Vaelira, only one of her normal attacks and it’s dead.
"Why they are not reducing?" Naivara muttered annoyingly while throwing another water spear toward the ape-like beast, Who was 10 feet tall with a small horn growing in the center of its head.

"Thud." His body drops to the ground, but the surrounding Blood Awakening realm beasts, which have strength equal to silver rank, become even more enraged and start throwing stones and wood branches toward her.
"Sigh." With a sigh she manifested a water barrier in the shape of a shield around her and easily blocked all the attacks.
After that she looked toward front and saw hundreds of beasts that were affected by demonic miasma, and in them many were in the blood awakening realm.
Then she turned her gaze toward one direction, and there she felt some humanoid presence, which is clearly the mastermind behind the scene.

"Should I kill them?" She muttered with an irritated expression, then looked down at her ring, which Luke had given as a gift to her. A worry appeared on her face when she thought, ’Is Luke safe?’ Then she touched her heart, which manifested a golden chain. Seeing the chains seem to close yet so far. her eyes become a little expectant and a little happy as well, with the thoughts of meeting him again.
"Can we even able to kill her?" one Dread Apostle with the Silver knight strength asked his four companion. On which they shook their heads instantly.

"Why are we even assigned to killing her? That’s a clear suicide mission," he muttered irritably because he knows what type of monster the sea princess is. "All the royals possess something that makes them strong, even though she is not the strongest, but she is not the weakest among them." Another person added with a worried voice. A chill ran through their spines because Naivara was just not looking at them, but her face also held a little smile, like she had already caught the prey.
"Do it," seeing that they can’t hide anymore. one person shouted while others nodded and attacked her with their full power.

All of them instantly activated their ability, on which their eyes turned deep red, and reddish demonic miasma covered their bodies; soon their bodies swelled a little bit, which shows they have gained some type of strength buff. Then reddish demonic Aether gathered around their hands and formed a demonic claw-shaped structure.
BOOM! BOOM! ... BOOM! The dirt beneath their feet exploded as they launched themselves straight toward Naivara, with the only one intention... that is to kill.

chapters.title: Chapter 81: The Sea Princess Finally Shows Her True Power
paragraphs: BOOM! BOOM! ... BOOM! The dirt beneath their feet exploded as they launched themselves straight toward Naivara, with only one intention... that is to kill.
Naivara saw all of this calmly and shook her head. "All of you can’t even use 100% power of your Silver Knight stage realm."
"THUD!!!" Their demonic claws collided with the Naivara water shield but only made a thud sound without doing any real damage.

"Don’t mock us!" One black-robed man roared and attacked her shield with more strength, which resulted in just a slight more ripple on her water shield. "Our gods have given enough strength, and we will get more after sacrificing you."
With that all five of bring a potion which contains a redish liquid, then with a swift motion they gulped down.

Soon two small illusionary horn appeared on their head and their body swells more. "This gives us power of half Infernal Apostle, which is equal to Golden knight. Let’s see know how you will gonna survive this!" One of them said mockingly, as their eyes become dark redish.
Naivara, even after seeing their transformation, didn’t get little worried. Because she knows that if they don’t know any series form, then they are way too weak.
"I will show you what a Royal Series looks like." She said to them, on which they got more berserk, and along with other mad beast apes, they increased their attack on her shield.
Naivara slowly raised her hand and, in a calm voice with a serene expression, uttered the words "The Ocean’s Final Authority Series."

The next moment, the Aether around her begins gathering. "SHHHHH..." as the air becomes filled with the sound of flowing water. Then a thin stream of blue ocean energy slowly starts wrapping around her arm and starts spinning faster and faster.

"WHOOSH..." The flowing current compresses. And the gentle movement of the her aether transforms into a razor-sharp blade. Soon a beautiful crescent-shaped water blade forms with a thickness of 10 cm and a height of 1 m; And it was glowing with a faint moon-blue light.

"First Form - Moonlit Tide Slash" Her calm voice echoed, But the pupils of everyone present dilated because they felt an imminent threat from that water blade. So without hesitation they turn to run, but it’s too late.

Because just her words complete it, she swings the blade toward them. "SHIIIIING!!!" With a loud shing sound, a crescent-shaped blade of Aether tears through everything. The Dread Apostle is cut in half at the start, while the blade continues its movement and cuts down the surrounding beast as well.
BOOOOM!!! Finally, the compressed ocean force explodes as it touches the ground with a loud boom sound, leaving deep cuts and shattered ground along the way.
"Huff." Naivara took a normal breath to calm down her aether flow and looked around.
"Good," she muttered with satisfaction, as all the remaining beasts were dead or had run away, but she could clearly see the five black-robed corpses, who got cut in half.
Then she looked toward the deeper forest, as her golden chain was pointing there. "I am coming, Luke."

"Why are so many Demon Whisperers are already dead!!!" Oryn shouted at surrounding black-robed man with a angry face, then he added. "Are you guys really just a paper tiger and not have any real strength?"
The black-robed men lower their heads because they were told to follow the order of Oryn the sea prince. So helplessly they can only hear his furious words.
"Maybe they face against someone stronger?" One of the Black robbed men said with slight courage and the result.

"How dare you talk back!" With a swift motion, two Tidekeeper realm Marinthains that were his guards and have strength equal to Silver knights pierce the body of the black-robed man, and with a thud, his body slumps to the ground with a regretful expression.
"Anyone else have anything to say!" Oryn glared at everyone, on which they shut their mouths and gave one last look toward their dead companion.
"Damn it!" Oryn cursed, because what he was doing was too risky, and he bet everything on this.
"If Father finds out, then I will be dead." With a slightly low voice, he muttered and resolved his will to complete this quest and get enough power to become the next sea king.
He turned toward the remaining demon whisper people and asked them with a still displeased voice. Is the final plan ready? the plan to kill the hero?
The surrounding Black rob nodded their heads and told him. Everything was set; they are just waiting for his command.

Oryn nodded and thought for a moment, "The more sacrifice, the better will the plan be, but now it seems we have to do with what we’ve got." "Okay, start the plan." With that, all of them start moving together, towards the location of plan.

"Sir Rowan!" Cedric cried out in alarm as one savage beast was about to stab him. "WHOSSHH," but then a bronze light flashed, and in the next moment, the attacking beast’s head was separated from its body while its blood sprayed on a shocked Cedric.

"Tch," Rowan clicked his tongue in annoyance after seeing Cedric’s condition and looked around. "How can they set up a secret realm entrance in the middle of the Central District, which is guided by Count Magnus himself?" He swings his sword to remove the blood while muttering with a confused expression.

Because as far as he knows, the demon whisper group has gone quiet. From the last hero summoning that happened a decade ago. ’Are they targeting the Count family?’ He shook his head and removed these thoughts, because for him the most important thing was now to get out of this place.
"Get up, Cedric, or I am going to leave you behind." Rowan said to Cedric while moving forward and crossing the corpses of mad deer beasts.
"YES, SIR!" Cedric shouted as he hurriedly followed Rowan toward deeper forest, while observing everything carefully.
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 82: The Titan Form Was Never Complete
paragraphs: "Master." Luke was seated beneath the tree, when he heard Vaelira’s voice, and turned to her. Who was roasting meat over campfire, that she hunted down recently?
"Thank you." He thanked her after taking the food. Vaelira nodded and returned back her focus to campfire.

Luke thought, while enjoying the food, ’I am getting close to the end of golden chain, so if I follow for a few more hours, then we can meet before sunset.’ He felt the distance between the two golden chains had been reduced, and soon they would be able to meet.
"ROARR!" But as they were enjoying their meals, two beast got attracted because of food rich aroma.
"WHOSSH!!" Poor thing, before they could even see what the food was, they got impaled by two arrows, and both beasts, which were blood awakening realm equals to silver knights, got killed instantly.
Luke gave a side glance toward Vaelira, who has returned back to her work, like all of this does not matter at all.
"Vaelira, do you have any combat series, like the Human Ascension Series?" Luke thought about what Aurielle had told him.
That most of the people can reach Bronze Knight with cultivation, but reaching Silver rank is a major breakthrough. Fot that they need either Origin skills or Human Ascension series arts.

’Sadly, all these is contain by rich people and nobles. So even if someone got a ascension series it’s most of the time fake or weak one.’ Luke sighed while thinking that, and that’s why he asked Vaelira.
"No, Master." She turned toward Luke and gave this answer before returning back to work.

Luke shook his head with regret. Because Aurielle told him that depending upon the rank of Ascension Series, one has to learn one move every stage, which is not only freaking powerful but also helps them break through the realm.

"System, why did you send them without any ascension series?" Luke frustratingly asked the system. Who just gave him an annoyed glance and replied. [Luke, that’s only available after you reach peak bronze stage or silver stage; before that you can only get Ascension Series separately through rewards, but all that depends upon your... Goddess Of Luck~]
After hearing the system’s playfull reply, Luke’s mood got little down, but he also felt a little hope after hearing the system’s last part.
Then he turned toward two titans and asked them if they have something like this that they can bestow.

Nyx, after hearing his question, shook his head and said in a normal tone. "Luke, we titans don’t have any limitation regarding realm breakthrough, so we never made something like this Ascension Series." Nyx paused slightly, then continued.

"And the things about special moves, you have already got from mine... by your system. So if you master them properly, then you can reduce your stamina and aether consumption for them. and each of them will be definetly powerfull from this so-called-ascension-series..." Nyx finally said those words, which showed that he doesn’t need those special moves at all and should only focus on the ability he got from them.

Luke felt their words made sense, as he always thought, the more you have, the better you become. "But from now on I have to focus on improving my skills as well and hone them to perfection." He got motivated, but he still shamelessly looked toward Myrkhal, expecting he would also say something.
Myrkhal, who was enjoying the wind breeze, heard Luke’s voice and turned to him. After seeing Luke looking toward him with pupy eyes, he changed the subject and told him something important.

"Luke, did you notice something when you used the form transformation ability of mine?" Myrkhal asked this question back to Luke, who got confused, and then he concentrated and replayed the skill usage, and the next moment, his pupils got so large that he suddenly shouted. "System, you scammed me!!"

Vaelira who was now making some raw arrows, by sharpening wood, heard her master loud shout and turned to him. There he was cursing loudly while pointing toward air. "Master have weird habit..." with that she returned back to her work and hoping, master would return back to normal soon.
"I trust your system, and you have done this to me!" Luke cursed the system with an expression that clearly said, "You have betrayed me."
Nyx and Myrkhal watched Luke overdramatic acting or maybe real one, but didn’t say anything; they just watched the system screen, which was glitching a little bit.

Finally, after a moment, Luke got calmed down but still looked toward the system with a betrayed expression. [Luke, you are wrong; I didn’t do anything in this,] the system said, trying to appear clean, which Luke was clearly not buying, and then he added.

[Luke, your second titan formed should be supposed to be different, but by some error, the Myrkhal titan was selected.] The system explained to him about the error, whereby by mistake or something else, Myrkhal awakened but not the titan, which it should be supposed to be.
Luke got confused and turn toward Myrkhal, who was still have same smiling blue mouth and didn’t react at this.

[So, that’s why you didn’t get any ability for your form transformation titan.] the system finally finished the words, and yeah... Luke just noticed he can use transformed titan raw strength or little elemental ability, but they don’t have any skill sets in them.

So he turned toward Myrkhal for clarification. Myrkhal nodded and told him about his situation. "Luke, the form you are transforming into are normally born at a very high realm." Myrkhal paused and allowed Luke to digest this information before continuing.

"So, right now you are like a child with a very heavy hammer. which you can’t move, but you are just hiding behind and taking the benefits of its strong body." After saying this, he further explains to him that all the forms he transforms into have already peaked in their ability or have their skills inside them. It’s just he is too weak to unlock them or he need practice to unlock them.
"So if I used my form more and more while training their elemental control, I can get their ability?" Luke asked with confirmation, on which Myrkhal nodded.

"Then I have to train more after reaching back territory, inside time chamber." with the plan set, he get up. But next moment suddenly more than ten Blood awakening realm jackals beast appeared along with hundreds of savage jackals beast.
"Nice timing." Luke smiled and told Vaelira to stop and let him handle this, who was already taking out her bow.
She got confused by her master order but still nodded and climbed the tree with one jump to watch his fight.

"Myrkhal Ascension." Luke uttered those words, and the next moment his entire body changed into a 12-foot-tall, faceless white titan, but he didn’t stop there and changed again into the Voltrax titan.
[Chapter End.]

There he was cursing loudly while pointing toward air.
"Master have weird habit..." with that she returned back to her work and hoping, master would return back to normal soon.
"I trust your system, and you have done this to me!" Luke cursed the system with an expression that clearly said, "You have betrayed me."
Nyx and Myrkhal watched Luke overdramatic acting or maybe real one, but didn’t say anything; they just watched the system screen, which was glitching a little bit.
Finally, after a moment, Luke got calmed down but still looked toward the system with a betrayed expression.
[Luke, you are wrong; I didn’t do anything in this,] the system said, trying to appear clean, which Luke was clearly not buying, and then he added.

[Luke, your second titan formed should be supposed to be different, but by some error, the Myrkhal titan was selected.] The system explained to him about the error, whereby by mistake or something else, Myrkhal awakened but not the titan, which it should be supposed to be.
Luke got confused and turn toward Myrkhal, who was still have same smiling blue mouth and didn’t react at this.
[So, that’s why you didn’t get any ability for your form transformation titan.] the system finally finished the words, and yeah...
Luke just noticed he can use transformed titan raw strength or little elemental ability, but they don’t have any skill sets in them.
So he turned toward Myrkhal for clarification.
Myrkhal nodded and told him about his situation.
"Luke, the form you are transforming into are normally born at a very high realm." Myrkhal paused and allowed Luke to digest this information before continuing.

"So, right now you are like a child with a very heavy hammer. which you can’t move, but you are just hiding behind and taking the benefits of its strong body." After saying this, he further explains to him that all the forms he transforms into have already peaked in their ability or have their skills inside them.
It’s just he is too weak to unlock them or he need practice to unlock them.
"So if I used my form more and more while training their elemental control, I can get their ability?" Luke asked with confirmation, on which Myrkhal nodded.
"Then I have to train more after reaching back territory, inside time chamber." with the plan set, he get up.
But next moment suddenly more than ten Blood awakening realm jackals beast appeared along with hundreds of savage jackals beast.
"Nice timing." Luke smiled and told Vaelira to stop and let him handle this, who was already taking out her bow.
She got confused by her master order but still nodded and climbed the tree with one jump to watch his fight.

"Myrkhal Ascension." Luke uttered those words, and the next moment his entire body changed into a 12-foot-tall, faceless white titan, but he didn’t stop there and changed again into the Voltrax titan.
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 83: One Strike That Shook the Entire Forest
paragraphs: "Myrkhal Ascension." Luke uttered those words, and the next instant his entire body changed into a 12-foot-tall, faceless white titan, but he didn’t stop there and changed again into the Voltrax titan.
Soon two blazing blue-white eyes opened as a 15-foot-tall thunder titan covered in dark storm-forged metal armor appeared in the forest.
The next moment, Nullex’s armor surrounded his body as its armour extend and connected his back spines with his head horns, making the lightning flow increase throughout his body.
"Good." A metallic voice came out of Luke. and the next moment, with a loud boom, he charged toward the upcoming blood-awakening jackals’ beasts.
"Nullex, show your power!" Luke roared. the next moment the spines connected to its head horns separated, but it grew long from its upper back toward sky and expanded it’s size as well.
THUNDER RUMBLE... Suddenly dark clouds start forming above Luke’s forest area as he releases his thunder aether in the surroundings, which calls upon those storm clouds.

KRRRRAAAACK!!! The next instant, a lightning bolt in a branch shape from the above comes toward Luke, and his back spine instantly gets connected to its. "Awesome," Luke muttered because his six spines were not charged with storm lightning but were also glowing bright blue that was filled with power, which was making the surrounding blood-awakening beasts wary.
But they were still in an enraged stage because of demonic miasma. So they didn’t think much and attacked the Giant Luke.

"Come." Luke also didn’t shy away; instead, he brought both his hands forward, and the next moment, the lightning that was collected at his six spines, came into those hands before he released them forward as lightning burst.
RUMBLE... CRACK! The heavy sound of lightning travelling echoed, and the upcoming beast got electrocuted, while the savage realm beast got burned to death.
"AWOOO!" The remaining beasts cried in pain and the next moment, they gathered wind aether at their mouths. Preparing for a wind attack.

"Not so fast," Luke said, and with one step, he exploded the dirt beneath him, and his body instantly appeared near the one jackal’s beast, who was still charging a wind attack. Suddenly, the enemy appeared beside them. which make its panicked and it tried to release the half-completed wind attack toward the enemy. but-

CRUNCH! A skull-breaking sound echoed because Luke’s giant punch had hit its head directly resulting it’s head exploded and all the matter inside exploding outside, then its body dropped to the ground lifelessly with a thud sound.
As Luke blasted apart one Blood Awakening realm beast. The remaining beasts finally completed their attacks and attacked him with their wind bomb skill.

WHOOM! Lightning burst around Luke’s body, and he instantly dodged the incoming attack. KRAAAASH!!! And the previous area, where he was moments ago, got blasted apart. Forming a 1 meter deep pit on the ground.
"Their attacks sure contain punch," Luke joked and tried to calm himself down because those attacks are like cannons from tanks, which have tons of lethal power.
Vaelira, from above, saw everything and got surprised. Because this is the first time she has seen her master’s power, and all that makes her confused.

Because Master is only a first-stage iron knight, so how is he exerting peak silver knight strength? and the first attack he did almost reached half-stage golden knight? So if some blood-awakening monsters had not dodged, then they would have been seriously injured. "Interesting." This word escaped her mouth without even her noticing.

"He is still not using enough." Myrkhal, who was with Nyx and sitting on a nearby tree branch. Muttered after seeing this. "He will learn it. " Nyx said because he had seen in his life, what the real thunder titan can do on the battlefield.
"Another one, Nullex," Luke roared while punching another blood-awakening beast and shouted to Nullex.
Nullex understood what Luke wanted, and soon another storm cloud gathered, but this time it was larger than before.
"Hahaha, we are going all out!" Luke laughed crazily and jumped straight toward the sky and shouted. "Bear my wrath!"

"RUMBLE... RUMBLE..." The dark storm clouds trembled. And released it’s all stored thunder. Which gathered around Luke as his six spines on the back began collecting those crackling lightning. " CRACKLE... CRACKLE..."

Blue sparks danced across his body as his armor channeled the rising lightning upward, guiding it toward his head. Soon, the horn-like crown on his head became fully charged, radiating the terrifying aura of a storm about to descend.
The blood-awakening jackals’ beasts below froze. As their instincts screamed danger. But it was too late.
Then—
"THUNDERFALL!"
Luke motioned with a hand, brought it down, and released a large concentrated beam of lightning toward the ground.
"KRRRRAAAAAACK!!!
The sky split apart. And a massive pillar of lightning descended from above and crashed into the forest.
"THUNDEROUS CRASH!!!" The entire forest shook. While the ground exploded on impact.

"BOOOOOOM!!!" A huge crater formed beneath the lightning strike. And the surrounding 60-70 meter tall trees around the impact zone shattered instantly, their trunks breaking apart from the overwhelming force.
The earth cracked in every direction as lightning spread across the ground like countless electric snakes.
ZZZZRAAAAT!!!

All nearby beasts were swallowed by the lightning snakes. While some stragglers that were fleeing for their life instantly caught inside the lightning field, and their bodies disappeared beneath the violent thunder.
The once peaceful forest now became a scene of destruction. as the only burning trees. broken ground. And a battlefield covered in the aftermath of Luke’s thunderous wrath remains.

"..." Vaelira got completely shocked and silent by this destruction. Because her master this attacked touched the threshold of a normal early golden-stage attack. As they are known as cities’ destroyers for a reason, now her master has done that with his iron stage realm cultivation.
"Master, you are the strongest iron knight in the world." When Luke got down and looked around with satisfaction at the destruction he caused, he heard Vaelira’s shocked voice.

"Haha, I know, but sadly this attack is a combined form of Nullex and me." He muttered while running his hand through his his titan head. But he knows he can’t be able to do this type of attack anymore and needs to rest at least one hour.

"Well... well... we have some guests." But suddenly Luke turned toward one side, where Vaelira was also looking. Because there were two people whom he really wanted to kill but didn’t get the chance to, and now in this place, this is the perfect opportunity.

"It’s a great pleasure meeting you again, Sir Rowan and Sir Cedric." A sinister smile appeared on the giant Luke’s face, while Rowan and Cedric cursed themselves, because they suddenly got curious about lightning attacks and came to enjoy the spectacle and now they are going to regret this decision.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 84: They Came to Watch the Lightning... And Found Death
paragraphs: "It’s a great pleasure meeting you again, Sir Rowan and Sir Cedric." A sinister smile appeared on the giant Luke’s face, while Rowan and Cedric cursed themselves because they suddenly got curious about lightning attacks and came to enjoy the spectacle, and now they are regreting this decision.
Five minutes earlier.

BOOMM! Rowan and Cedric, who were carefully moving forward, got stunned by the sudden explosion sound, but the next scene shocked them even more. In the distance, large dark storm clouds have gathered and are constantly releasing lightning toward the ground.
’Is there any treasure being born?’ This thought comes into Rowan mind as his brow furrows. Cedric from the side was also the same, but he controlled himself and didn’t say anything.

"What do you think?" Rowan turned back and asked Cedric, his opinion on this. Cedric paused and thought for a moment, before nodding and shared his views well. Which were the same for both people. So they decided to take the risk and approach the thundering site.

"HOLY HELL!!" After few minutes later when they reached the site. Both of them exclaim after seeing the scene of the battlefield. Because in the sky a giant being was being bombarded by lightning, but his body was not taking damage. Instead, he seems to be charged.

"Sir, is this not the same as Luke’s giant form?" Cedric, from the side, whispers in a low voice to Rowan. Who also came out of his shocked state and focused on the giant. ’Yeah, he is the same. It’s just now there, an additional armor-like object clinging to his body. He confirmed, but this discovery made his face pale. Because he has a long-standing feud with Luke, and now they are at the same place. Where he is wreaking havoc.
"THUNDERFALL!

Finally, both of them heard Giant Luke’s thunderous voice, and then came the destruction that they had only seen caused by the Golden Knights. ’Crazy!! Only this thought comes into their minds. after feeling his powerful attack.
Because even though they are almost 1 kilometer away from the impact area. But their surrounding trees’ leaves were violently shaking, as if the next moment they would also be blown away.
"Sir, let’s go." Cedric spoke in a low, trembling voice. Rowan’s expression had already turned ugly after seeing the destruction, So after hearing Cedric words, he slowly nodded.
Then two of them immediately turned around and prepared to leave. Or at least, they tried to—
Until a voice came from behind them.
"It’s a great pleasure meeting you again, Sir Rowan and Sir Cedric." Instantly color left both of their faces because it seems that Luke has already found out their places.
Present time.

"Now that we have met, don’t you think we should greet each other, Sir Rowan?" Luke took one step after another toward them and muttered these words with a chilling tone. But the voice comes out with a metallic friction sound.
Vaelira from the side. Just observed and didn’t interfere because it seems the master wants to deal with them by himself.
"Sir Luke... What’s there to be greeting about? We were just passing through, so don’t mind us and continue your fun."
Cedric, from the Rowan side, muttered those words, with a pause in between them, and added the last word. After noticing a blue mask, women with long green hair were behind Luke.
Luke, who was moving playfully toward them, got stunned, and a sweat formed on his giant thunder titan under the armor.
’If Aurielle has heard his words, then I am sure I have to sleep outside for a whole week.’ He shook his head to remove those scary thoughts.

"But I can’t let you go, as there are many things you have done that displeased me." Luke continued his step while muttering those cold words, which brought sweat to both Rowan’s and Cedric’s foreheads.
Then Luke added another sentence. "But, Sir Rowan..."
The metallic voice paused, and the friction of his armor echoed heavily through the forest. "You should not have touched my wife."
The final words came out colder than before. The heavy metallic sound of his voice carried a chilling pressure, causing the atmosphere around them to become suffocating.
’This is bad. What should I do?’ Rowan thought worriedly because now he was sure Luke wanted to kill them. As he could feel, Luke’s killing intent was increasing with each step.
Cedric from the side also felt the threat, but instead of getting shut down. He retorted or tried to reason with Luke.
"Sir Luke, we are nobles. So you can’t kill us, or else the kingdom and empire will hunt you down!" Cedric said his last word with a slightly raised voice.
Luke, who is just 100 meters away from them, Paused on Cedric’s absurd words and turned to look back toward Vaelira.
Vaelira saw her master was looking toward her after that person’s words. She got confused by Luke looks and didn’t undestand, what he was asking, so she just nodded her head.
Luke with a sigh returned his gaze toward the front. Because expecting Vaelira to understand his joke is hard for her, at least now.
Rowan, who was beside Cedric, also got stunned and turned to give him an idiot look. Cedric got confused by that look, but then both of them heard Luke’s mocking voice.
"If some beast attacked and killed both of you, then what’s my fault in that?" Cedric’s face got pale after hearing this, while Rowan just shook his head.

BOOM! Luke released lightning toward his foot and shot straight at Rowan and Cedric. "Damn it." Rowan cursed, seeing this, and immediately activated his C-rank origin skill, Earth Shell. The next instant, he felt the connection form with the surrounding ground, and he summoned a shield to stop charging Giant Luke.
"Earth Shield!" Rowan shouted as he raised his one leg slightly, then slam the ground and sent his aether toward it.

"KRRRACK!" A large 10-foot-tall stone wall appeared in the front, which still seems dwarfed against giant Luke. ’But Earth shields have thickness which shoul—’ BOOM! Rowan’s thoughts were interrupted as Luke easily destroyed the Earth Shield and appeared in front of him.

’Silver knight rank physical strength?’ His eyes got wide; he could feel the aura Luke was emitting still belonged to a first-stage iron knight. ’Then how is his strength silver stage?’ His thoughts again interrupted as Luke’s fist now heading toward his face.

"DON’T UNDERESTIMATE ME!!!" Seeing the situation getting worse, Rowan shouted in anger. He couldn’t stand being looked down upon—especially by someone whose realm was lower than his own yet was completely overwhelming him.
His pride refused to accept it. "ORIGIN ULTIMATE FORM: EARTH GIANT!" Rowan roared, while unleashing his ultimate ability.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 85: HE LOST THE BATTLE, BUT HIS FINAL TRAP COULD KILL LUKE
paragraphs: "ORIGIN ULTIMATE ABILITY: EARTH GIANT!" Rowan shouted as he barely avoided Luke’s attack with a desperate roll across the ground.

But the next instant, "RUMBLE... RUMBLE..." The earth starts rising around his body and begins to move. " CRACK... CRACK..." Earth below his foot cracked as it’s attached to his body, and layers of stone and earth wrap around his arms, legs, and chest. But it’s not stopped after wrapping instead. The shell continues forming, becoming thicker and heavier.
As the transformation completed, a 10-foot-tall earth giant appeared at the place of Rowan, as its body is now fully covered, and Rowan can feel that his strength is increased by a large margin.
"NOW DIE!" He shouted while punching toward Luke face with huge force and already expecting that Luke’s giant form’s physical strength would definitely be lower than his Earth giant body.
Luke felt the change in Rowan’s confidence. But even then... He still didn’t take him seriously.
A faint smile appeared on his face. "Nullex." He whispered And The next instant—

The armor covering Luke’s right arm began changing. "KRRRRR..." The black storm cloud started moving, twisting, and reshaping itself. As the dark metallic fragments flowed across his arm like living armor.
"CLANK... CLANK..." The armor extended outward. And the metal gathered at its edge and then compressed. And finally formed into a massive warhammer.

"BOOOOOOM!!!" A heavy black hammer appeared in Luke’s hand. In which lightning-like patterns crawled across its surface. "CRACKLE... CRACKLE..." Dark thunder energy leaked from the weapon, making the surrounding air tremble.
He lifted the storm metal hammer onto his shoulder with a smile. "Nice," and those words escaped his mouth, and then he tightened his grip on the war hammer.
Black-blue aether surged through his arms. While the muscles in his body tensed as he gathered his full strength.
Then—he swung. The war hammer tore through the air and rushed toward Rowan’s Earth Giant form with overwhelming force. "BOOOOOOM!!!" The hammer and the massive stone fist collided.
For a moment, everything went silent. Then— "KRAAAAAAASH!!!" A violent shockwave exploded from the impact point. As the surrounding dirt erupted into the air.

"BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!" The ground cracked beneath their feet as the force of the collision spread outward. While the nearby trees shook violently from the shockwave. Even the air itself seemed to distort for a moment.

Cedric, who had already moved a safe distance away, was still caught by the shockwave. "—! And before he can even shout out in alarm. " FWOOOOOSH!!!" His body got blasted backward. Meanwhile...

The Earth Giant’s massive arm began cracking. "CRACK... CRACK..." Small pieces of stone started breaking apart. Then—"KRRRRRAAAACK!!!" The entire earth shell around Rowan’s fist shattered. ’What!’ Rowan’s eyes widened seeing this scene.

But The war hammer didn’t paused at Rowan reaction and continued forward; because the force was too overwhelming, it destroyed the Rowan Earth Giant’s hand... completely and also the real arm beneath it. "Ughh..." Rowan cried out in pain when he felt his entire hand was gone.
But before he could further react—"BOOOOOOM!" The remaining force blasted through his body. Then his giant earth armor also broke apart as he was sent flying backward.

Rowan’s body crashed heavily into the ground. "KRAAAASH!!!" As the earth exploded beneath him, forming a large crater where he landed. Dust covered the battlefield, and for a moment... only the sound of falling rocks remained.
Rowan’s vision is also filled with blood, as his earth giant body is now half-destroyed. And Only his chest part and left hand have some earthly armor left.
After taking a rough breath. He tried to get up because he heard the footstep of Luke coming. STEP! STEP! STEP!
Luke made a holding gesture as Aether flowed toward his hand, and soon a lightning bolt formed at his hand.
"CRACKLE!" A crackling sound can be heard, and Rowan got terrified as he finally felt the threat of death so close.
"NO!" He cried out, but Luke threw the lightning bolt straight toward his heart. STAB! The lightning bolt pierced his earthly armor, then his heart.
"Ughh..." A last pained grunt escaped Rowan’s mouth as his raised hand got slumped to the ground.
Luke slowly come close to Rowan body and looked down at his eyes, which were staring back at him with both regret and hatred.

A satisfied smile appeared at Rowan’s lips. then those memory, where Oryn give him this.

’Whatever, atleast Luke is going to die here for sure.’

while Rowan was thinking those. the system panic voice reached Luke. [Luke, run! That’s an explosion magic scroll containing a golden knight-level attack! Your titan body even with Nullex armor will not be able to survive that!]

The spine armor got reduced, while his whole armor extended and changed into something like cutting armor, which will reduce air resistance. His foot downside also changed to a more grip-holding-like structure, while six small nozzle-like structures formed at his back, which will release lightning to move forward.

ZRRRZT... ZRRRZT... Blue sparks danced across black-blue armor, and its speed increased as he ran away from the glowing time bomb. While the six small nozzles keep releasing lightning, which also further increased his speed to extreme levels.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: A Dead Enemy’s Final Gift
paragraphs: Cedric gains consciousness a few seconds later after the impact, and saw a confusing scene in front.
Luke’s giant body armour instantly changing, while he was turning back and runing away from the Rowan body, who was holding a glowing magic scroll is his hand.

’Wait... magic scroll?’ Cedric’s eyes widened, and he concentrated on the magic scroll and nearly felt his soul leaving his body. Because Rowan, with a smile, was holding an explosion-type magic scroll.

"Crazy!! How the hell did he get this level of magic scroll?" As he was cursing Rowan and his whole generation, while keep trying to stand up and run away from that lunatic. Who wants to take everyone with him.
He suddenly recalled the previous interaction with the Oryn. "You will need this..." Oryn gave something to Rowan.
On that time he got confused. ’But now its seems that Oryn gave him this magic scroll at that moment.’
"Damn it!" A curse again escaped his mouth recalling this and he instantly ran in the opposite direction from Luke’s.

WHOOSSH! But as he just start sprinting, one normal wooden arrow without any metal head suddenly came toward him from behind and impaled his leg to the ground. "UGHHHHH!" a pained grunt escaped his mouth and he cursed "Why now?"
With an ugly expression and a face filled with pain, Cedric forced himself to turn back.
There, he saw the blue-masked woman calmly lowering her bow, while Luke had already reached her side and grabbed her by the waist.
The next moment, Luke’s speed increased even further as he carried her away, leaving the area behind.

"Is this the end?" Cedric, with a lost voice, muttered because he tried to remove the arrow, and it didn’t budge at all. "I am going to die?" Fear finally appeared in his eyes when he remembered how fulfilling his life was, and now he is going to lose everything.
But then a face appeared in his mind, the same face. After he met it, everything went down, and now he is also going to die as well.
"I CURSE YOU, LUKE VOIDHEART!!!" Cedric shouted with all the strength left in his lungs in his final moments. Before the next instant—everything was swallowed by a blinding white light.

Luke, who was holding Vaelira by her waist, heard Cedric curse, but he didn’t slow down at all because his instinct was still screaming at him that danger was behind. And the next instant he felt the whole atmosphere tremble, and then an explosive shockwave came from behind.

But his speed was very fast and everything became blur for him, it’s so fast that even the shockwave wasn’t able to touch him. Few seconds later, he finally heard the sound, followed by the explosion.
BOOOOM!!!
He felt the surrounding ground tremble, while nearby trees shook violently because the explosion shockwave finally reached them.
Eventually the shockwave calm down and he released his titan form and took a deep breath to calm down, before turning back.

In the distance, where the explosion occured, a large crater has formed. Which is nearly 100 m wide and 2-3 m deep. Nothing remains in that area. Trees, stones, everything else had been completely vaporized by explosion.
"Is this the real golden knight attack?" Luke, with a little fearful expression, asked back toward everyone: Nyx, Myrkhal, Vaelira and the system.

Because when he earlier used the thunderfall attack, by overexploiting his aether and combining it with Nullex help. He thought he finally reached the Golden Knight attack level, but now seeing this, his confidence wavers fully.

[Luke, that explosion magic scroll attack was equal to peak golden knight full power and close to half diamond knight stage. In terms of raw power,] the system explained to him while trying to calm him down and told him not to get demotivated, because one day he will also be able reach that damage with just one swing of his hand.
"Ok," Luke nodded and replied with less demotivated voice. On which Vaelira gave her master a confusing glance. ’One moment he was talking to air, and then the next moment he said another thing.’
"Are you alright, master?" Vaelira came close to Luke and touched his forehead while asking worriedly. Thinking that maybe seeing the attack of this level has left him with trauma.
Luke, who had just got calm, suddenly got startled by a sudden touch and looked at Vaelira’s brown eyes, which now seemed a little worried about him.
Luke smiled at Vaelira and shook his head while telling her that he is all right. After that they found a place to rest for a while. Before they can plan for the journey again.

"Loot checking time." Luke muttered excitedly while looking toward the spatial ring which he got from Rowan’s hands. Sadly Cedric’s body, along with the ring, was lost in an earlier blast or else it would be more better.

Vaelira, from the side was trimming wood to make more arrows while leaning against the tree. though her partial attention was still on her master, and when she saw his excited expression a thought come into her mind. ’Does he like rings?’
Luke used his Aether to remove the imprint of Rowan before binding his Aether as a lock. After doing all this, he checked inside the ring and found out its size was 10 cubic metres.
It’s filled with silver and gold coins, while some health potions, Aether potion and stamina potion were also there.

Other than that, some spare clothes can also be seen and a few armours along with normal weapons without any grade. "It’s still good." Luke nodded with satisfaction, because something is better than nothing.
After that he counts the amount of coins, which were 10,000 silver coins and 1,000 gold coins.

"I am rich!" an excited exclaimation escaped his mouth and a big smile appeared on his face. Because from the moment Luke entered this secret realm and summoned Vaelira, he literally did not feel any life-threatening situation, except the situation with the magic explosion scroll earlier, and now finding even loot with that is really amazing.
Though, if Luke really finds out the hidden plans of demon whisper group, which is going to take everything from him, then he would not be that happy.
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 87: The Silent Huntress Meets The Sea Princess
paragraphs: Nyra, after completing her successful breakthrough. Start her searched for other people, and soon she found some noble, knights and maids who were teleported together.

After that all of them move together and keep continuing their search. During their journey they fight many mad beasts of different types, but fortunately none of the people get seriously injured, which prevents their journey from getting slowing down.
"Where are we even heading?" After walking half hour, some of the nobles got fed up and asked Nyra. She stopped upon hearing this.

And After taking a brief look at the surroundings. finding that they are still inside the giant forest and do not have any clue regarding how to escape this secret realm yet, which demotivates almost everyone.
"We have to move; it doesn’t matter where... but we have to." Nyra try to motivate everyone and said this and soon everyone started moving again - BOOMMMM!!!
But just as they moved, all of them heard a deafening sound. which forced some people to stumbled as they fall backward.
"Holy mother!" someone among the crowd exclaimed after seeing a gigantic mushroom cloud that had formed far in the distance.

Others also followed his gaze and become terrified after witnessing this. Finally a few seconds later. "Should we... approach that explosion?" One knight asked while trembling, because moving without any purpose can be dangerous, but going toward the explosion location can also be dangerous.
Nyra also looked worriedly toward the massive mushroom cloud and got a little conflicted about the decision. Everyone was staring at the Nyra, waiting for her decision.

Felling everyone stares, makes her little uncomfortable. "Nyra!" But then an excited voice came from the distance, and everyone almost simultaneously turned their heads. There Elias Duvall and Vivienne Duvall were coming excitedly toward Nyra.

"Brother! Mother!" A big smile blossoms on Nyra’s face. And she hurriedly ran toward them. "I missed you, Mother." Nyra hugged Vivienne and spoke with a little sad voice, on which Vivienne’s expression also got sad, and she rubbed her back gently with a smile on her face.
"I am here, so everything will be alright." Vivienne said to her in a loving voice, and Nyra’s body, which was tired from all those chases and now leading a group of people, finally relaxed somewhat.
Elias from the side watched this but didn’t interrupt; instead, he observed the mushroom cloud and said to everyone.

"We are going toward the explosion location. After finding what’s happened, we can decide further!" Other nobles, knights and maids nodded, while Vivienne and Nyra just listened. Soon everyone starts their marching towards the explosion location.

"What’s happened?" Aurielle watched the mushroom cloud with a wary expression and felt her golden chain was also pointing toward that side, which increased her worry. Because earlier, the demon whisper man said that their plan was the hero sacrifice, and now this big explosion.

Margaret and other Blackstone’s Highlands legions’ knights were also watching the mushroom cloud with different expressions. Aurielle has found Margaret before, so she gathers up all her territory people whom she has found along the way.

"My lady, what should we do?" Kai came in front, and with a respectful bow he asked her. Aurielle came out of her thoughts but still didn’t turn back toward them. Instead, she ordered everyone to pack up their things, as they are heading toward it.
Everyone nodded in agreement and packed up their things before heading toward the explosion direction.

Though, if someone saw their groups, one question would sure come into their mind. "Did she only get her people? "What about other nobles and knights?" Well, the answer is simple: Aurielle didn’t take others into her group because most of them didn’t respect her husband, and also she didn’t have any positive view toward other nobles because of a past territory incident. So she left them and only grouped up with her people.

"Tch... what a failure," Oryn muttered with disdain while looking toward the mushroom cloud. He knows only Rowan can do this type of attack. After all, he has given him that magic scroll, but seeing the small crystal ball in his hands is still burning with the blue flame; he knows that Luke is still awake.
"Everything is ready?" He asked after turning back. There’s a massive 100-foot-tall beast lying on the front.
Many parts of its body were rotted, so its skeletons could be seen from outside.
"Yes, sir, after half an hour it will wake up, and soon everyone will die." One black-robed man from the Infernal Choir came forward and said it with a normal tone.

Oryn nodded, and together with the others, he moved toward the distant forest. Behind them, the corpse of the massive beast remained motionless, its body slowly being covered by a thick reddish miasma.
And ten large crimson crystals were embeded in its body. connected directly to its heart, forcing it to beat once every minute as if the dead beast was still being kept alive by some unknown force.

After Oryn and others moved away from the place. the surroundings distorted, everything was covered with trees, and the beast inside became invisible. So even if someone comes here before 30 minutes, they will not find anything.
Naivara also saw a mushroom cloud. And instantly head toward it, because her golden chain is pointing in that direction.

After travelling some distance, she saw Luke was seated beneath the tree and grinning like an idiot while looking at the ring in his hand. Then her gaze shifted toward the other side; there a green-haired woman in a blue mask was sitting beside the tree, while her bow with an arrow mounted was pointed toward her.

Vaelira sensed something was coming with fast speed, but she didn’t attack. Instead, she observed the upcoming person, as she didn’t sense any malice or killing intent from her. But still, for her master’s safety, she knocked an arrow on her bow and pointed toward her.

The person is a beautiful woman. When she first arrived, she observed her master with a gaze that she coundn’t understand. Then she looked toward her with an expression clearly asking, ’Who is this woman?’
[Chapter End.]

There’s a massive 100-foot-tall beast lying on the front.
Many parts of its body were rotted, so its skeletons could be seen from outside.
"Yes, sir, after half an hour it will wake up, and soon everyone will die." One black-robed man from the Infernal Choir came forward and said it with a normal tone.
Oryn nodded, and together with the others, he moved toward the distant forest.
Behind them, the corpse of the massive beast remained motionless, its body slowly being covered by a thick reddish miasma.
And ten large crimson crystals were embeded in its body. connected directly to its heart, forcing it to beat once every minute as if the dead beast was still being kept alive by some unknown force.
After Oryn and others moved away from the place. the surroundings distorted, everything was covered with trees, and the beast inside became invisible.
So even if someone comes here before 30 minutes, they will not find anything.
Naivara also saw a mushroom cloud.
And instantly head toward it, because her golden chain is pointing in that direction.
After travelling some distance, she saw Luke was seated beneath the tree and grinning like an idiot while looking at the ring in his hand.
Then her gaze shifted toward the other side; there a green-haired woman in a blue mask was sitting beside the tree, while her bow with an arrow mounted was pointed toward her.
Vaelira sensed something was coming with fast speed, but she didn’t attack.
Instead, she observed the upcoming person, as she didn’t sense any malice or killing intent from her.
But still, for her master’s safety, she knocked an arrow on her bow and pointed toward her.
The person is a beautiful woman.
When she first arrived, she observed her master with a gaze that she coundn’t understand.
Then she looked toward her with an expression clearly asking, ’Who is this woman?’
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 88: LUKE’S NEW SUMMONED BEAUTY CAUSED TROUBLE
paragraphs: Luke, who was lost in thought about buying different things with that money, didn’t notice Naivara’s arrival immediately.
Only after a few seconds later he found that she was here and was doing a staring contest with Vaelira, who surprisingly wasn’t losing in that.
’What I am thinking.’ He shook his head to remove those unnecessary thoughts before happily approached Naivara.
"Naivara", Naira removed her eye contact from the blue-mask girl when she heard Luke’s voice. But before she could turn toward him, Luke without warning hugged her tightly. "Thank god you are safe."
She heard Luke’s relief voice, which calmed down her heart as well. Even though this is the first time. she has gotten hugged from a man, she somehow doesn’t feel disgusted with this.

But when he said those words. Her heart also accepted his touch, that’s why she also tried to slowly bring her hand to hug him back. "I am glad that you are also ok." Those words come out of her mouth after she hugs him.

Luke smiled after hearing words, which increased even more when she hugged him. Because it’s mean, maybe she is giving a place to him in her heart. Even though he can feel it’s little, he is still happy about this.

"Luke, you can call me Naira from now on." Luke, who was smiling happily, stopped at Naivara’s words and leaned slightly back before looking at her face. "What~?" he asked her with a teasing smile, at which Naivara lowered her face slightly before muttering in a low voice. "All those who are close to me, call me ’Naira’."

Luke’s smile widened on this. after that he leaned forward slightly enough to get close to her ear, then whisper in a low voice. "Of course. If my wife wants me to call her Naira, then who am I to refuse?"

Naira’s face immediately got red while a small blush appeared on her cheeks. Luke felt Naira lower her head more and trying to hide her face in his chest. Which brings an even bigger smile to his face. like he wants to kiss her cheek right now. because she is looking so cute. Still he holds himself back. As they are not that close.

"So, Naira, have you eaten?" Luke asked with a playful tone, on which Naira gave him a glare, like, ’Don’t be so cheeky’, then said in a low voice. "No," Luke nodded with a smile and brought her toward his seat while lighting the campfire back.

Vaelira, from the side, saw all this: how a woman suddenly appeared and how her master hugged her, then said something in a low voice to the woman, who instantly melted in his arms. ’So he is a womanizer.’ This thought instantly comes into her mind.

After that she gave a last look toward her master, who is now feeding the roasted meat to the blue-haired woman lovely while making some ’ahhh’ sound. before returning back toward trimming more wooden arrows.
Luke, who was busy feeding Naira, didn’t notice that he had become a womanizer in Vaelira’s eyes.

While Luke and Naira was eating their fill. Vaelira was facing other problem, because without thinking she have made more than hundreds of arrows. Which now worrying her. ’Now where would I hold all these arrows?’ She looks pitifully toward her small quiver, then toward piles of arrows.
Luke after feeding Naira. Turned toward Vaelira and Saw all of this, so with a smile on his face, he gave a small spatial ring to her.
"Thank you, Master." Vaelira thanked him in a normal voice while looking curiously at the spatial ring. But when she used the ring, surprisingly all the arrows got stored in this small ring.

Naira came close to Luke and asked him. "Who is she?" Luke, who was smiling while seeing Vaelira’s expression, got startled when Naira suddenly came to his side and asked him. He first took a deep breath to calm himself down, then told her. "She is a gift sent by the goddess of luck."

[0-0] Luke saw the system reaction, but he chose to ignore that, but then Naira’s slightly weird voice came. "Why women?" Luke got flabbergasted before gaving her a long look, which got her confused. "What?"

"Both of you only see women. Why can’t you just focus on the gift? See how lovable and helpful the gift she has sent is." Luke said to Naira while making a hurt face as he pointed toward Vaelira, who is now trimming another wood to make more wooden arrows.
’Huh?... Again?’ Luke’s eyes twitch at Vaelira’s behaviour. Because she has somehow become a fan of trimming wood.
Naira shook her head while seeing her husband and the Vaelira-named women, whom he had told her about. "We should go and find the exit." With that, she stood up. on this Luke also nodded.

Then after packing some utensils and more wooden arrows... the three of them start moving, but the direction choosen by Luke because he told her. "first we should find Aurielle," at which Naira’s face changes slightly, which reverts back to normal the next instant, and she nods. Seeing everyone agree, Luke guided them toward the direction Golden Chain were going.

Along the way, they encounter many beasts along with some demon-whisper groups. But all of them died with a single arrow of Vaelira, which surprised Naira to an extreme. Because she also felt the threat from Vaelira’s normal arrows.

"Now you understand how helpful she is." Luke smiled, seeing her reaction, before telling her that she can do even more. Naira gave Luke an annoyed glance, then started moving ahead. Luke got confused by her looks still sprinted to followed her.
"This way!" But as they were moving, they heard the sound of people talking from the front. with hundreds of people footsteps come toward their sides.
"Master, many humans are coming." Vaelira, with her farsight already saw this then informed Luke about it.
Luke nodded before thinking. "Other survivors?" But he still decided to hide first and observe. So soon, three of them climbed the tall tree while hiding themselves among its leaves.

"Do you think we can find the exit in time?" one noblewoman asked another, and the same discussion was happening among other people as well. Because it’s already been 3 hours since they got trapped inside this and didn’t find any hint toward an exit.
[Chapter End]
