chapters.title: Chapter 89: LUKE DISCOVERS THE SECRET BEHIND VAELIRA’S MASK
paragraphs: Nyra, Elias and Vivienne, who was at the front, also heard their gossip but didn’t say anything to calm their minds. As they were also worried, though, slightly because they felt with their strength they couldn’t clear the exit condition.
’Nyra and the Count’s family?’ Luke from the above saw all of this and got surprised but then he tried to find his knights or his people among the group.

Sadly he coudn’t able to find a single one. ’Are they not here?’ This thought comes into his mind, which also brings worry. But he still calm himself down by saying that they will be fine and maybe with other groups.

With that, he decided that they should ignore them. Because he doesn’t have any good impressions toward nobles, even though Lady Nyra is a good person. but seeing she is safe with her family. He maked this decision.
Well, at least that’s what he thought. "WHO’S THERE!" But somehow, someone among them is a perception type, who identifies their location easily, as they were not using any ability to hide.
Seeing they are already exposed. Luke, along with Naira and Vaelira, jumped toward the ground.

THUD! With a thud-sound impact, they landed safely on the ground, though some dust cloud formed, which made the surrounding nobles back away in fear of the unknown, while knights stepped forward before pointing their swords toward the dust cloud.

"Sir Luke!" But then suddenly Nyra’s voice rang out, which makes all of them got confused. ’What is he doing here?’ and the next moment they saw his figure, though he was not alone, as there were two women were also present beside him.

"Princess Naivara!" Someone from the crowd exclaims happily after identify her. Because they know that royals possessed strength way above normal knights. So seeing Naivara, they instantly understood that Luke survived because he got lucky, which is why he was safe.
Luke didn’t know about their misunderstanding, and even he knew. He would not care about them.
"Lady Nyra, I am happy seeing you are doing fine and Sir Elias and Lady Vivienne as well." Luke brought his focus to the Count family, and with a smile he greeted them.

On this Nyra’s face bloomed, before a happy smile appeared on her face, while Elias just nodded. But Lady Vivienne’s expression got conflicted. Because she now knows how her daughter became happy after seeing Luke, like she had found something which she was looking for for a long time and was now heading towards.

"Sir Luke, your potion and fruit were really helpful, for that I am very grateful." Nyra came close to Luke with a smile but she didn’t notice that Naira was also beside him and was giving her betrayed look. Like she is her friend, but now she is not even noticing her.
Luke, who was being thanked by Nyra, noticed Naira’s expression from his side eyes, which makes him embarrassed. So he took her thanks while saying she should also talk with her friend.

Luke finally got free, then he hold Vaelira’s hand to take her to far from the group and sat beside the tree. The same were for nobles, knights and maids because they were also planning to rest some time here before continuing their journey.

Luke while sitting, saw that many noblemen or women try to get close to Naivara so they can gain her protection. But this time Luke didn’t react aggressively like he did when someone approached Aurielle. As he had learned his lesson. that he has to control his emotions, or maybe he will hurt his wives one day.

"Master, are you okay?" While Luke was lost in thought, Vaelira’s slightly worried voice reached his ear. which brings him out of his thoughts. After that he turned toward and looked at her face, which still has a still-blue mask, next to her eyes, which contain genuine concern.
’Even though she is a silent type. She doesn’t seem heartless.’ this thought comes into his mind which bring a smile on his lips.

Luke told her that he was fine. On this the worry in Vaelira’s eyes lessened a bit, but Luke got curious. ’What’s behind the mask?’ He got curious about this and finally asked her the question. "Vaelira, why are you wearing the mask?"
Vaelira, who had just calmed down after hearing her master’s reply, suddenly got stunned by his question, and a blush appeared on her face inside her mask.
She looked toward master’s eyes and face, which seemed to really hold genuine curiosity.
Then she lowered her head, before saying in a weak voice. "Something... which makes both women and men fall for me...

Luke heard her low voice, but it was very low. So he leaned toward her face while trying to listen her words. And when he did, he got stunned. "What?" - a ’what’ word escaped his mouth, on this, Vaelira suddenly raised her face and became stunned.
Because her master’s face was so close to her. that she can feel his hot breath along with his manly scent, which brings even more blush to her face.

"Master..." Luke also got stunned by this situation because after summoning her, it was the first time he heard her somewhat shy and weak voice. which he never expected. "Gulp", he subconsciously swallowed, as this situation is really dangerous.

Somewhere inside Luke, [kekekeke] system was laughing like this for some time like he got a short circuit. Nyx gave the system a look - ’What a pervert’ - and made some distance from the small glowing ball of white light. which is a system.
Myrkhal on the side was sleeping with the same blank face, while his mouth was gone.
[Cough...cough...] The system coughed to hide his previous act before ignoring Nyx’s look, which seems to question his existence.
Then he muttered excitedly. [Luke, if you really saw her face, then how would you be able to control yourself? In her last life, even emperors became crazed after seeing her look once.]
System voice become even more excited while thinking about those situations and he again starts laughing like crazy. [kekekekekeke]

Nyx made even more distance, because that glowing ball of light was now laughing crazily while raising his small white-light hands in the air. ’What the hell is wrong with this pervert?’ Only this thought comes into Nyx’s mind.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 90: CAUGHT FLIRTING? LUKE FACES HIS WIFE’S JUDGMENT
paragraphs: Luke and Vaelira were lost in their world while their faces were so close that they forgot to separate.
"Cough... Cough..." But then a forced cough sound echoed, at which Vaelira got out of her trance and instantly moved her face, but a deep blush still remained on her face inside her mask.
But the same was not true for Luke, because he identified the voice of the cough. And with a slow but fearful face, he turned toward the sound, and there he accepted the reality.

"Aurielle did say that sometimes you can’t control yourself. I thought she was joking, but now it seems true~" There Naira was standing with hands folding and looking down at him with a smiling face while she said this.

"It’s a misunderstanding. Naira, your husband is innocent. you have to believe me!" Luke hastily stood up and held her shoulders while making a face that seemed to scream. ’I am the most innocent man in the world,’ while keep repeating those words to her.
From the distane Nyra’s face got flushed while seeing. that Sir Luke again captured the hearts of other women instantly. ’He is definitely a womaniser,’ she thought while blushing.

Vivienne from the side even got more shocked. ’What the hell is wrong with my daughter? That man was just clearly flirting with other women, and she is blushing like an idiot.’ She facepalmed herself.
While other noblemen looked at Luke with jealousy before thinking. ’We can’t enjoy more than one beautiful woman, and he is having a buffet of princesses.’
But noble women just shook their heads with the thought. ’pervert.’

Luke, who was declared a pervert by almost everyone, was still pleading to Naira that he was innocent. While Vaelira, on the side to hide her embaresment, was again trimming some wood to make more arrows.

But that earlier incident memory was still not going away from her. ’Why did my body get hot when I inhaled the master scent?’ She shook her head to remove those pervert thoughts while continued trimming more and more arrows.
Naira knows her husband didn’t do anything and thought it would be fun to tease him. Like Aurielle has told her at the dance party. But after seeing her husband’s reaction, she was satisfied.
still, when she looked toward Vaelira, she felt something was wrong because some arrow she made had the word "master" carved on it.

Naira’s eyes twitch at this, then one thought comes into her mind while looking at Luke’s relieved face. ’I have to make sure that he doesn’t get close to other women, or he will make them fall for him.’
She smiled at Luke while making this resolve, then held his warm hands. "Okay, husband." With a smile, she said to Luke, who got stunned by the word ’husband’ which brings a small blush to his face.

’Damn it, why are you torturing us? Go somewhere if you want to be lovey-dovey.’ Almost all noblemen, even some knights, gritted their teeth, while some gritted their napkins in their mouths. looking at this torturous scene.
After resting for an hour, everyone decided to move. But Luke decided to not go with the crowd instead only travels with his people.
Nobles and knights didn’t care about Luke’s words but looked toward Princess Naivara.
Naivara saw everyone’s reaction, on which she also chose the same and decided to go along with Luke.
Though this decision made everyone face pale, because if they could get the protection of the sea princess. Then their chances of surviving this secret realm will increase.

"Mother, I also want to go with Sir Luke," Nyra pleaded to Mother. Whose face changed to worry, but after a moment, she shook her head while declining her offer. On this that, Nyra’s face became sad. Because she wants to spend more time with Sir Luke, but now it seems difficult.

Luke saw Nyra’s sulking face so he comforted her. "Lady Nyra, we can meet again after this secret realm is over. So you don’t have to worry about us." Luke with a charming smile on his face, said to Nyra, who upon his word become shy.
While Naira just shook her head helplessly But Vaelira added another woman name to her memory who fell for her master.
Nyra, Elias, Vivienne and others watched Luke and his party’s departing figures with different expressions.
"Do you think they can find the exit of this secret realm?" Nyra asked her brother, who just shook his head before saying. "He doesn’t know."

"This forest seems weird." Aurielle muttered under her low breath after sensing the absence of any beast. At this word, every knight brings out their weapons and looks warily toward their surroundings.
Margaret also gave a worried look toward Aurielle before shifting her gaze forward. Everyone also turned their gaze because they heard the sound of footsteps, and it was more than one person.
"More Demon Whisper?" one knight asked warily, but others just kept quiet while keep focused all their attention toward the front.

After a moment, the bushes covering the front moved, and from there came a young man who had blue eyes and black hair, while beside him were two young women. One is a green-haired woman with a blue mask, while the second one is a blue-haired, blue-eyed woman.
"MASTER!!!" Immediatelyl all of them shouted excitedly. As they are very happy to meet their master.
Aurielle also smiled, seeing her husband was back, but then her eyes twitched, and a bad premonition rose in her heart while watching the green-haired woman with the blue mask. ’Don’t tell me!’
"Aurielle and everyone, I am glad all of you are safe." Luke also felt relieved, after seeing them, then he smiled and greeted everyone.
Naivara from the side just nodded toward Aurielle, who also returned the greeting with a nod. while Vaelira just quietly stands beside Luke.
After cheering for a moment, finally all knights come down and prepare to set up camp here for their master.
Aurielle, Luke and Naivara separated from the group before standing a little distance from the camp near a giant tree.
Luke wants to hug Aurielle, but he sees that Naivara is also here. So he controlled himself.
Aurielle felt Luke’s gaze and immediately understood, but she didn’t care about Naivara and tightly hugged Luke while also kissed him on his lips.

After a deep kiss she finally separated and passed a seductive comment. "Darling lips have become even more tastier than before." which instantly made Luke turn his head sideways to hide his embarrassment.
[Chapter End]

sentences.text: Luke and Vaelira were lost in their world while their faces were so close that they forgot to separate.
"Cough...
Cough..." But then a forced cough sound echoed, at which Vaelira got out of her trance and instantly moved her face, but a deep blush still remained on her face inside her mask.
But the same was not true for Luke, because he identified the voice of the cough.
And with a slow but fearful face, he turned toward the sound, and there he accepted the reality.
"Aurielle did say that sometimes you can’t control yourself.
I thought she was joking, but now it seems true~" There Naira was standing with hands folding and looking down at him with a smiling face while she said this.
"It’s a misunderstanding.

Naira, your husband is innocent. you have to believe me!" Luke hastily stood up and held her shoulders while making a face that seemed to scream. ’I am the most innocent man in the world,’ while keep repeating those words to her.
From the distane Nyra’s face got flushed while seeing. that Sir Luke again captured the hearts of other women instantly. ’He is definitely a womaniser,’ she thought while blushing.
Vivienne from the side even got more shocked. ’What the hell is wrong with my daughter?
That man was just clearly flirting with other women, and she is blushing like an idiot.’ She facepalmed herself.
While other noblemen looked at Luke with jealousy before thinking. ’We can’t enjoy more than one beautiful woman, and he is having a buffet of princesses.’
But noble women just shook their heads with the thought. ’pervert.’
Luke, who was declared a pervert by almost everyone, was still pleading to Naira that he was innocent.
While Vaelira, on the side to hide her embaresment, was again trimming some wood to make more arrows.

But that earlier incident memory was still not going away from her. ’Why did my body get hot when I inhaled the master scent?’ She shook her head to remove those pervert thoughts while continued trimming more and more arrows.
Naira knows her husband didn’t do anything and thought it would be fun to tease him.
Like Aurielle has told her at the dance party.
But after seeing her husband’s reaction, she was satisfied.
still, when she looked toward Vaelira, she felt something was wrong because some arrow she made had the word "master" carved on it.

Naira’s eyes twitch at this, then one thought comes into her mind while looking at Luke’s relieved face. ’I have to make sure that he doesn’t get close to other women, or he will make them fall for him.’
She smiled at Luke while making this resolve, then held his warm hands.
"Okay, husband." With a smile, she said to Luke, who got stunned by the word ’husband’ which brings a small blush to his face.
’Damn it, why are you torturing us?
Go somewhere if you want to be lovey-dovey.’ Almost all noblemen, even some knights, gritted their teeth, while some gritted their napkins in their mouths. looking at this torturous scene.
After resting for an hour, everyone decided to move.
But Luke decided to not go with the crowd instead only travels with his people.
Nobles and knights didn’t care about Luke’s words but looked toward Princess Naivara.
Naivara saw everyone’s reaction, on which she also chose the same and decided to go along with Luke.
Though this decision made everyone face pale, because if they could get the protection of the sea princess.
Then their chances of surviving this secret realm will increase.
"Mother, I also want to go with Sir Luke," Nyra pleaded to Mother.
Whose face changed to worry, but after a moment, she shook her head while declining her offer.
On this that, Nyra’s face became sad.
Because she wants to spend more time with Sir Luke, but now it seems difficult.
Luke saw Nyra’s sulking face so he comforted her.
"Lady Nyra, we can meet again after this secret realm is over.
So you don’t have to worry about us." Luke with a charming smile on his face, said to Nyra, who upon his word become shy.
While Naira just shook her head helplessly But Vaelira added another woman name to her memory who fell for her master.
Nyra, Elias, Vivienne and others watched Luke and his party’s departing figures with different expressions.
"Do you think they can find the exit of this secret realm?" Nyra asked her brother, who just shook his head before saying.
"He doesn’t know."
"This forest seems weird." Aurielle muttered under her low breath after sensing the absence of any beast.
At this word, every knight brings out their weapons and looks warily toward their surroundings.
Margaret also gave a worried look toward Aurielle before shifting her gaze forward.
Everyone also turned their gaze because they heard the sound of footsteps, and it was more than one person.
"More Demon Whisper?" one knight asked warily, but others just kept quiet while keep focused all their attention toward the front.
After a moment, the bushes covering the front moved, and from there came a young man who had blue eyes and black hair, while beside him were two young women.
One is a green-haired woman with a blue mask, while the second one is a blue-haired, blue-eyed woman.
"MASTER!!!" Immediatelyl all of them shouted excitedly.
As they are very happy to meet their master.
Aurielle also smiled, seeing her husband was back, but then her eyes twitched, and a bad premonition rose in her heart while watching the green-haired woman with the blue mask. ’Don’t tell me!’
"Aurielle and everyone, I am glad all of you are safe." Luke also felt relieved, after seeing them, then he smiled and greeted everyone.
Naivara from the side just nodded toward Aurielle, who also returned the greeting with a nod. while Vaelira just quietly stands beside Luke.
After cheering for a moment, finally all knights come down and prepare to set up camp here for their master.
Aurielle, Luke and Naivara separated from the group before standing a little distance from the camp near a giant tree.
Luke wants to hug Aurielle, but he sees that Naivara is also here.
So he controlled himself.
Aurielle felt Luke’s gaze and immediately understood, but she didn’t care about Naivara and tightly hugged Luke while also kissed him on his lips.
After a deep kiss she finally separated and passed a seductive comment.
"Darling lips have become even more tastier than before." which instantly made Luke turn his head sideways to hide his embarrassment.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 91: PEAK GOLDEN KNIGHT THREAT! LUKE’S LIFE IS IN DANGER
paragraphs: But talk about godshit luck; the direction he turned is the same direction Naivara was standing and now she is looking at him with a large smile. but that smile felt wrong.

"Naira." Her name escaped his mouth, on which he rubbed his hair to hide the earlier embarrassment. Fortunately Naira didn’t comment on this kiss scene, or it would have been more awkward. And when he finally felt this was over, he breathed a sigh of relief. atleast that what he thought.

"Aurielle, I know my husband is also your husband. But can you not do this shameless behaviour in front of me?" Naivara, still with a same smile on her face, said to Aurielle. who just titled her head slightly, and a smirk appeared on her face.

Aurielle moved close to Naivara then with the smirk, she said. "You misunderstood something... Naivara! Luke is my husband, and I am his wife~ So I will kiss him wherever and whenever I want~" Naivra’s smile cracked slightly when she mentioned that Aurielle is a wife of Luke and didn’t accept her as Luke wife.

"Both of you calm down... Okay." Luke, seeing the situation is getting out of control, decides to intervene, like a good husband does. But on this both of them turned toward him with a glare, which was clearly saying. "Shut your mouth."

Luke, feeling both wives glare, felt worried, so he tried to change the subject. "Naivara, you have to be careful around Oryn. I don’t know why, but I have a feeling that this trap was set by him, or at least he is involved." Luke, with a serious face, told her while keeping the secret of how he knew this.
Naira, who was glaring at Luke, suddenly got stunned after hearing his words. And the same for Aurielle as well.

’Why would he do that? I mean, he is a prince? Doesn’t this seem very risky? This thought comes into her mind because it doesn’t make any sense. But still, she didn’t ask Luke the source of this information, because if he wanted to, he would have told her.
"Ok, I will be careful." She nodded with a worried face, as she had to return home with Oryn.

Aurielle, who was also listening to this, told the information she had got from the demon whisper while keeping the hero’s awakening ceremony secret from Luke. "Luke, I have found that the demon whisper’s real target is the hero... which is you."
Luke got baffled after hearing Aurielle’s words, because why would demons target him? But she says, ’Because you are a hero.’

’Yeah, a talentless hero.’ He muttered those words in his mind and got worried, because if they have prepared to kill him inside this secret realm, then they have to face some peak silver knight strength powerhouse as well. which is Naira and some other knights, So their method definitely includes something which can take care of them as well.
[URGENT QUEST TRIGGERED.]
[Demon Whisper Hidden Objective]
[Description: The demon god wants the sacrifice of the hero, and that’s why the demon whisper set up this trap.]
[Mission: Survive the threat or escape this secret realm or eliminate the threat. Aurielle and Naivara should not die.]
[Threat level: Peak Golden Knight.]
[Rewards: Today’s return will definitely be 10,000x from both wives.]
Luke suddenly heard a system ding sound, and this urgent quest popped up, which startled him. ’This?’
Aurielle and Naira got confused by Luke’s reaction and asked him what happened. But he didn’t answer, as his whole focus was on the quest.
Seeing Luke was not answering them, both of them stopped asking and just calmly waited for him.

’Demon god! He wants my sacrifice?’ Luke’s mind went blank for a second, after reading this. Because a god is an entity which has never seen or felt their real strength. Even in the marriage hall when the saintess got possessed by the goddess of light, her aura easily suppressed everyone. but still that was not read god power.

He stopped those thoughts and, with a heavy heart, continued to read. ’Surive. Escape. Elimate.’ He repeated those words inside his mind with a worried face because he also saw the threat level, which is ’golden knight’ and not an early but a peak one.

’I am doomed.’ His face became ugly because golden knights have the strength to destroy a city if given time, and the last magic explosion scroll attack, which nearly took his life, was also equal to a peak golden knight.
Both wives show Luke’s face becoming uglier and uglier. Which worried them as well, because they don’t know what’s happening with him or what he is thinking.
"You should ask him..." Naira come close to Aurielle and in a low voice, said this to her. Aurielle’s face changed slightly, but she still nodded.

"Darling, everything is alright?" Luke, who was going to read further paused upon hearing her worried voice, then turned toward Aurielle. There both Naira and she were looking at him with worried faces, which pained his heart. Because he doesn’t want anything to happen to them.

"Huff..." He took a long but deep breath, then with a serious face, he said to both of them. "Whatever their plan is... I am going to deal with it so both of you don’t have to worry." Both wives, after hearing his serious voice, felt something was wrong.
"Luke, what’s happened?" Naira came close to Luke before asking with a questioning voice.

On which he turned toward her and just shook his head. "Nothing... you just don’t have to worry about this. Believe me I will take care of this...somehow." With a little heavy voice, he replied to her, but his voice seemed to lack confidence.

"Luke, I know you don’t want us to harm; that’s why you are saying all these, right?" Aurielle also comes close to him then hold his hands while asking this. Luke didn’t reply or show any reaction on this. But Aurielle, seeing this, got more worried, and the same was with Naira as well.
"Are you thinking us useless weight... that will drag you down?" Aurielle added these words, after seeing Luke is not saying anything.
Luke got startled by this and shook his head before saying, "Never."
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 92: FOUR AGAINST ONE: THE DEMON’S FINAL TRUMP CARD
paragraphs: "Then please tell us... and you also know I am strong. Plus, I have this armour you have given to me." After hearing Aurielle’s words, Luke instantly remembered Queen Eclipse Regilia that comes with Queen Descent’s ability. which can theoretically make her raw power, like strength, aether and shadow control, to early golden knight level. And that will give tremendous help to him if he took her.

Naira got confused hearing about armour things still didn’t stop them. Finally after seeing that they are done. She also added. "Luke, also don’t forget me. I can’t say about genius, but if I used my full power, then I could reach mid-peak golden knight stage strength." Luke got surprised hearing Naira’s confident voice.
Well, in this it’s not Luke’s fault. Because he doesn’t know anything about her original skills.

Seeing they are hell-bent on going, Luke sighed and told them about the crucial details, again without mentioning the source. "The enemy or the trap they set for me... is on peak Golden Knight level."

"WHAT!!" Both of them shouted at the same time, with wide eyes, because that was crazy. ’A peak golden knight!’ Their minds stopped for a moment. The golden knight, strength is no joke. Because even viscounts have most have only one golden knight in their territory and the resources need to train Golden knight is huge.

’They sure prepared thoroughly. Naira thought this with a grim expression. still she didn’t lost all hope. Because it’s a real golden knight level or something else; they have to find that after meeting the threat personally.

"Whatever, I am still going with you," Naira, with a serious face, said to Luke, who nodded with a downcast face. As he was still worried about how to deal with this. Because he knows, if he used his all power, then maybe...maybe he can deal with the early golden knight but with peak golden knight.
He then turned toward Vaelira, who at some time had come behind him and was also listening to everything. ’Maybe with her origin ultimate ability we can do something.’

Now the plan is set. He nodded at everyone and told them to be ready because soon four of them will be going to tackle this threat. After that he moved alone near a tree and continued reading the system screen.
After seeing the rewards text, his somewhat downcast mood becomes better and he thought .’Awesome!’ because if he succeeds, then he will definitely be going to make it big this time.
"Why are all my wives not here...?" With a pained face he muttered those words. But he also knows the truth. For getting rewards, he has to interact with them.
Finally, after half an hour’s rest, Luke said goodbye to everyone and followed the direction which the system was pointing.
While they were traveling toward the location, Luke asked the system about how his strength multiplier actually works.

Soon system answered this query. [Well... if we take the example of your second titan, which gives 5x strength. Then your 2nd armor Nullex, which has a 3x strength multiplier bonus.] The system paused for a moment to let Luke digest this info. then continued.

[It gave you raw power like strength and aether. So after we added this multiplier to your current realm. You are going to have early Silver Knight stage raw power.] Luke heard system words clearly. But this creates another an question.

"But my titan form Voltrax’s strength was around mid-silver knight. when I was fightning against those beast." The system heard Luke’s confused voice and added. [Luke, the things about early silver knight stage, that’s a basic raw power you are getting after you transform, like your Myrkhal titan form or even other form transformations.]

[But it’s like an ant of the same realm can’t exhibit the same strength as an elephant in the same realm in terms of raw strength.] Luke’s doubts started getting cleared while listening to the system explanation.

[So, your titan forms are the apex of their lineage. And each of them can’t be measured by normal indicators.] Luke nodded, because that was true. His titan gave him a body that is larger than humans’ or other species’. So it should be normal that they would have more strength.

[But if you think about it, your Voltrax titan form has too much strength. then there you are very wrong.] Luke came out of his thoughts when he heard the system’s mocking voice. So with a confused voice he asked, "What do you mean?"

[Well, if you use Titan, which specializes in raw strength. Then you will see why they are called apex.] Luke’s eyes light up on this. Because he did have other form titans unlocked with Myrkhal form ability, but he thought that every one of them had the same strength. So that’s why he didn’t use them and only stick with Voltrax, because of its lightning power.
"We have arrived," Vaelira’s voice comes from behind, as she has already sensed the location of their destination.
Luke stopped his thinking about titans and observed the surroundings. Which still consists of trees, but the trees present here are very huge and more dense.
"It’s a formation," Naira said after a moment and pointed toward a few trees, which clearly have the markings of magic symbols on them.
Then Aurielle stepped forward and swung her purple sword with a slash toward the tree, which got instantly cut down.
The next instant, the whole forest around them ripples, and after a moment, it disappears.
"This!!!" All of their eyes widened. Because in the distance they saw a gigantic owl-like creature but without wings.
His whole body was embedded with large reddish crystals, which were emitting dense demonic miasma while the beast was in a curling position.
"It’s dead?" Aurielle muttered confusedly because she can see. Some parts of its body were rotten, and from there skeletons could be seen.
Plus its chest was also not rising or falling. Which indicated an absence of breathing.

"Seems like they have prepared this for us." Naira, after observing the giant body, said to everyone because she had seen this type of ritual where they revived the dead body of a giant monster to let it wreak havoc.
"Then we just have to destroy its body before it can revive." Luke stepped forward before saying this to everyone. On which Aurielle and Naira looked toward him with a ’you should not jinx it’ look.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 93: LUKE AWAKENS THE TITAN OF ABSOLUTE STRENGTH
paragraphs: Luke didn’t see their reaction, but the next second it happened. RUMBLE!! The giant owl’s body trembled as the red crystals pulsed with energy which filled its body. Then it slowly opened its yellow eyes.
Seeing many pests has come around the giant owl, without any warning, roared loudly, "ROARRR!!!"
Then he pushed himself up with one hand. When he finally stood up all of them saw a 30-foot-tall giant owl covered in brown feathers. While his once yellow eyes now burned with a deep crimson glow.
"This is bad!" Luke muttered under his breath while Aurielle and Naira just shook their heads. Then all of them move toward their positions, which they had decided on earlier.

Luke will be the main fighter, who will take the agro of the threat. ’Why?’ Because he is going to take the help of 7 queen ward rings. As one he has given to Vaelira, and now only seven are left to him.
Aurielle will provide both support and crowd control, while the main attackers will be Naira and Vaelira. Though, Vaelira’s ultimate ability will be their killing move.
"Time for the new titan!" Luke shouted after that he transformed into the Myrkhal titan first. As currently he can only access their transformation from faceless titans.
"Azrion!" Reality spoke those words when Luke’s faceless titan willed it. Then the next instant, the white body of the faceless titan began changing.
With a rumble sound, the 12-foot-tall faceless titan body began expanding. Muscles grow rapidly, shoulders widen along with his chest becoming wider, and the arms become massive.
Finally, a cracking sound came as his white body skin cracked apart and stone-like flesh appeared in its place. While golden aether lines flow across his whole body.
Then a boom sound occurred as he took one step forward, which shook the earth a little.
Finally everyone saw a 20-foot-tall Atlas titan, who is known for their absolute strength.

Aurielle, Naira, and Vaelira got shocked after seeing Luke transform into a 20-foot-tall giant with dark brown hair like a lion’s mane, but its end has a black part. while his eyes were glowing with golden light.
The whole titan didn’t have any armor on his body, that’s the reason his muscular body could be seen clearly. Which is only covered by short black pants.
After a moment, Luke summoned Nullex as well, which covered his body in brown-colored armor, and two large gauntlets appeared in both his hands.
Then, Luke felt his realm’s raw power had reached the early silver knight stage. But if he attacked with his punch. Then even peak silver knights have to be careful.

"Good, but not enough." He clenched his gauntlets, which generated a gust of air, but seeing the 30-foot giant owl beast. He knows this strength is not enough to suppress him. "System, show Atlas’s titan description. " Still Luke wants to see if he missed something in Atlas Titan.
[Myrkhal Titan Face: Azrion]
Species: Atlas Titan / Strength Lineage.
Description: Atlas is one of the ancient Titan forms contained within Myrkhal, the Faceless Titan.
Unlike other Titans that focus on special powers or elements, Atlas represents the pure concept of physical strength.
A body created to carry impossible weight. A Titan whose every muscle, bone, and movement exists for one purpose—
Overwhelming force.
"Ok! that’s crazy," Luke muttered with a surprised expression. Even though he can feel that his body contains tremendous strength, he didn’t expect it to contain an overwhelming one.
"ROARR!" The giant owl beast, who was now fully awake, felt provoked when he saw a bipedal being standing in front of him.
"I need more strength." Luke muttered in a low voice while the other three women backed away because a fight was going to start.
"Use form assimilation with your behemoth titan," Myrkhal, who was resting inside Luke finally said to him.
Luke nodded after hearing his suggestion and used form assimilation, the second ability of the Faceless Titan, which allowed him to merge one trait of his other titan, into the current titan.
"System, used behemoth titan strength trait." Luke said this to the system, as the Behemoth titan is of the Beast titan lineage which also has large raw strength.

Soon his body expanded and turned into a 25-foot-tall titan. "Now, it’s enough." Luke nodded with satisfaction because now his punching strength has reached the early golden knight level. So he finally has the strength to damage the owl giant’s body.

"ROARR!!" The beast seems to get impatient and charges straight toward Luke Atlas, with his punch. "Let’s see how much strength you have got, big boy." Luke’s titan-heavy voice sounded, and he also charged toward him with his punch.
After a moment Luke’s large gauntlet collided with the owl beast’s large punch, and the result was catastrophic.
"BOOOOM!" because the moment both of their punches collided, the shockwave it generated blew away everything in a 100 m radius. Even the giant trees, 100m tall, didn’t survive and got blasted apart.
"Careful," Aurielle shouted toward the other women, and the three of them instantly increased the distance from the two giant monsters.

"Are both of their strengths on the same level?" Aurielle asked confusedly, because even though the surroundings got destroyed near both of them. But none of them took a single step after clash. While their punch and gauntlets are in the same place where they have collided.
Naira shook her head and said. "Luke’s strength seems great, but his body defenses and stamina, we don’t know."

Aurielle observed again and noticed that Naira is right. Because the giant owl beast has absorbed the force into his body, while Luke’s giant form has a little crack around his arm, but it’s healing very fast.
"BOOM!" Another loud boom sound echoed as they had separated from their previous lock position and were now fighting back again.

There Luke punched the owl’s face while dodging the owl’s punched attack and kneed the monster’s gut. Each attack generates an immense shockwave that can blasted apart any normal early silver knight stage.
"It seems like we have to use our full power." Aurielle said to Naira, who nodded at her words. Then both of them summoned their power.
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 94: LUKE’S WIVES FINALLY SHOW THEIR REAL STRENGTH
paragraphs: "Queen Descent!" Aurielle summoned her Eclipse Queen regalia armor’s ultimate ability. WHOSSHHH! Her armor released all the stored dark energy that it contained over this time, which blew away the surrounding dust and stones.

Her body armour starts becoming black, like shadows are enveloping her. Only a violet fracture remains on her armor, which is pulsing with glowing light, and her black cloak becomes more darker then submerged into her shadow, like it’s got connected to it.

All the surrounding shadows present in the forest around 1 km away start getting restless then they ripple in the next moment. After that they expanded and covered fully the whole 1 km area in darkness.

"Well, that was something." Naira said with narrowed eyes because she can tell the armor Aurielle is wearing doesn’t seem like normal grade. ’Relic gear? seems close.’ These thoughts occurred to her mind, but then she heard Aurielle’s mocking words.
"Well, what I can say...my husband is so sweet and loves me so much that he gives me this special present." Aurielle looked toward Naira and said with a smile on her face.
Naira’s eyes twitched seeing this, but she felt a little jealous. Because this level of items, she was not allowed to touch even in king palace.

Then Aurielle asked her a question but with the same mocking words. "Do you know? What did he say when he gave me this special gift?" Aurielle saw that even after hearing her question, Naira didn’t reply but just looked into her eyes.

Aurielle didn’t care, and said. "This special gift I have brought for my one and only queen wife~" Naira saw Aurielle was clearly smiling after saying those words, while repeating ’only wife’ again and again.

Naira looked toward her left hand, there was only a ring shining with azure light and nothing else. ’Why didn’t he give me that armor?’ She felt little resentment toward Luke so she turned toward him while giving a displeased glare.
BOOM! BANG! SLAM! CRASH!

Luke Atlas and Owl Giant exchanged many blows, which results both of them getting injured. But because of his Titan regeneration ability, he healed instantly. Though he noticed that the owl beast was also slowly healing by consuming those reddish crystal energies that were embedded deep inside his body.
Sadly, once he tried to bring them out. But the moment he touched them. The giant owl retaliated fiercely and nearly bit his arm off from his shoulder.
"Why are they taking so long?" Luke muttered with an irritated voice. as their husband and master is fighting here alone, and they are not helping him at all.

After that he exchanged another blow; but he felt the surroundings become dark, which means Aurielle has used the ultimate ability of her armor, so soon help will come. Sadly he waited a few seconds, but nothing happened. Only he felt a resentful glare toward him.

’What?’ BANG!! Distracted by the sudden change, he lost focus on the battle. Which results the owl’s punch landed directly on his face, sending his body flying backward through the air before he crashed into the ground 100 meters away.
"Damn it," Luke cursed while getting up with his giant body while shouting toward the women, who were still gossiping. ’Literally gossiping.’ "Can all of you help me!"
Vaelira, who was listening to Aurielle’s words seriously, because in her words, the master’s name was mentioned many times. Suddenly got startled after hearing her master’s loud voice.
Then she saw he was fighting the giant monster alone and now got blasted apart. While the owl beast were charging toward him.
"Titan Breaker Arrow" She instantly mounted an arrow on her bow and used her ability while reeling the arrow toward the charging owl-beast.
WHOSHH!
At the start, the arrow was of normal size, but soon its size changed, it became 10 feet long and 3 feet wide.
The owl beast felt the incoming attack. So he stopped his sprint and punched toward the incoming titan’s arrow.
CRACK! The moment his fist connected to Arrow. The arrow got blasted apart into splinters without doing any damage to his body. "ROARR!"
The owl beast roared and still charged toward Luke Atlas, who now stood up from the ground without much harm.
Aurielle also comes out of her talk with Naivara and uses her S-rank origin skill, Shadow Sovereign.
Soon large shadows start moving toward the owl-beast and attach to its body as they try to drag its huge body to the ground.
RUMBLE RUMBLE! The giant beast felt irritated by these black bindings and used his force to rip them apart or pull them from the ground.
"Not so fast." Aurielle whispered while charging a 10-foot-long Shadow Blade and throwing it toward the owl beast.
The shadow blade collided with the giant owl beast, tearing through its chest. Which results in chunks of flesh were ripped away from the impact and fell heavily to the ground.
"ROARR!" The owl beast roared in anger. After seeing he got injured, in the next instant, with a single motion, he ripped apart all shadows binding him while a glow of light appeared on his mouth.
"This is bad!" Luke felt that the owl-beast is going to use some type of high-yield energy blast. So he instantly moved toward Aurielle and others.
Naivara also saw the situation was bad and immediately used her origin skill’s ultimate form.
"S-rank Origin Skill: Mother of Endless Tides... Ultimate form: Mother of Tides’ Descendant!"
In an instant a 30-foot-tall incarnation, completely made of ocean aether, appeared in Naira’s place, and she was embedded in the center of this incarnation.
The Ocean Mother incarnation raised her giant hand toward the owl beast and used a defensive skill, which she named "Ocean Mother’s Aegis!"
The moment those words escaped her mouth, a massive spinning shield made entirely of ocean aether, which also looks like a water shield, appeared in front of her.

Aurielle, from the side, also felt the threat and summoned the surrounding shadows to form a thick, massive darkness shield comprised of surrounding shadows and her aether. before placing behind Naira’s shield.

Luke also reached the location. "Nullex!" then shouted, and the next second he crossed his hands, on which Nullex removed the giant gauntlets before forming a thick layer of small frontal shields on both of his giant hands, while his foot armor also changed as its side part extended and dug deep into the ground. So Luke will not be blasted apart when he stops that beam.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 95: NAIRA SUMMONS A LEVIATHAN AGAINST THE DEMON BEAST
paragraphs: The owl beast who was gathering the energy from his body. finally released the large reddish demonic beam toward Luke location.
The beam traveled while destroying everything in its path. Even the ground below melted as it formed a straight line toward Luke’s position.

"BOOOOOM!" A deafening sound echoed when the thick reddish demonic beam collided with the Naira’s spinning water shield. For the moment it’s seems its going to hold, because its surface just rippled more and more.
But soon it got destroyed, and the reddish beam, which was reduced somewhat, collided with Aurielle’s darkness shield.
This time just a shockwave was created, and no deafening sound came. As all sound was engulfed by darkness itself.

Surprisingly, the darkness shield was able to hold the power of the reddish beam for more time, because as more and more of the reddish beam pushed. It’s also stretched backward while keeping trying to absorb its energy.
But alas, it’s also got destroyed, and the beam is now which is half of its initial size. Come straight toward Titan Luke.
"COME!" Luke Atlas’s titan form shouted, then the next moment he bore the brunt fully. "Damn it," Luke cursed, because this energy that collided with his arms’ shield was still too high.
’How is this possible? Doesn’t he peak at the golden knight level being?’ Luke while blocking the energy beam, thought with an ugly face. So he asked this to the system.
[Luke, did you see those red crystals on his body?] Luke nodded, because he was also confused about those crystals other than knowing that the owl beast could heal with them.
[Those crystals contain raw demonic energy, and in this attack he released some energy. That’s why this attack crossed peak golden knight and entered just shy of the half-diamond knight stage.]

’What!’ Luke’s eyes widened because it was absurd. And if he can do more of this type of attack, doesn’t this mean all of them are going to die? ’ Luke thought this grimly, though this time system or anyone didn’t reply to him.
"BOOOOM!" Finally, after holding that reddish demonic beam for a few moments. It stopped, and a loud explosion occurred in front of Luke.

"So they finally started. Oryn stood on a high hill and watched the explosion occur in the distance. Sadly, he can’t check if Luke is dead or not. Because he has placed the crystal ball inside the owl beast. So whatever happened The owl beast should definitely going to kill Luke.
"Let’s go; it’s not safe here anymore." With that, Oryn and others left the hill. While other places also felt the tremor and shaking of ground because of the ongoing fight.
"Please be safe, everyone," Margaret prayed while looking toward the explosion’s direction.
"What’s happening there?" Nyra and others paused when they heard the large sound and turned toward the location with a questioning gaze.

"Did someone find the exit location?" One noble asked from the crowd, on which others’ eyes lit up before the next instant it was gotten down. Because all of them felt the explosion’s intensity which seemed to reach the golden knight stage. So if they headed in that direction. Then it would be suicidal.
So after a moment of thinking, Vivienne and Elias decided to not go and wait for the result of the fight, which is currently going over there.
"We have to kill him fast or else we are going to be exhausted first." Luke said to everyone when he saw that those red crystals were nearly giving the owl beast infinite energy to keep going on.
"Ok, I will use the big moves. So cooperate with me." Naira said so to everyone and used her ability with the help of the incarnate body.
Aurielle, Luke, and Vaelira nodded and prepared their strong attack as well.

Naira Ocean mother incarnation, raised both her hands toward the sky, but her hands’ direction remained toward the owl-beast. Who was taking a deep breath after its earlier released of energy blast, and the red crystals on its body also seemed to dim slightly.
"LEVIATHAN’S BITE!!!" Naira’s loud voice comes from Ocean Mother’s body, and the next instant, everyone in the secret realm hears a sound, which they would never forget.
"WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHHH!!!"
The sound of a colossal being. Then next moment everyone saw in the sky a 50-foot gigantic jaw-shaped mouth form, which was packed with sharp teeth.
The whole jaw is made entirely of water, while its teeth are remain in deep blue color.
Oryn, who was running with his guards and Black robbed man. heard the sound, at which he paused and turned back. But this made his eyes widen to the extreme, and a word escaped his mouth. "CRAZY!"
Because he knows one thing about her stepsister. That she is normally mid-rank among the Sea King children.
The reason is her S-rank origin skills. Even after being S rank, their power is comparable to A and B rank only. But—"
The moment she used her ultimate form, the game changed. As her every normal attack becomes A rank, while her S-rank skills become peak S-rank, which can kill cross-realm.
"We have to move fast!" Oryn said with a panicked voice because he is not worried about Naira destroying the owl-beast. He is worried about something else.
Everyone present inside the secret realm felt fear from the gigantic jaw that appeared in the air. Fortunately, the jaw was not attacking them.
"ROARRR!" The owl beast, seeing something bigger than him, angered him. So he roared toward the gigantic jaw.
Naira, who finally formed the whole jaw. Said another word. "BITE! "
The Leviathan heard her word, or that’s what it seemed to everyone. Because the next moment it opened its mouth wider and bit down toward the owl beast.
BOOOOOM!!!

The moment the jaws clamped down, a terrifying shockwave erupted from the impact, tearing through everything in the surrounding area. Trees shattered, the ground cracked, and a massive cloud of dust swallowed the battlefield.
Then—another shockwave exploded outward. The violent force swept away the dust cloud, revealing the scene hidden within.
The place where stood Luke, Aurielle, and Vaelira, their eyes locked on the location.
The giant owl beast was using both of its hands to hold back the enormous jaws. One hand pressed against the upper teeth, while the other pushed against the lower jaw, forcibly stopping its advance.
[Chapter End]

Because he has placed the crystal ball inside the owl beast.
So whatever happened The owl beast should definitely going to kill Luke.
"Let’s go; it’s not safe here anymore." With that, Oryn and others left the hill.
While other places also felt the tremor and shaking of ground because of the ongoing fight.
"Please be safe, everyone," Margaret prayed while looking toward the explosion’s direction.
"What’s happening there?" Nyra and others paused when they heard the large sound and turned toward the location with a questioning gaze.
"Did someone find the exit location?" One noble asked from the crowd, on which others’ eyes lit up before the next instant it was gotten down.
Because all of them felt the explosion’s intensity which seemed to reach the golden knight stage.
So if they headed in that direction.
Then it would be suicidal.
So after a moment of thinking, Vivienne and Elias decided to not go and wait for the result of the fight, which is currently going over there.
"We have to kill him fast or else we are going to be exhausted first." Luke said to everyone when he saw that those red crystals were nearly giving the owl beast infinite energy to keep going on.
"Ok, I will use the big moves.
So cooperate with me." Naira said so to everyone and used her ability with the help of the incarnate body.
Aurielle, Luke, and Vaelira nodded and prepared their strong attack as well.
Naira Ocean mother incarnation, raised both her hands toward the sky, but her hands’ direction remained toward the owl-beast.
Who was taking a deep breath after its earlier released of energy blast, and the red crystals on its body also seemed to dim slightly.
"LEVIATHAN’S BITE!!!" Naira’s loud voice comes from Ocean Mother’s body, and the next instant, everyone in the secret realm hears a sound, which they would never forget.
"WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHHH!!!"
The sound of a colossal being.
Then next moment everyone saw in the sky a 50-foot gigantic jaw-shaped mouth form, which was packed with sharp teeth.
The whole jaw is made entirely of water, while its teeth are remain in deep blue color.
Oryn, who was running with his guards and Black robbed man. heard the sound, at which he paused and turned back.
But this made his eyes widen to the extreme, and a word escaped his mouth.
"CRAZY!"
Because he knows one thing about her stepsister.
That she is normally mid-rank among the Sea King children.
The reason is her S-rank origin skills.
Even after being S rank, their power is comparable to A and B rank only.
But—"
The moment she used her ultimate form, the game changed.
As her every normal attack becomes A rank, while her S-rank skills become peak S-rank, which can kill cross-realm.
"We have to move fast!" Oryn said with a panicked voice because he is not worried about Naira destroying the owl-beast.
He is worried about something else.
Everyone present inside the secret realm felt fear from the gigantic jaw that appeared in the air.
Fortunately, the jaw was not attacking them.
"ROARRR!" The owl beast, seeing something bigger than him, angered him.
So he roared toward the gigantic jaw.
Naira, who finally formed the whole jaw.
Said another word.
"BITE!
The Leviathan heard her word, or that’s what it seemed to everyone.
Because the next moment it opened its mouth wider and bit down toward the owl beast.
BOOOOOM!!!
The moment the jaws clamped down, a terrifying shockwave erupted from the impact, tearing through everything in the surrounding area.
Trees shattered, the ground cracked, and a massive cloud of dust swallowed the battlefield.
Then—another shockwave exploded outward.
The violent force swept away the dust cloud, revealing the scene hidden within.
The place where stood Luke, Aurielle, and Vaelira, their eyes locked on the location.
The giant owl beast was using both of its hands to hold back the enormous jaws.
One hand pressed against the upper teeth, while the other pushed against the lower jaw, forcibly stopping its advance.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 96: THE FINAL HUNT DESCENDED... BUT DEATH WASN’T ENOUGH
paragraphs: Despite the overwhelming force trying to crush him, the jaw attack was frozen in place.
"Do your attack!" Naira shouted at everyone, because her attacks seemed too powerful, but she still wasn’t able to cross the golden knight stage and can only reached peak golden knight.
That’s why the owl beast was able to hold the advance.
The three of them come out of their shocked state after hearing Naira shout and start using their attack as well.
"S-RANK ORIGIN SKILL: SHADOW SOVEREIGN!" Aurielle whispered those words, then the shadows in the surroundings moves toward her.
Soon every shadows compress in front of her, and a large amount of darkness aether is also released from her Queen Eclipse armor. With each moment it’s compressed further and further.
Finally, a huge black-purple sword entirely made of darkness appeared in the sky. Its size was 20 m long with 2 m width. which is now floated above her.
The darkness surrounding its pulsed with enegy but didn’t release any sound. Instead, all the surrounding lights and sound got absorbed inside it.
"ULTIMATE SKILL! ABYSSAL EXECUTION!" She finally uttered the name of her ultimate skill and released it straight toward the giant owl beast’s face.
WHOSSSH!

The owl beast, who was holding both ends of the gigantic jaw, also felt the threat from the incoming giant blade. So he again charged his energy back toward his mouth, and this time, without making much strength, he fired toward the black-purple blade.
BOOOM!
Another shockwave was released when both attacks collided. But the blade didn’t get destroyed; instead, it slowly kept moving forward while the owl beast’s reddish beam kept stopping it.
Luke also returned back to its faceless titan form and instantly changed back to Voltrax’s thunder titan.
Sadly he doesn’t have any other energy-type titan form unlocked, or else he could combine their aethers with Voltrax to make his attack even stronger.
"Nullex!" Luke shouted while jumping straight toward the sky, then he used the same attack that he had done previously.

Soon storm clouds gather, while his upper six back spines become large due to Nullex, and the next moment lightning strikes towar him, which he keep storing in his six spines, then moving toward his head horns.
The owl-beast moved his eyes warily slightly toward the sky. Where Luke was charging his attack. But he can’t do anything.
"THUNDERFALL!" After charging fully, Luke released all the lightning he stored in his horns toward the giant owl beast in a form of beam.
BOOOOM!
Another explosion sound comes. When Luke’s lightning beam keeps attacking the owl-beast’s waist part.
"Vaelira Now!" Seeing his attack was effective, the owl-beast wasn’t able to dodge. Luke shouted toward Vaelira, who was preparing her ultimate for a while.
In the distance Vaelira’s arrow was glowing with two different colors, while the arrow itself became black. She raised her bow high and pointed toward heaven itself.
"S-RANK ORIGIN SKILL: THE FINAL HUNT!" Vaelira whispered those names in a low voice as she released her arrow.
WHOSHH!
With a whoosh sound, it reached straight toward the sky, and after a moment it disappeared.
Vaelira closed her eyes while trying to feel it. Soon she saw the arrow stop at a certain point and begin descending.
The view she was viewing was like that: a black arrow with two rotating colors, which were brown and golden Was coming down without making any sound.
Soon the brown light disappeared, and the arrow became gigantic, 10 m long and 3 m wide. then after a moment its speed increased as golden light surrounded the whole gigantic arrow.
But the next instant, the eclipse arrow took effect, and the surrounding golden lights got absorbed inside the black arrow.
The owl beast didn’t know. that death was coming straight toward him from his back. Until he heard a voice.

"ULTIMATE ABILITY! CELESTIAL HUNT: FINAL DESCENT!" Those words escaped Vaelira’s mouth, and then everyone saw a gigantic black arrow suddenly appear behind the owl beast, while its trajectory was toward its neck.
The owl-beast who was already dead. But now felt that feeling again. He doesn’t know why, but je felt that something was hidden inside that black arrow, which can really kill him.

Vaelira saw the panicked face of the owl beast and thought about her celestial hunt. whose final descent is guaranteed kill ability, unless the enemy is at a way higher realm than her. Sadly that was not true for the owl-beast.
Without any sound, the black arrow pierced the helpless and trapped owl beast, while forcing his body also downward.
But then as it’s forced removed from those hands that were holding down the gigantic jaw and his reddish beam, which is also stopped.
So all the combined attacks finally reached his body, which results a large-scale explosion occurred in its place.
BOOOOOOOM!
Luke and others instantly make distance from the explosion to prevent getting swept up.
A few seconds later when the dust clouds surrounding the owl-beast were removed. Everyone got shocked by the scene.

Because all the flesh of it is gone and only a skeleton remains. Then Luke gazed toward its heart, on which his eyes widened extremely, and his titan instinct also screamed at him. But this time it was more serious than before.
There in the front, those reddish crystals were embedded inside its skeleton, which further connects to the heart. Which is surprisingly safe? But now it’s beating, increasing with each second.
THUMP! THUMP! THUMP!
And each thump tells Luke to run, or he will be going to die for sure.
So he did that. This time without even a system warning, he instantly changed his form to Sylvarion, which is the Zephyron Titan lineage. And they are known as the apex when it comes to aerial speed.
Soon a 15-foot-tall humanoid titan with a slim but broad-shouldered body which will hold its huge 40-foot wingspan.
Its whole body is silver-colored, while a green, aether-like coating can be seen on its body, which increases its speed by taking advantage of wind aether from the surroundings.

This titan’s face was also humanoid but more refined, while its eyes were bright blue-white. Two curved horns can also be seen on its head, along with its long silver-white hair. That’s flowed naturally.

This transformation happened in an instant, and the three women also felt the threat from the heart. But before they can move, Luke Sylvarion spread its huge silver-blue wings and, with a swift motion, reached them one by one.
"LUKE!" Aurielle screamed, trying to tell Luke about the danger of heart. But Luke nodded as he already felt it clearly.
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 97: "DO YOU LOVE ME?" NAIRA FINALLY ASKED LUKE
paragraphs: Soon surrounding winds flowed across its 15-foot body, but they didn’t hinder it. Instead, it’s increased his speed to extreme levels.

A few seconds later. Everyone’s expression turned to horror because suddenly a big red ball of fire appeared in the distance and was now expanding with crazy speed, on this everyone already guessed that it was an explosion but it’s happening very fast.
Margaret, Kai, and other knights who were 30 km away from the location also saw this doomsday scene and felt they were going to die today.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The next second, its deafening sound also comes, which makes everyone tremble, and they instinctively crouched to the ground while closing their ears.
Luke and others also heard the explosion sound, but fortunately Luke had already made some distance with his fast speed. And now he is constantly making distance from the explosion.
While they were escaping, Oryn was also escaping from the explosion location.
Soon a portal emerged in front of the portal for everyone who was inside the secret realm, which indicates that exit conditions have been triggered.

This brings relief to everyone’s face, and everyone entered the portal while giving a last look toward the explosion, which is just keeping increasing. Likely it’s going to swallow the whole secret realm.
Luke’s knights and maid also saw the portal. So with relieved face they also exited. and this same scene was happening everywhere.
"Portal?" Luke and others felt many portals opened in the surroundings, so he also, without thinking, took the three of them toward the nearest portal to escape this shithole place.
WHOSSH! WHOSSH! WHOSSH!
With that, everyone inside the portal returned back toward the previous location from where they had come.
With a whoosh, many portals opened in the stadium, and everyone came out one by one.
"We are safe!" "Finally, I escaped!" "Damn those demon whispers!"
After emerging, everyone shows different reactions. Some cursed while some hugged their family. But one thing is true: all those who have returned were happy.
When Luke come outside of portal, he also returned back into his normal form. So now he was also in the same place as everyone present, but he felt something was not right.

After looking around, he noticed. That the whole stadium was burning while many places also got destroyed. And corpses of both black-robed men and knights of Stormveil County were also spread across the ground.

"Did a fight happen here as well?" People from the crowd also noticed the corpses and muttered. While trying to figure out what happened earlier or at least hoping to find someone from Stormveil County.
THUD! A thud sound comes. to which everyone turned toward the sound; and there was a person standing fully armed along with their armor, but seeing the person brings smile at everyone face.
"Lady Octavia!!!" Yes, Octavia just returned after feeling the presence of so many portals. But when she saw that, her family, along with others, returned safely. She sighed in relief.
"Please, everyone, follow the inspection before stepping out of the stadium." After a moment of reunion, she said this to everyone.
When everyone heard her words, they got baffled by this sudden inspection. On this Octavia answered that maybe someone among them is a demon whisper member. So they are checking for demonic mana.
After hearing Octavia answered, many nobles got displeased, but still, they didn’t say anything. Because just now they have escaped that shithole, and now, no one wants to waste more time on it.
Oryn, who was also transported back here along with his bodyguards and demon whisper people, who have already changed their clothes.

But when he saw Luke was also alive, he got shocked. Because according to the calculations. If by some miracle he somehow defeated the owl-beast, then he should have died in the explosion. As he doesn’t have any means to escape that large explosion at all.

While he was gritting his teeth and giving Luke a death glare, he heard Octavia’s words. On which his face paled instantly. So he immediately made distance from the demon-whisper people while giving them a last glare. ’Don’t come close to me.’
"Why did he do this?" Because he knows they are loyal and their gods need Oryn for their plan. So they will not harm him in any way.

Soon everyone lined up and moved toward the exit one by one to check. There knights hold positions to check everyone with a light crystal. and workers were also entering the stadium to do the work of moveing the corpses.
The ten demon whisperers saw Oryn actions, but didn’t say anything. Instead, they exchanged glances among themselves, and soon all of them nodded.
BOOM! The next moment. Two demon-whispering men charged straight toward the entrance, while the other eight moved straight toward the walls of the stadium.
"STOP THEM!" Octavia, who was happily talking with her family members, heard the shout and saw this scene.
So without hesitation, she attacked the eight demon whisperers who were now close to the wall and were about to escape.
WHOSSH!
She released the aether blade instantly moved toward them, but two people from them turned back and threw themselves toward the aether blade.

"Damn it!" A curse escaped from Octavia’s mouth because after that two people blocked her attack, and the remaining six successfully escaped. While the first two people were already impaled to the ground by a dozen spears.
Luke and his wives, along with everyone saw this. But they can’t help, as they were already very exhausted, and also their aether runs dry.
After that, his gaze turned toward Oryn, whose face had become ugly, and he was giving him a death glare.
Luke narrowed his eyes. Sadly right now he can’t do anything to the sea prince. Because he doesn’t have any evidence of him colluding with demons.
So he can’t announce this as well. But he was sure one day he would the settle scores with him.
Naira and Aurielle both were holding Luke’s hands from the moment they had come here from the portal.
So when Luke clenched his fist a little, they felt it and followed his gaze. There was Oryn glaring at Luke, but when he saw Naira was also looking toward him. He immediately turned his gaze away.
"Naira, be careful of him." Luke reminded her again, and she nodded.
Finally, after half an hour, all the remaining people checking were done. Then Luke, along with his people, also comes out of the stadium.
After coming out, they felt the surrounding atmosphere was also off. As the roads were completely empty, while fully armed knights patrolled the roads and streets.
"It seems like the whole central district got locked down." Luke muttered, on this both of his wives nodded.
"MY LADY!!" But just as they were moving to find an inn to settle down. A loud cry comes from the distance.
Everyone’s gaze turned toward the voice, and there they saw two female knights with armor that had golden lining running toward them.
"Your body guards are here." Luke said to Naira, who just looked ahead with different emotions.
Even though she can’t say she fell in love with Luke, she did feel a comfort in his presence that she only felt in her mother presence.
So now, her bodyguards have returned. This means she has to go back and separate from Luke.
Naira slowly turned toward Luke.
There Luke was also looking toward her with concern. Soon her eyes met his, and in those eyes she felt the same emotion that he always had whenever he met her.
"Luke." In a low, but gentle voice, Naira called out his name.
"Yes." Luke also replied in a gentle voice, but it contained sadness, as he knew where this talk ending would go.
Naira smiled slightly at his voice, which warmed her heart.
Then, without breaking that smile, she asked him one question. "Do you love me...?"
Luke heard Naira’s voice, which stopped at the end.
Though he didn’t answer immediately, instead he just kept looking at her blue eyes, and she also did the same, which is keeping her looking at his blue eyes.
Finally, after a moment, his eyes become a little moist, and he says, "YES!" though his voice sounds a little high this time.
Which Aurielle, who was beside him, also heard. Though it’s pained her heart... hearing her husband saying he loved other women. But she controls herself, because she has already decided.
’Among the five wives, she is first and will always be.’ With that, she turns her face away from them.
Naira felt her heart skip a beat when Luke said he loved her. which widens her smile and also makes her eyes moist as well. But before she could do anything, Luke asked her a question.
"And do you love me, Naira?" His voice didn’t pause as he asked her without breaking eye contact.
Naira felt her heart beating faster. So she smiled and leaned close to his ear before whispering, "When you claim my hand in front of Sea King, at that time I will give you my answer...husband~"
With that, she separated from Luke, before giving a kiss on his cheek, and moved toward her bodyguards with a satisfied smile.
"She is gone." Aurielle saw her husband’s foolish behavior, because he was now standing frozen.
"Huh?" Aurielle heard Luke’s confused voice when he came out of his thoughts. But his face still held a foolish grin, which irritates her more than Naira asking him about love.
So she came close to Luke and, with a napkin, removed the lipstick mark that Naira had left on his right cheek.
"For a whole week, sleep alone." With that, she throws away the napkins and starts moving toward the nearest inn.
"HUH???" This time Luke’s even more confused voice comes, followed by panic. ’What the heck? alone for a whole week?’
While repeating those words in his mind, Luke chased Aurielle to asked her forgiveness.

Vaelira, who watched everything from the start to end. Add another note in her mind. ’Master is afraid of his first wife but can’t sleep without her.’ She nodded, and with Knights and Margaret, they also followed them back.
[Chapter End.]

So he can’t announce this as well.
But he was sure one day he would the settle scores with him.
Naira and Aurielle both were holding Luke’s hands from the moment they had come here from the portal.
So when Luke clenched his fist a little, they felt it and followed his gaze.
There was Oryn glaring at Luke, but when he saw Naira was also looking toward him.
He immediately turned his gaze away.
"Naira, be careful of him." Luke reminded her again, and she nodded.
Finally, after half an hour, all the remaining people checking were done.
Then Luke, along with his people, also comes out of the stadium.
After coming out, they felt the surrounding atmosphere was also off.
As the roads were completely empty, while fully armed knights patrolled the roads and streets.
"It seems like the whole central district got locked down." Luke muttered, on this both of his wives nodded.
"MY LADY!!" But just as they were moving to find an inn to settle down.
A loud cry comes from the distance.
Everyone’s gaze turned toward the voice, and there they saw two female knights with armor that had golden lining running toward them.
"Your body guards are here." Luke said to Naira, who just looked ahead with different emotions.
Even though she can’t say she fell in love with Luke, she did feel a comfort in his presence that she only felt in her mother presence.
So now, her bodyguards have returned.
This means she has to go back and separate from Luke.
Naira slowly turned toward Luke.
There Luke was also looking toward her with concern.
Soon her eyes met his, and in those eyes she felt the same emotion that he always had whenever he met her.
"Luke." In a low, but gentle voice, Naira called out his name.
"Yes." Luke also replied in a gentle voice, but it contained sadness, as he knew where this talk ending would go.
Naira smiled slightly at his voice, which warmed her heart.
Then, without breaking that smile, she asked him one question.
"Do you love me...?"
Luke heard Naira’s voice, which stopped at the end.
Though he didn’t answer immediately, instead he just kept looking at her blue eyes, and she also did the same, which is keeping her looking at his blue eyes.
Finally, after a moment, his eyes become a little moist, and he says, "YES!" though his voice sounds a little high this time.
Which Aurielle, who was beside him, also heard.
Though it’s pained her heart... hearing her husband saying he loved other women.
But she controls herself, because she has already decided.
’Among the five wives, she is first and will always be.’ With that, she turns her face away from them.
Naira felt her heart skip a beat when Luke said he loved her. which widens her smile and also makes her eyes moist as well.
But before she could do anything, Luke asked her a question.
"And do you love me, Naira?" His voice didn’t pause as he asked her without breaking eye contact.
Naira felt her heart beating faster.
So she smiled and leaned close to his ear before whispering, "When you claim my hand in front of Sea King, at that time I will give you my answer...husband~"
With that, she separated from Luke, before giving a kiss on his cheek, and moved toward her bodyguards with a satisfied smile.
"She is gone." Aurielle saw her husband’s foolish behavior, because he was now standing frozen.
"Huh?" Aurielle heard Luke’s confused voice when he came out of his thoughts.
But his face still held a foolish grin, which irritates her more than Naira asking him about love.
So she came close to Luke and, with a napkin, removed the lipstick mark that Naira had left on his right cheek.
"For a whole week, sleep alone." With that, she throws away the napkins and starts moving toward the nearest inn.
"HUH???" This time Luke’s even more confused voice comes, followed by panic. ’What the heck? alone for a whole week?’
While repeating those words in his mind, Luke chased Aurielle to asked her forgiveness.
Vaelira, who watched everything from the start to end.
Add another note in her mind. ’Master is afraid of his first wife but can’t sleep without her.’ She nodded, and with Knights and Margaret, they also followed them back.

[Luke, I have told you already. that includes Margaret in your harem as well. So if next time Aurielle becomes angry or jealous. Then Margaret will take care of the situation.]
After entering just as Luke was about to slump onto the bed, he heard the system sage’s voice.
He just gave a speechless look toward the system screen and shook his head. because the system was still hell-bent on making Margaret a harem member.
"Wait!" But When a system message comes, he also remembers something he had almost forgotten.
"System, where are my rewards?" With a questioning look, Luke asked the system. Who got silent for a moment before a screen popped up.
[Return system activated: Checking both wives emotions...]
Luke nodded after he finally saw this message. Because he is not letting go of his rewards.
When he was thinking this, Nyx and Myrkhal also came out with curious expressions, then each settled down on his shoulders.
Luke’s eyes twitch at this, because most of the time, they like to remain somewhere inside him. But for this they come out almost immediately.
[Emotions calculated. First Wife Aurielle Valmont.]
[Yesterday emotions: Jealousy/Love/Fear/Satisfied/Proud...etc.]
After reading Aurielle’s emotions, Luke nodded. Because he was sure about this. As he felt some of them firsthand, while for others, like pride, he did not.
’It must be when I beat those nobles.’ He nodded while thinking this.
[Congratulations!!! 10,000x Return Activated (Max)!!!]
"???" Tons of questions appeared on Luke’s face, while Nyx and Myrkhal just watched this curiosity.
Luke got confused because the word "maxed" didn’t come out before. ’So why now?’ After thinking for a moment, he didn’t get any answer, so he asked the system about this.
[Well...Luke... It’s like that...]
"0-0" "Say it!" Luke felt the system was taking too much time, so he urged him to spill the beans.
[Hmm...your first milestone. The one 100x multiplier with Aurielle is not going to work here. Because the max return is 10,000x.]

[100 Iron Knight Stage Tempering Potion x 10,000!]
[One E-rank Human Ascension Series. x 10,000!]
