Because he has already heard from the system. That anything from this world can’t help him at all in case of a realm breakthrough or tempering the realm.
So all he has system potions. But now if he gets 10,000x of those, then he has to wait for the bronze-rank tempering potion. Which he does not when he will get.
So that’s why this question.
[(0-0) Of course not! I am a reputable system, and this type of thing does not work with me at all.]
But sadly, the system’s answer completely ruined Luke’s plan.
[Though you have like two 100x. So you can upgrade only one time and multiply the amount by 100x.]
Luke nodded half-heartedly at the system’s answer but didn’t do the upgrade.
’I need an iron-temper potion, not a bronze one. At least for now.’ So with gritted teeth he clicks on the 10,000x multiplier.
[Congratulations!!! Luke, for getting 1 million Iron Knight Stage Temper Potions!]
"Yeah..." Luke just replied nonchalantly while thinking, ’At least now, I can train millions of peak iron knights.’
He laughed lightly at his thought, while Nyx and Myrkhal didn’t comment on this. Because they didn’t find these rewards worthwhile.
Then Luke turns his gaze toward the second reward. Which was the E-rank human ascension series.
"What to do?" He muttered confusedly, then asked the system for some info.
[Luke, each rank of the ascension series decides the move it contains.]
[For E rank... only one move is there, which can help only breakthrough, from bronze rank to silver knight. "Of course! except you, because it’s helping... not making the breakthrough."]
Luke heard the system words clearly, but at the last words, his face sank again. Because this means he can’t even depend on the Ascension series, which humans make for realm breakthroughs.
"Ok, fine..." With a low voice, he said, while thinking about how to choose.
He first canceled the E rank because it’s a low type and only has one move. after a person reached Silver Knight. That person will need another ascension series.
And for upgrading once to make them D-rank and get hundreds of them. He also shook his head.
Though in the previous case, he will get 100 random D-rank ascension series.
Still no, So he finally upgraded them straight to C rank.
[Congratulations!!! Luke, for getting the C rank Human Ascension Series: Black Steel Ascension Series.]
Luke nodded with a smile on his face and checked what this C-rank ascension series contains.
[Chapter End.]

paragraphs: [⚔️ C-Rank Black Steel Ascension Series]
First Ascension Technique:
Black Steel Skin
Type:
Defense / Body Enhancement
Description:
The user learns to merge their Aether with their physical body, creating a layer of hardened Aether reinforcement beneath their skin.
The technique transforms the user’s body into something similar to forged black steel.
Which, unlike normal armor, Black Steel Skin moves together with the user’s body.
So every part of their body becomes reinforced:
• muscles
• bones
• skin
• internal organs
That’s the result: the user’s defense increases drastically, allowing them to endure attacks that would normally injure ordinary warriors.
Effects:
• Increases physical durability
• Reduces damage from physical attacks
• Strengthens the body against impact
• Improves resistance against weaker Aether attacks
• Allows the user to fight longer without exhaustion
{Mastery Requirement:
By completely mastering Black Steel Skin, the user gains control over defensive Aether reinforcement and obtains the qualification to ascend into the Silver Knight Realm.}
[Second Ascension Technique: ## Black Steel Armor...]
[Third Ascension Technique: ## Black Steel Fortress...]
"Huh...?" Luke read and became confused, so he read again, but confusion still didn’t go.
"That’s it?" he exclaims confusedly, because the reward doesn’t match with the C-rank at all, which is a bit disheartening.
"System! Tell me this is not real??" So Luke, with a scammed expression, looks toward the system screen with suspicious eyes.
[Cough...] The system coughed after hearing Luke sus Words; meanwhile, Nyx and Myrkhal already understood its real effect. So they didn’t comment; instead, they waited for the system explanation.
[Luke, are you asking? That’s why the first technique is just coating their body with Aether??] The system asked for confirmation while not mentioning anything about the second and third techniques.
Luke nodded, because if it’s about coating the body with Aether. which he can also do! even without any technique help.
[Luke, first of all... YOU... HAVE... AN... S-S-S-RANK! SKILL! So you can cover your body with aether easily. But that’s not the same with everyone.]
Luke face change to sudden enlightment, because system was right.
The system saw the changes on Luke’s face, then continued with the same tone.
[So, normally, people have to learn techniques which, teach them how to properly use their Aether. And suprsingly that’s all is Human Ascension Series.]
The system finished his explanation while adding the last sentence. That these techniques are like inheritance, which contains the method or a move. Which previous generation took time to create.
So they passed this on to the new generation. which will give them a ready-made move, So they can focus on learning new moves or create brand-new ones.
"WOW!!!" Luke stood up from the bed after hearing the full explanation. Because that means those 3 techniques took someone else’s time and effort with tons of error.
And now everyone can master those techniques without wasting that time.
Nyx shook his head after seeing Luke’s reaction. Who clearly didn’t understand anything from the name at all.
So he added. "The same is with my SHADOW OF NYX skill that you got instantly, but for me it took millions of years to make it perfect."
Luke, who was still lost in thought. Heard Nyx’s voice, which gives him another blow.
’Millions of years!!!’ and only these words repeated in his mind.
[Luke, do you want to read the description of the second and third techniques?] System with a face that’s clearly saying, "Don’t underestimate my rewards as well," asked baffled Luke.
Luke stopped those repeated words in his mind and looked toward the system button, which clearly says "READ MORE..."

If it were before, maybe he would skip that. But now let’s do it! So Luke, with an excited smile, finally clicked on "read more." Because after hearing that these techniques contain knowledge of someone or whole generation. He becomes excited to find out what those two techniques would be.
Second Ascension Technique:
Black Steel Armor
Realm:
Silver Knight Technique
Type:
Defense / Aether Armor Enhancement
Description:
After mastering Black Steel Skin, the user learns to push their Aether reinforcement beyond the surface of their body.
Instead of only hardening their flesh...the user creates a layer of condensed Black Steel Aether around their entire body.
This invisible reinforcement acts like a second layer of armor. But unlike normal armor,
Black Steel Armor moves perfectly with the user’s body and strengthens every movement.
The more Aether the user releases, the denser and stronger the armor becomes.
Effects:
• Creates powerful Aether-based defense
• Greatly reduces incoming damage
• Protects against stronger physical attacks
• Improves resistance against Aether attacks
• Allows the user to ignore weaker attacks completely
{Mastery Requirement:
By completely mastering Black Steel Armor, the user gains advanced control over defensive Aether reinforcement and obtains the qualification to ascend into the Gold Knight Realm.}
GULP!
Luke after reading full description, swallowed his saliva that was about to come out from his mouth.
"THIS IS ABSURD!!!" Finally a few seconds later he utter those words loudly with schoked expression.
BAM!

But just as he was about to continue his words. From the room alongside him, "Aurielle’s Room," a sudden fist slamming against the wall sound... was heard. Then comes his sweet wife’s angry voice along with a few... curses.
"LUKE! HAS YOUR DICK BECOME TOO BIG! THAT’S WHY YOU CAN’T SLEEP ALONE AT ALL!!"
Luke face become deep red, when she said those words.
Even though he knew she was angry, he still...shouting like that. What if someone heard?
So he gathers his courage to ask her to calm down—
CREEK! BAM!
But before he can do that, he hears the door opening sound and, with a bam, its closing sound.
STEP! STEP!
Then he heard the clear footstep of someone walking. And a bad premonition rose into his heart.
CLICK!

And finally, it’s become true. Because his room door opened suddenly with a click sound, and there stood a very beautiful woman with black hair and purple eyes that were filled with love. "No...those eyes were filled with suspi...SUSPICION?!"
"Where is that blue-masked woman?" Aurielle asked him, with those same suspicious eyes, looks around Luke’s room and scans each corner to find the hidden woman.
"HUH?...HAH??? From ’huh’ to ’hah,’ Luke’s mouth opened fully, and he gave a speechless look with teary eyes toward his wife.

’Can’t you trust?? Your husband even a little bit??’ Luke, with a betrayed expression, looks toward his wife. Who always thought he was fing around with every woman. which clearly his system wants. [(¬‿¬)]
Aurielle saw her husband’s innocent look with big crocodile tears, but her heart didn’t melt at this sight.
"Don’t act so innocent in front of me!" Her voice was still a little high when she said those words to him with a expression. "I am not falling for this."
Which brought even more crocodile tears to his eyes, but then he heard something. Which brings sweat to his forehead.
"Naira told me! That’s how you were playing an eye-to-eye game, face-to-face with your little vixen."
Luke’s eyes became wide and mouth opened after hearing those words.
Because that incident really happened, ’But that was an misunderstanding!!!’
Luke thoughts, that were constantly screaming, "I am innocent," while keep giving the same look to Aurielle. Which was clearly not working at all.
But then Aurielle instantly come in front of him and with a sudden motion she grabed tightly his little brother. "OUCH! 🥒🤏😖"
Luke felt instant pain with little pleasure 😬 but still more pain. Because of her sudden touch.
Though it’s still bring real tears to his eyes and one thought comes into his mind. ’Is she going to castrate me? Means my future generation is in danger!!!"
Luke was imagining things that have gone too far for his future generation.
Meanwhile, Aurielle’s face has become a little red. Because she felt Luke’s dick is not big at all. Means he was not with any women or even thinking about them.
’Damn it! But why my face is becoming red? Suddenly this thought comes into her mind, and she unconsciously starts stroking Luke’s dk.
"Ahh...now it’s feels good... ( ̄▽ ̄)💦" But then she heard her husband’s moaning sound, filled with vulgar words: "More! Honey! More!"

’More what???’ While thinking this, she looked down, and her face turned deep red. Because there she was, stroking her husband’s little brother, which has now become hard. And there her husband was, lost in high heavens but still spouting those vulgar words.
"YIKESS!" With a sudden yelp, she backed away from Luke and shook her hand in the air to remove his wet liquid, which was now coming from his pants.

But that clinging wet liquid was still not removing itself from her hand. So with a disgusted face, she looked toward her husband, and there she saw, that Luke’s expression fall when she suddenly backed away, while his gaze constantly looked toward her hand with a longing expression.
Aurielle’s face filled with shame at this, and she raised her shaking hand. because she was controlling her anger. While pointing her finger toward Luke. "YOU!!!"
Because she was not like that before, only after meeting her horny husband, who always likes to go rough with her. She changed without even her knowing.

So without saying anything but just with a hmph. She turned back toward the closed door to leave this room. But then she turned back again toward Luke and grabbed his hand. to bring him along to her room.
"Why?" Well... because she doesn’t know what Luke will do with his hard d**k now. Maybe if she left him alone and he really reached the Blue Mask women’s room. Then that would be worst.
So she can’t leave her horny and hard husband alone. ’At least for tonight!’
